Grabstract.source: AI graphical abstract generator for publication-ready visual summaries.
Grabstract.zh: AI 图形摘要生成器，用于发布就绪的视觉摘要。

Open Knowledge Maps.source: AI-based visual search engine for scientific knowledge and topic maps.
Open Knowledge Maps.zh: AI-based科学知识和主题图可视化搜索引擎。

Connected Papers.source: Visual graph for exploring academic papers related to a seed paper.
Connected Papers.zh: 用于探索与种子论文相关的学术论文的可视化图表。

ResearchRabbit.source: AI-powered literature review assistant with citation maps and built-in visualizations.
ResearchRabbit.zh: AI-powered 文献综述助手，具有引文图和内置可视化功能。

Litmaps.source: Dynamic literature-review maps for discovery, visualization, sharing, and monitoring.
Litmaps.zh: 用于发现、可视化、共享和监控的动态文献综述地图。

Consensus.source: AI-powered scientific search and evidence synthesis; useful as report input.
Consensus.zh: AI-powered 科学检索和证据合成；可用作报告输入。

MinerU.source: Complex PDFs and Office documents to LLM-ready markdown/JSON.
MinerU.zh: 将复杂 PDF 和 Office 文档转成便于大语言模型处理的 Markdown 或 JSON。

Docling.source: Document conversion and structure extraction for gen-AI workflows.
Docling.zh: gen-AI 工作流程的文档转换和结构提取。

MarkItDown.source: Lightweight Python library and CLI for converting PDFs, Office files, images, audio, HTML, structured text, ZIPs, YouTube URLs, and EPubs into LLM-ready Markdown.
MarkItDown.zh: 轻量级 Python 库和 CLI，用于将 PDFs、Office 文件、图像、音频、HTML、结构化文本、ZIPs、YouTube、URLs 和 EPubs 转换为 LLM-ready Markdown。

MarkSight.source: Browser-local Markdown editor and MCP server that turns Markdown documents into installable Agent Skills, live Mermaid previews, styled HTML, and print-ready PDF exports.
MarkSight.zh: 浏览器本地 Markdown 编辑器和 MCP 服务器，可将 Markdown 文档转换为可安装的 Agent Skills、实时 Mermaid 预览、样式化的 HTML 和打印就绪的 PDF 导出。

Marker.source: Fast PDF to markdown and JSON conversion.
Marker.zh: 将 PDF 快速转换为 Markdown 和 JSON。

Unstructured.source: Document ETL for transforming complex documents into structured formats for language-model pipelines.
Unstructured.zh: 文档 ETL 工具，将复杂文档转换成适合语言模型工作流使用的结构化内容。

GROBID.source: Scholarly-document information extraction for metadata, references, and full-text structure.
GROBID.zh: 元数据、参考文献和全文结构的学术文档信息提取。

PaperMage.source: NLP and CV library for scientific papers.
PaperMage.zh: NLP 和 CV 科学论文库。

s2orc-doc2json.source: Scientific paper parsers for PDF, LaTeX, and JATS to JSON.
s2orc-doc2json.zh: PDF、LaTeX 和 JATS 到 JSON 的科学论文解析器。

Piktochart AI.source: Prompt, notes, or uploaded content to editable infographics, reports, and presentations.
Piktochart AI.zh: 提示、注释或上传内容到可编辑的信息图、报告和演示文稿。

hbr-style-visualization.source: Claude Code skill for HBR-style editorial charts, strategic matrices, flywheels, and business infographics.
hbr-style-visualization.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于 HBR-style 编辑图表、战略矩阵、飞轮和业务信息图。

viz-skills.source: Claude Code command skills that analyze articles or concepts into seven logical relationship types and generate SVG infographics using matching spatial metaphors.
viz-skills.zh: Claude Code 命令 Skill 将文章或概念分析为七种逻辑关系类型，并使用匹配的空间隐喻生成 SVG 信息图。

Claude Design.source: Anthropic Labs product for collaborating with Claude on polished visual work from prompts, images, documents, PPTX/XLSX/DOCX files, websites, and codebases, with export to PPTX, PDF, Canva, folders, or standalone HTML.
Claude Design.zh: Anthropic Labs 产品，用于与 Claude 合作，通过提示、图像、文档、PPTX/XLSX/DOCX 文件、网站和代码库进行精美的视觉工作，并导出到 PPTX、PDF、Canva、文件夹或独立的 HTML。

Venngage AI Infographic Generator.source: Text or documents to on-brand infographics and visual summaries.
Venngage AI Infographic Generator.zh: 文本或文档到品牌信息图和视觉摘要。

Jeda AI Infographic Generator.source: PDF/report/article or data to extracted insights and infographic structures.
Jeda AI Infographic Generator.zh: PDF/report/article 或提取见解和信息图结构的数据。

Infogram.source: AI-assisted visuals, chart suggestions, and interactive data stories.
Infogram.zh: AI-assisted 视觉效果、图表建议和交互式数据故事。

ai-frontier-daily.source: Agent skill and scheduled workflow that fetches official AI vendor updates, curates them in Chinese, renders Xiaohongshu and WeChat card images, and publishes a GitHub Pages review gallery.
ai-frontier-daily.zh: Agent Skill 和预定工作流程，获取官方 AI 供应商更新，用中文进行管理，渲染小红书和 WeChat 卡片图像，并发布 GitHub 页面评论库。

ppt-master.source: Document to editable PowerPoint with native shapes, animations, narration, and template support.
ppt-master.zh: 将文档转成可编辑的 PowerPoint，支持原生形状、动画、旁白和模板。

Presenton.source: Open-source presentation generator and API with template and MCP positioning.
Presenton.zh: 开源演示生成器和带有模板的 API 和 MCP 定位。

NodeSlide.source: Reviewable deck-as-code app that turns prompts, structured briefs, or raw data into typed DeckSpec presentations with cited agent proposals, editable charts, HTML publishing, and PowerPoint export.
NodeSlide.zh: 可审查的演示文稿即代码应用程序，可将提示、结构化摘要或原始数据转换为键入的 DeckSpec 演示文稿，其中包含引用的 Agent 提案、可编辑图表、HTML 发布和 PowerPoint 导出。

Deckbuilder.source: Python library, CLI, and MCP server that turns Markdown or JSON into complete PowerPoint decks, analyzes templates, recommends layouts, and remaps fonts or languages in existing presentations.
Deckbuilder.zh: Python 库、CLI 和 MCP 服务器，可将 Markdown 或 JSON 转换为完整的 PowerPoint 平台、分析模板、建议布局以及重新映射现有演示文稿中的字体或语言。

PPTAgent.zh: 代理反射 PowerPoint 生成框架。

AI Multi-Agent Presentation Builder.source: Azure sample that uses Semantic Kernel and multiple agents to generate draft PowerPoint decks from a user topic.
AI Multi-Agent Presentation Builder.zh: Azure 示例，使用语义内核和多个 Agent 从用户主题生成草稿 PowerPoint 卡片组。

presentation-ai.zh: 开源 Gamma 风格的 AI 演示生成器。

DeckForge.source: API-first presentation engine for agents that turns prompts or structured Presentation IR into PPTX or Google Slides decks with slide/chart discovery tools, themes, QA checks, and a TypeScript SDK.
DeckForge.zh: 适用于 Agent 的 API-first 演示引擎，可将提示或结构化演示 IR 转换为 PPTX 或 Google 幻灯片平台，其中包含幻灯片/图表发现工具、主题、QA 检查和 TypeScript SDK。

slide-deck-ai.source: Multi-provider AI assistant for professional presentation generation.
slide-deck-ai.zh: 用于生成专业演示文稿的多提供商 AI 助手。

odin-slides.zh: GPT-based Word/文档到 PowerPoint 生成器。

SlideSmith AI.source: Local document-to-presentation generator that turns PDFs, Markdown, Word documents, and plain text into structured slide narratives with local AI backends and PPTX, PDF, or HTML export.
SlideSmith AI.zh: 本地文档到演示文稿生成器，可将 PDFs、Markdown、Word 文档和纯文本转换为结构化幻灯片叙述，并具有本地 AI 后端和 PPTX、PDF 或 HTML 导出。

slide-maker.source: Codex and Claude Code deck-maker that reads papers, repos, documents, data, or topics, plans and critiques slide narratives with specialized agents, then ships source-traced, fully editable native PPTX decks with charts, equations, speaker notes, and template galleries.
slide-maker.zh: Codex 和 Claude Code 套牌制作者可以使用专门的 Agent 阅读论文、存储库、文档、数据或主题、计划和评论幻灯片叙述，然后提供带有图表、方程、演讲者注释和模板库的可追踪源头、完全可编辑的本机 PPTX 套牌。

M3E Canvas.source: Browser-based Material 3 Expressive canvas for sketching linked mobile and desktop app screens, previewing flows, exporting PNGs, and copying multilingual prompts for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or other coding agents.
M3E Canvas.zh: 基于浏览器的 Material 3 Expressive 画布，用于绘制链接的移动和桌面应用程序屏幕、预览流程、导出 PNGs 以及复制 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 或其他编码的多语言提示Agent。

NiubiGEO.source: Open-source AI brand-visibility workbench that turns domains, competitor sets, model answers, citations, and repeated keyword tests into evidence-backed visibility reports, comparison dashboards, and monitoring views.
NiubiGEO.zh: 开源 AI 品牌可见性工作台，可将域、竞争对手集、模型答案、引文和重复关键字测试转换为有证据支持的可见性报告、比较仪表盘和监控视图。

WeChat Intelligence Hub.source: Local-first Codex skill and reader pipeline that converts authorized WeChat history into searchable intelligence, action items, relationship context, opportunities, Markdown reports, and interactive HTML daily briefings.
WeChat Intelligence Hub.zh: 本地优先的 Codex Skill 和读取器管道，将授权的 WeChat 历史记录转换为可搜索的情报、行动项目、关系背景、机会、Markdown 报告和交互式 HTML 每日简报。

Holo Card Studio.source: Codex skill that turns a text brief or reference image into layered holographic or lenticular cards, editable Blender scenes, rendered images, GLB assets, and interactive Three.js card viewers with validation reports.
Holo Card Studio.zh: Codex Skill 将文本摘要或参考图像转换为分层全息或光栅卡、可编辑的 Blender 场景、渲染图像、GLB 资源以及带有验证报告的交互式 Three.js 卡查看器。

ffmpeg-skill.source: Agent Skill and MCP toolset that gives coding agents a verified FFmpeg workflow for cutting, joining, captioning, overlaying, color converting, waveform rendering, delivery checking, JSON reporting, and whole-project video export.
ffmpeg-skill.zh: Agent Skill 和 MCP 工具集为 Agent 编码提供了经过验证的 FFmpeg 工作流程，用于剪切、连接、字幕、叠加、颜色转换、波形渲染、交付检查、JSON 报告和整个项目视频导出。

handraw-style.source: Hand-drawn style prompt skill and numbered visual gallery with 261 curated reference styles, model-capability notes, image references, and scripts for resolving style IDs into stable image-generation prompts.
handraw-style.zh: 手绘风格提示 Skill 和编号视觉库，其中包含 261 个精选参考样式、模型功能注释、图像参考以及用于将风格 IDs 解析为稳定图像生成提示的脚本。

dream-loop.source: Agent skill for building visually rich games, apps, or scenes through a closed loop of image-generation targets, 3D asset creation with Blender or APIs, and browser-based Three.js implementation reviewed against the target screenshot.
dream-loop.zh: Agent Skill 用于通过图像生成目标的闭环构建视觉丰富的游戏、应用程序或场景，使用 Blender 或 APIs 创建 3D 资产，以及根据目标屏幕截图审核基于浏览器的 Three.js 实现。

consulting-pptx-skill.source: Claude Code skill for boardroom-quality decks using a 110-rule slide-design rulebook, 62-part HTML slide library, visual catalog PDF, automated deck checks, rendered layout inspection, and Chrome PDF export.
consulting-pptx-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于会议室质量的演示文稿，使用 110 条幻灯片设计规则手册、62 部分 HTML 幻灯片库、视觉目录 PDF、自动演示文稿检查、渲染布局检查和 Chrome PDF 导出。

Yingzao.source: Claude Code and Codex skill that transforms architecture, cultural-place, object, food, or travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with fact boundaries, reference recipes, Chinese typography briefs, sparse layout guides, and optional 3x3 video storyboards.
Yingzao.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 将建筑、文化场所、物体、食物或旅行照片转换为艺术指导的编辑海报，其中包含事实边界、参考食谱、中文排版简介、稀疏布局指南和可选的 3x3 视频故事板。

Image Story Video Wizard.source: Codex and WorkBuddy skill that guides audio-first image-story videos from topic, benchmarks, writing pack, script, voice, storyboard, style, character anchors, image prompts, asset QC, preview, and final render.
Image Story Video Wizard.zh: Codex 和 WorkBuddy Skill 从主题、基准、写作包、脚本、语音、故事板、风格、角色锚点、图像提示、资产 QC、预览和最终渲染中指导音频优先的图像故事视频。

Codex Skill Stats & Dashboard.source: Local-first Codex dashboard and soft-hook skill that tracks skill usage events, activation state, project context, translation status, and skill details through a zero-dependency SQLite plus vanilla HTML interface.
Codex Skill Stats & Dashboard.zh: 本地优先的 Codex 仪表盘和软挂钩 Skill，通过零依赖 SQLite 和普通 HTML 界面跟踪 Skill 使用事件、激活状态、项目上下文、翻译状态和 Skill 详细信息。

edit2docs.source: Agent-native Python document engine, MCP server, and hosted service that generates or chat-edits native DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files with real paragraphs, cells, charts, previews, and PDF/SVG/PNG rendering.
edit2docs.zh: Agent-本机 Python 文档引擎、MCP 服务器和托管服务，可生成或聊天编辑本机 DOCX、XLSX 和 PPTX 文件，其中包含真实的段落、单元格、图表、预览和 PDF/SVG/PNG 渲染。

dashi-ppt-skill.source: Agent skill for workplace presentation decks with browser-editable HTML output, 12 visual themes, 1020 layouts, adjustable controls, editable text/media, and one-click export to offline HTML, PDF, or editable PPTX.
dashi-ppt-skill.zh: Agent Skill 适用于工作场所演示文稿，具有可浏览器编辑的 HTML 输出、12 个视觉主题、1020 个布局、可调整控件、可编辑文本/媒体，以及一键导出到离线 HTML、PDF 或可编辑 PPTX。

deck-factory.source: Claude Code skill that turns one-line intent into presentation-grade editorial HTML decks with dark and paper-light profiles, deterministic quality gates, Chromium rendering, shareable PDFs, and showcase motion films.
deck-factory.zh: Claude Code Skill 将一行意图转换为演示级编辑 HTML 平台，具有深色和纸光轮廓、确定性质量门、Chromium 渲染、可共享 PDFs 和展示动态电影。

econ-slides-skill.source: Claude Code and Codex skill that turns economics papers into verified Beamer talks or discussant decks, tracing numbers to source pages, rebuilding regression exhibits, compiling LaTeX, and checking rendered geometry.
econ-slides-skill.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 将经济学论文转化为经过验证的 Beamer 演讲或讨论平台，跟踪源页面的数字，重建回归展示，编译 LaTeX 并检查渲染的几何图形。

voiceover-deck.source: Claude Code skill that builds narrated, self-playing single-page web slide decks with browser text-to-speech by default, optional ElevenLabs voice cloning, captions, controls, fullscreen playback, and static-host sharing.
voiceover-deck.zh: Claude Code Skill 可构建带旁白、自播放的单页网页幻灯片，默认情况下具有浏览器文本转语音功能，可选 ElevenLabs 语音克隆、字幕、控件、全屏播放和静态主机共享。

PresentationSkill-ClaudeCode.source: Claude Code skill suite that turns source material, outlines, notes, and datasets into citation-disciplined HTML decks, print-quality posters, and research-synthesis outlines through an HTML plus Playwright pipeline.
PresentationSkill-ClaudeCode.zh: Claude Code Skill 套件，通过 HTML 加 Playwright 管道，将源材料、大纲、注释和数据集转换为受引文约束的 HTML 平台、打印质量海报和研究综合大纲。

canva-monthly-report.source: Claude Code skill for building recurring social-analytics monthly reports in Canva decks from Google Sheet data, with scripts for parsing sheet tables, aggregating monthly metrics, mapping Canva element IDs, and generating safe edit operations plus chart values.
canva-monthly-report.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于根据 Google Sheet 数据在 Canva 平台中构建定期社交分析月度报告，并带有用于解析工作表、聚合每月指标、映射 Canva 元素 IDs 以及生成安全编辑操作和图表值的脚本。

ppt-agents.source: Markdown to PowerPoint workflow using AI agents.
ppt-agents.zh: 使用 AI Agent 的 Markdown 到 PowerPoint 工作流程。

Slideia.source: Open-source monorepo with Next.js, FastAPI, CLI, API, and MCP server surfaces for proposing slide outlines, drafting content, and exporting LLM-generated PowerPoint decks.
Slideia.zh: 具有 Next.js、FastAPI、CLI、API 和 MCP 服务器界面的开源 monorepo，用于提出幻灯片大纲、起草内容和导出 LLM-generated PowerPoint 幻灯片。

deckdown.source: Markdown presentation engine for agents with PDF, PNG, and PPTX output.
deckdown.zh: 用于 Agent 的 Markdown 演示引擎，具有 PDF、PNG 和 PPTX 输出。

Frontend Slides.source: Agent skill that creates HTML presentations from prompts or converts PowerPoint files with selectable visual themes.
Frontend Slides.zh: Agent Skill，根据提示创建 HTML 演示文稿或转换具有可选视觉主题的 PowerPoint 文件。

Slides AI Plugin.source: Agent plugin for Claude, OpenClaw, and compatible hosts that turns a prompt into animated HTML slides or editable PowerPoint decks.
Slides AI Plugin.zh: 适用于 Claude、OpenClaw 和兼容主机的 Agent 插件，可将提示转换为动画 HTML 幻灯片或可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片。

Present.source: Claude Code skill that turns research, notes, meeting summaries, proposals, or educational material into self-contained HTML presentations with article mode, slide mode, optional images, and narrated audio.
Present.zh: Claude Code Skill 将研究、笔记、会议摘要、提案或教育材料转换为独立的 HTML 演示文稿，具有文章模式、幻灯片模式、可选图像和叙述音频。

slidemason.source: Local-first AI presentation builder that turns documents into polished decks through Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or other coding agents without API keys or accounts.
slidemason.zh: 本地优先的 AI 演示构建器，可通过 Cursor、Windsurf、Claude Code 或其他编码 Agent 将文档转换为精美的演示文稿，无需 API 密钥或帐户。

cc-slidev.source: Claude Code plugin for developer-focused technical presentations in Slidev with evidence-based design guardrails and export-oriented workflows.
cc-slidev.zh: Claude Code 插件，用于在 Slidev 中进行以开发人员为中心的技术演示，具有基于证据的设计护栏和面向出口的工作流程。

revealjs-skill.source: Claude Code plugin and skill for creating Reveal.js HTML presentations from natural language, with professional themes, Chart.js data visuals, speaker notes, overflow checks, screenshots, and PDF export via Playwright and DeckTape.
revealjs-skill.zh: Claude Code 插件和 Skill 用于从自然语言创建 Reveal.js HTML 演示文稿，具有专业主题、Chart.js 数据视觉效果、演讲者注释、溢出检查、屏幕截图，以及通过 Playwright 和 DeckTape 导出 PDF。

slidev-deck-stack.source: Claude Code skill and plugin that codifies Slidev v52 deck construction, covering Markdown/Vue layouts, magic-move, Mermaid/PlantUML, KaTeX, Chinese fonts, and PDF/PPTX/PNG/SPA export.
slidev-deck-stack.zh: Claude Code Skill 和插件，编码 Slidev v52 演示文稿结构，涵盖 Markdown/Vue 布局、magic-move、Mermaid/PlantUML、KaTeX、中文字体和PDF/PPTX/PNG/SPA 导出。

high-quality-slides.source: Claude Code skill for research-first, narrative-driven HTML decks with design-system gates, viewport-locked output, and optional PPTX export through a companion pptx skill.
high-quality-slides.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于研究优先、叙事驱动的 HTML 平台，具有设计系统门、视口锁定输出以及可选的 PPTX 通过配套 pptx Skill 导出。

Presentation Skill.source: Platform-agnostic AI-agent skill for image-generated slide decks with an HTML module fallback for editable or interactive presentations.
Presentation Skill.zh: 与平台无关的 AI-Agent Skill，用于图像生成的幻灯片，并带有用于可编辑或交互式演示的 HTML 模块回退。

presentation-writing-claude-skill.source: Claude skill that turns notes, documents, spreadsheets, transcripts, and briefings into persuasive slide-by-slide narrative outlines with optional clean PPTX output.
presentation-writing-claude-skill.zh: Claude Skill 将笔记、文档、电子表格、成绩单和简报转换为有说服力的逐幻灯片叙述大纲，并具有可选的干净 PPTX 输出。

Office-PowerPoint-MCP-Server.source: MCP server for creating, editing, and manipulating PowerPoint through python-pptx.
Office-PowerPoint-MCP-Server.zh: MCP 服务器，用于通过 python-pptx 创建、编辑和操作 PowerPoint。

Presentation Gen MCP Server.source: MCP server for AI-assisted PowerPoint generation from structured content, templates, layouts, and styling, usable from Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
Presentation Gen MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器，用于从结构化内容、模板、布局和样式生成 AI-assisted PowerPoint，可从 Claude Code、Claude 桌面、Cursor 和其他 MCP 客户端使用。

MCP Office Documents Server.source: Dockerized MCP server that lets AI assistants create PowerPoint, Word, Excel, email, and XML files from prompts or Markdown, with custom templates and local, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, or MinIO output storage.
MCP Office Documents Server.zh: Dockerized MCP 服务器，允许 AI 助手根据提示或 Markdown 创建 PowerPoint、Word、Excel、电子邮件和 XML 文件，使用自定义模板和本地、S3、GCS、Azure Blob 或MinIO 输出存储。

2slides MCP Server.source: Official 2slides MCP server for generating PowerPoint presentations through the 2slides API, including theme search and fast PPT creation from agent workflows.
2slides MCP Server.zh: 官方 2slides MCP 服务器，用于通过 2slides API 生成 PowerPoint 演示文稿，包括主题搜索和从 Agent 工作流程快速创建 PPT。

PowerPointMcp.source: Windows-only MCP server, CLI, VS Code extension, and optional skill for live Microsoft PowerPoint COM automation with slide, shape, table, chart, note, animation, template, and export-to-image verification operations.
PowerPointMcp.zh: 仅 Windows MCP 服务器、CLI、VS 代码扩展和可选的 Skill，用于实时 Microsoft PowerPoint COM 自动化，具有幻灯片、形状、表格、图表、注释、动画、模板和导出到图像验证操作。

PPT-MCP.source: Pure Node.js PowerPoint MCP server built with PptxGenJS for creating, analyzing, and managing presentations with AI assistance.
PPT-MCP.zh: 纯 Node.js PowerPoint MCP 服务器使用 PptxGenJS 构建，用于在 AI 的帮助下创建、分析和管理演示文稿。

PptMcp.source: Windows PowerPoint COM automation MCP server and CLI for AI assistants to create, edit, chart, animate, validate, and export decks as PDF, slide images, video, or other formats.
PptMcp.zh: Windows PowerPoint COM 自动化 MCP 服务器和 CLI，用于 AI 助手创建、编辑、图表、动画、验证和导出平台为 PDF、幻灯片图像、视频或其他格式。

Slides MCP Server.source: Rust MCP server for end-to-end PowerPoint deck authoring with 71 tools covering slides, text runs, shapes, connectors, tables, images, charts, themes, layouts, speaker notes, hyperlinks, SVG/PNG rendering, PDF export, contrast checks, and design linting.
Slides MCP Server.zh: Rust MCP 服务器用于端到端 PowerPoint 平台创作，具有 71 种工具，涵盖幻灯片、文本运行、形状、连接器、表格、图像、图表、主题、布局、演讲者注释、超链接、SVG/PNG 渲染、PDF 导出、对比度检查和设计 linting。

gslides-2-html-presenter.source: Claude Code skill that converts a Google Slides share URL into two synced, fully self-contained offline HTML files: a screen-share-safe audience deck and a private presenter-notes view with thumbnails, keyboard navigation, and local sync.
gslides-2-html-presenter.zh: Claude Code Skill 将 Google 幻灯片共享 URL 转换为两个同步的、完全独立的离线 HTML 文件：一个屏幕共享安全的观众平台和一个带有缩略图、键盘导航和本地同步的私人演示者注释视图。

ppt-mcp.source: Windows PowerPoint COM automation MCP server with live presentation control, slide/shape/text/table/chart/media/animation tools, Material Symbols insertion, and export to PDF or slide images.
ppt-mcp.zh: Windows PowerPoint COM 自动化 MCP 服务器，具有实时演示控制、幻灯片/形状/文本/表格/图表/媒体/动画工具、材质符号插入以及导出到 PDF 或幻灯片图像。

OfficeCLI.source: Local Office suite for AI agents to create, inspect, edit, render, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without Microsoft Office, including HTML/PNG preview loops and an installable agent skill.
OfficeCLI.zh: 用于 AI Agent 的本地 Office 套件，无需 Microsoft Office，即可创建、检查、编辑、渲染和自动化 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件，包括 HTML/PNG 预览循环和可安装的 Agent Skill。

Kova.source: Native desktop Markdown presentation editor with live preview, auto layouts, themes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, Mermaid charts, rich media, speaker notes, build animations, computed tables, and PPTX/PDF/standalone HTML export.
Kova.zh: 本机桌面 Markdown 演示文稿编辑器，具有实时预览、自动布局、主题、KaTeX、语法突出显示、Mermaid 图表、富媒体、演讲者注释、构建动画、计算表和 PPTX/PDF/standalone HTML 导出。

image-to-editable-ppt-skill.source: Codex skill that reconstructs slide images, PDFs, and image-based PPTX pages into editable PowerPoint decks with OCR-guided text boxes, simple native shapes, extracted visual assets, notes preservation, and per-page verification loops.
image-to-editable-ppt-skill.zh: Codex Skill 将幻灯片图像、PDFs 和基于图像的 PPTX 页面重建为可编辑的 PowerPoint 平台，其中包含 OCR-guided 文本框、简单的原生形状、提取的视觉资源、注释保存和每页验证循环。

dom-to-pptx.source: Client-side HTML/DOM-to-PowerPoint library and agent skill installer that maps computed layout, CSS gradients, shadows, SVGs, fonts, animations, and transitions into editable PPTX slides.
dom-to-pptx.zh: 客户端 HTML/DOM-to-PowerPoint 库和 Agent Skill 安装程序，可将计算布局、CSS 渐变、阴影、SVGs、字体、动画和过渡映射到可编辑的 PPTX 幻灯片中。

MinerU2PPT.source: Windows GUI and converter that uses MinerU-structured PDF/image extraction to rebuild source documents as high-fidelity editable PowerPoint presentations with CPU and CUDA package variants.
MinerU2PPT.zh: Windows GUI 和转换器，使用 MinerU 结构的 PDF/image 提取将源文档重建为具有 CPU 和 CUDA 软件包变体的高保真可编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

ppt-rs.source: Rust PowerPoint generation library, CLI, and optional MCP server that converts Markdown or HTML into valid editable PPTX, supports templates, charts, media, package validation, and image/export round trips.
ppt-rs.zh: Rust PowerPoint 生成库、CLI 和可选的 MCP 服务器，可将 Markdown 或 HTML 转换为有效的可编辑 PPTX，支持模板、图表、媒体、包验证和图像/导出往返。

html2pptx.source: Node.js CLI and library for converting HTML files into PowerPoint presentations while preserving text, lists, images, SVGs, hyperlinks, CSS styling, transforms, layouts, and post-processed PPTX validity.
html2pptx.zh: Node.js CLI 和库，用于将 HTML 文件转换为 PowerPoint 演示文稿，同时保留文本、列表、图像、SVGs、超链接、CSS 样式、转换、布局和后处理的 PPTX 有效性。

office-editor-mcp.source: Python MCP server for AI assistants to create, edit, format, and analyze Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents, including slide management, graphic elements, tables, charts, animations, transitions, OCR, translation, and encryption utilities.
office-editor-mcp.zh: Python MCP 服务器，用于 AI 助手创建、编辑、格式化和分析 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文档，包括幻灯片管理、图形元素、表格、图表、动画、过渡、OCR、翻译和加密实用程序。

Alai MCP Server.source: Hosted Alai MCP endpoint and local wrapper for generating, editing, exporting, and adding speaker notes to designer-level presentations.
Alai MCP Server.zh: 托管 Alai MCP 端点和本地包装器，用于生成、编辑、导出演讲者注释以及将演讲者注释添加到设计师级演示文稿中。

powerpoint-mcp.source: Lightweight local MCP server that creates and edits PowerPoint files cross-platform through python-pptx without external API calls or COM automation.
powerpoint-mcp.zh: 轻量级本地 MCP 服务器，通过 python-pptx 跨平台创建和编辑 PowerPoint 文件，无需外部 API 调用或 COM 自动化。

Presentations.AI MCP Server.source: Official Presentations.AI MCP server that creates designed decks from topics, raw text, or PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT/Markdown files and exposes PPTX, PDF, image, share, and render exports.
Presentations.AI MCP Server.zh: 官方演示。AI MCP 服务器，用于从主题、原始文本或 PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT/Markdown 文件创建设计的平台，并公开 PPTX、PDF、图像、共享和渲染导出。

Figma Console MCP.source: Figma MCP server that gives agents read/write design-system, FigJam, accessibility, screenshot, token-sync, and Figma Slides deck creation and management tools through local, cloud, or SSE modes.
Figma Console MCP.zh: Figma MCP 服务器，提供 Agent 读/写设计系统、FigJam、可访问性、屏幕截图、令牌同步和 Figma 通过本地、云或 SSE 模式幻灯片组创建和管理工具。

google-slides-mcp.source: TypeScript MCP server for creating, reading, and modifying Google Slides presentations through the Google Slides API and batch update requests.
google-slides-mcp.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器，用于通过 Google Slides API 和批量更新请求创建、读取和修改 Google Slides 演示文稿。

DocGem MCP.source: Claude Code MCP plugin that generates PowerPoint, Word, Excel, PDF, HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, Mermaid, Gantt, Draw.io, CSV, and JSON artifacts from natural-language prompts.
DocGem MCP.zh: Claude Code MCP 插件，可生成 PowerPoint、Word、Excel、PDF、HTML、Markdown、LaTeX、Mermaid、甘特图、Draw.io、来自自然语言提示的 CSV 和 JSON 产物。

mcp-ppt.source: Python MCP server that creates, edits, saves, and exports PowerPoint presentations with slides, images, tables, outlines, base64 downloads, and SVG insertion.
mcp-ppt.zh: Python MCP 服务器，用于创建、编辑、保存和导出包含幻灯片、图像、表格、大纲、base64 下载和 SVG 插入的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

Lutrin.source: Markdown deck compiler, VS Code/Obsidian workflow, and agent skill that infers layouts, validates overflow, and exports editable PowerPoint or standalone HTML presenter pages.
Lutrin.zh: Markdown 套牌编译器、VS 代码/Obsidian 工作流程和 Agent Skill，用于推断布局、验证溢出并导出可编辑的 PowerPoint 或独立的 HTML 演示者页面。

slide-mcp.source: Figma Slides plugin and bundled MCP bridge that turns prompts or create_deck JSON into designed decks with 39 layouts, 17 design systems, charts, images, tables, BYOK LLM mode, and local-only key storage.
slide-mcp.zh: Figma Slides 插件和捆绑的 MCP 桥将提示或 create_deck JSON 转换为具有 39 种布局、17 个设计系统、图表、图像、表格、BYOK LLM 模式和仅限本地密钥存储的设计演示文稿。

figma-slides-mcp.source: MCP server, Figma plugin, and optional design skill that lets AI agents create and edit Figma Slides with text, shapes, images, D3 charts, Rough.js sketches, Satori HTML-to-SVG layouts, screenshots, and PNG/SVG/PDF export.
figma-slides-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器、Figma 插件和可选设计 Skill，允许 AI Agent 创建和编辑包含文本、形状、图像、D3 图表、Rough.js 草图、Satori 的 Figma 幻灯片HTML-to-SVG 布局、屏幕截图和 PNG/SVG/PDF 导出。

figma-use-slides.source: Official Figma MCP guide skill for building, editing, restyling, validating, screenshotting, and organizing Figma Slides decks through the use_figma tool and Slides-specific Plugin API rules.
figma-use-slides.zh: 官方 Figma MCP 指南 Skill，用于构建、编辑、重新设计、验证、屏幕截图和组织 Figma 通过 use_figma 工具和幻灯片特定插件 API 规则来演示幻灯片。

pptx-tools.source: .NET MCP server and CLI for reading, updating, extracting, and generating PowerPoint files through agent tools.
pptx-tools.zh: .NET MCP 服务器和 CLI，用于通过 Agent 工具读取、更新、提取和生成 PowerPoint 文件。

che-pptx-mcp.source: Swift-native PowerPoint MCP server for creating, opening, editing, reading, and exporting PPTX files through roughly 45 PresentationML tools without requiring PowerPoint.
che-pptx-mcp.zh: Swift 原生 PowerPoint MCP 服务器，用于通过大约 45 个 PresentationML 工具创建、打开、编辑、读取和导出 PPTX 文件，而不需要 PowerPoint。

Marp MCP.source: MCP server plus Claude Code skill for creating and editing Marp slide decks with academic and professional styles.
Marp MCP.zh: MCP 服务器加上 Claude Code Skill，用于创建和编辑具有学术和专业风格的 Marp 幻灯片。

Marp Slide Creator.source: Agent Toolkit skill for creating Marp presentations with seven embedded themes, image-layout patterns, theme-selection guidance, and slide-design quality checks.
Marp Slide Creator.zh: Agent 工具包 Skill 用于创建具有七个嵌入主题、图像布局模式、主题选择指南和幻灯片设计质量检查的 Marp 演示文稿。

marp-slides.source: Claude Code skill for polished Marp decks with 22 reference decks, SVG charts, dashboard components, dark/light themes, interactive elements, and Marp PDF/PPTX/HTML export.
marp-slides.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于抛光 Marp 演示文稿，具有 22 个参考演示文稿、SVG 图表、仪表盘组件、深色/浅色主题、交互式元素和 Marp PDF/PPTX/HTML 导出。

PptxGenJS-mcp-server.source: Node.js MCP server that lets LLMs create, edit, manage, and export PowerPoint decks with text, shapes, images, tables, and charts through PptxGenJS.
PptxGenJS-mcp-server.zh: Node.js MCP 服务器，允许 LLMs 通过 PptxGenJS 创建、编辑、管理和导出包含文本、形状、图像、表格和图表的 PowerPoint 平台。

md-slides.source: Claude Code skill that turns topics or Markdown files into Marp, Beamer, PDF, PPTX, and HTML slide outputs with optional AI-generated diagrams and illustrations.
md-slides.zh: Claude Code Skill 将主题或 Markdown 文件转换为 Marp、Beamer、PDF、PPTX 和 HTML 幻灯片输出，并带有可选的 AI-generated 图表和插图。

md2html.source: Claude Code skill that converts Markdown deck sources into standalone branded HTML web-viewer and print/PDF slide renderings with offline-friendly assets and reusable templates.
md2html.zh: Claude Code Skill 将 Markdown 幻灯片源转换为独立品牌的 HTML Web 查看器和打印/PDF 幻灯片渲染，具有离线友好的资源和可重复使用的模板。

deckset-claude-skill.source: Claude Code and Claude Desktop skill for creating Deckset Markdown presentations, with bundled Deckset documentation, examples, and documentation scraper.
deckset-claude-skill.zh: Claude Code 和 Claude 桌面 Skill，用于创建 Deckset Markdown 演示文稿，附带捆绑的 Deckset 文档、示例和文档抓取工具。

pptx-from-layouts-skill.source: Agent skill that uses real slide master layouts and placeholders.
pptx-from-layouts-skill.zh: Agent Skill 使用真实的幻灯片母版布局和占位符。

hands-on-deck.source: PowerPoint inspect/edit/create/verify CLI through atomic JSON patches.
hands-on-deck.zh: PowerPoint 通过原子 JSON 补丁检查/编辑/创建/验证 CLI。

agent-slides.zh: 可组合 PowerPoint、Skill 和 CLI。

ultimate-ppt-master-skill.source: Local-first AI presentation production workbench for source material to PPTX or web decks.
ultimate-ppt-master-skill.zh: 本地优先的 AI 演示制作工作台，用于 PPTX 或网络平台的源材料。

slide-wright.source: Agent skill that turns topics, notes, or outlines into custom Reveal.js slide decks, showing style previews before building a self-contained deck that can export to PDF or deploy to a live URL.
slide-wright.zh: Agent Skill 将主题、注释或大纲转换为自定义 Reveal.js 幻灯片，在构建可导出到 PDF 或部署到实时 URL 的独立幻灯片之前显示样式预览。

Terry-slide-gen.source: Claude Code slide-generation skill that collects notes, outlines, research, optional figures, or style references once, then autonomously produces generated slide PNGs and an assembled editable PPTX deck.
Terry-slide-gen.zh: Claude Code 幻灯片生成 Skill，可收集笔记、大纲、研究、可选图形或样式参考一次，然后自动生成生成的幻灯片 PNGs 和组装的可编辑 PPTX 幻灯片。

codex-ppt-skill.source: Codex-oriented PPT generation skill using staged planning and image generation.
codex-ppt-skill.zh: Codex面向PPT生成Skill采用分阶段规划和图像生成。

presentation-skills.source: Skills for AI agents to process presentations.
presentation-skills.zh: Skills 用于 AI Agent 处理演示文稿。

anthropics-skills.source: Official public Agent Skills repository including PPTX, PDF, document, and spreadsheet workflows.
anthropics-skills.zh: 官方公共 Agent Skills 存储库，包括 PPTX、PDF、文档和电子表格工作流程。

MiniMax-AI-skills.source: Skills repository with PPTX generator/editor patterns.
MiniMax-AI-skills.zh: 带有 PPTX 生成器/编辑器模式的 Skills 存储库。

daymade-claude-code-skills.source: Claude Code skills marketplace whose documentation suite includes doc-to-Markdown conversion, Mermaid PNG rendering, PDF creation, and professional PPT deck creation.
daymade-claude-code-skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 市场，其文档套件包括文档到 Markdown 的转换、Mermaid PNG 渲染、PDF 创建和专业的 PPT 演示文稿创建。

slide-design-skill.source: SlideSpeak presentation-design skill that derives a bespoke visual style from a topic, brand URL, reference site, or moodboard and renders polished 1920x1080 HTML slide decks with charts, tables, and imagery.
slide-design-skill.zh: SlideSpeak 演示设计 Skill，从主题、品牌 URL、参考站点或情绪板派生出定制的视觉风格，并渲染带有图表、表格和图像的精美 1920x1080 HTML 幻灯片。

html-slides.source: Agent skill for Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, and Copilot that creates HTML presentations with speaker notes, converts PPTX files to web slideshows, and targets the HTMLSlides presenter app.
html-slides.zh: Agent Skill，适用于 Claude Code、Gemini、Codex 和 Copilot，用于创建带有演讲者注释的 HTML 演示文稿、将 PPTX 文件转换为 Web 幻灯片并以 HTMLSlides 为目标演示者应用程序。

pptx-mcp-live.source: MCP server for PowerPoint with 32 cross-platform python-pptx tools plus 26 Windows COM live-automation tools for open decks, picture effects, shape formatting, transitions, and PDF/image export.
pptx-mcp-live.zh: 用于 PowerPoint 的 MCP 服务器，具有 32 个跨平台 python-pptx 工具以及 26 个 Windows COM 实时自动化工具，用于开放平台、图片效果、形状格式化、过渡和 PDF/image 导出。

claude-skill-academic-ppt.source: Claude Code skill for generating academic defense PPTX decks from LaTeX, PDFs, or text, with dual-engine figure generation, action titles, speaker notes, and Q&A prediction.
claude-skill-academic-ppt.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于从 LaTeX、PDFs 或文本生成学术答辩 PPTX 套牌，具有双引擎图形生成、动作标题、演讲者注释和问答预测。

ppt-skills.source: Claude Code skill and text-to-PPTX pipeline for hand-drawn Rough.js-style visual slides, Playwright rendering, and editable dual-layer PowerPoint output.
ppt-skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 和文本到 PPTX 管道，用于手绘 Rough.js 风格的视觉幻灯片、Playwright 渲染和可编辑双层 PowerPoint 输出。

typst-claude-skill.source: Claude Code skill for producing Typst PDFs, reports, academic papers, resumes, invoices, and presentation slides from natural-language requests with bundled templates and CLI references.
typst-claude-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于根据自然语言请求生成 Typst PDFs、报告、学术论文、简历、发票和演示幻灯片，并附带捆绑模板和 CLI 参考。

LobsterAI.source: NetEase Youdao desktop-grade office agent for data analysis, PPT creation, video generation, document writing, web research, scheduled reports, and IM-controlled desktop work.
LobsterAI.zh: NetEase有道桌面级办公Agent，用于数据分析、PPT创建、视频生成、文档编写、网络研究、预定报告和IM-controlled桌面工作。

Garden Skills.source: Agent skill collection whose web-video-presentation, web-design-engineer, GPT-image, knowledge retrieval, and beautiful-article skills turn source material into web presentations, visual articles, dashboards, infographics, diagrams, and recordable video surfaces.
Garden Skills.zh: Agent Skill 集合，其网络视频演示、网络设计工程师、GPT-image、知识检索和精美文章 Skill 将源材料转换为网络演示、视觉文章、仪表盘、信息图、图表和可录制视频表面。

ai-agents-skills.source: Creative agent-skill stack for cinematic decks, branded design systems, viral videos, video editing, video-to-landing pages, parallax landing pages, HyperFrames captures, AI images, and Mermaid diagrams.

keynote-slides-skill.source: Keynote-style agent skill for single-file HTML decks with Gemini-generated infographics, multi-brand theming, content databases, and narrative-framework selection.
keynote-slides-skill.zh: Keynote 风格的 Agent Skill 用于单文件 HTML 演示文稿，具有 Gemini 生成的信息图、多品牌主题、内容数据库和叙事框架选择。

Claude Office Skills.source: Practical office skill suite plus Office MCP server for PDF, spreadsheet, Word, conversion, and presentation operations including PPT creation, Markdown-to-slides, and HTML export.
Claude Office Skills.zh: 实用的办公 Skill 套件加上 Office MCP 服务器，用于 PDF、电子表格、Word、转换和演示操作，包括 PPT 创建、Markdown 到幻灯片和 HTML 导出。

guizang-ppt-skill.source: Codex and Claude Code skill for polished single-file HTML slide decks, deck illustrations, social covers, and WebGL or low-power presentation runtimes using editorial-magazine and Swiss visual systems.
guizang-ppt-skill.zh: Codex 和 Claude Code Skill 用于精美的单文件 HTML 幻灯片、幻灯片插图、社交封面和 WebGL 或使用编辑杂志和瑞士视觉系统的低功耗演示运行时。

gpt-image2-ppt-skills.source: Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes skill that uses OpenAI gpt-image-2 to generate image-first PPTX decks, clone reference PPTX layouts, apply bundled styles, and retouch pages through image-to-image edits.
gpt-image2-ppt-skills.zh: Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 和 Hermes Skill 使用 OpenAI gpt-image-2 生成图像优先的 PPTX 套牌、克隆参考 PPTX 布局、应用捆绑样式并通过以下方式修饰页面图像到图像的编辑。

ppt-image-first.source: Conversation-first, image-first PPT workflow skill for Codex, Claude Code, and Opencode CLI that turns vague deck needs into content bases, style previews, locked plans, and image-backed PPTX delivery.
ppt-image-first.zh: 对话优先、图像优先的 PPT 工作流程 Skill，适用于 Codex、Claude Code 和 Opencode CLI，将模糊的演示文稿需求转化为内容库、样式预览、锁定计划和图像支持的 PPTX 交付。

Skywork-Skills.source: Skywork Agent Skills suite for AI office workflows including AI PPT, AI Document, AI Excel, AI Image, AI Search or DeepResearch, and AI Music, usable by Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenClaw.

slide-deck-generator.source: Coding-agent skill that builds production-ready browser-based presentation decks with React, Vite, and Framer Motion from scripts, outlines, or presentation briefs.
slide-deck-generator.zh: Coding-Agent Skill 使用 React、Vite 和 Framer Motion 从脚本、大纲或演示摘要构建可用于生产的基于浏览器的演示文稿。

codex-claude-academic-skills.source: Chinese academic skill suite whose office-academic skill produces paper-reading reports and academic PPT or Word documents, while companion skills cover research writing, peer-review responses, scientific computing, and publication-grade charts.
codex-claude-academic-skills.zh: 中国学术 Skill 套件的办公室学术 Skill 生成论文阅读报告和学术 PPT 或 Word 文档，而配套的 Skill 涵盖研究写作、同行评审回复、科学计算和出版级图表。

GitDiagram.source: Interactive diagrams for public GitHub repositories.
GitDiagram.zh: 公共 GitHub 存储库的交互图。

CodeBoarding.source: Static analysis plus LLM reasoning for architecture diagrams and component documentation.
CodeBoarding.zh: 结合静态分析与大语言模型推理，生成架构图和组件文档。

Understand-Anything.source: Interactive knowledge graphs for code and business knowledge, compatible with multiple coding agents.
Understand-Anything.zh: 代码与业务知识的互动知识图谱，兼容多种编码Agent。

PocketFlow-Tutorial-Codebase-Knowledge.source: Codebase-to-tutorial agent workflow, adjacent to visual explainers.

oh-my-mermaid.source: Claude Code oriented codebase-to-Mermaid architecture diagrams.

CodeAtlas.zh: GitHub 存储库的交互式依赖关系图。

codemap-skill.source: Claude Code/Codex skill for module maps and technical debt scoring.

drawing-skills.source: Claude Code diagram skill pair that renders and visually checks Mermaid drafts, then converts them into polished AWS, GCP, or Azure cloud-icon architecture diagrams with SVG, PNG, and editable draw.io outputs.

Pretty-mermaid-skills.source: Mermaid rendering capability for agents with SVG and ASCII outputs.
Pretty-mermaid-skills.zh: Mermaid 具有 SVG 和 ASCII 输出的 Agent 渲染功能。

agent-toolkit.source: Skill collection with Mermaid diagram patterns.

LLMermaid.source: Prototype around Mermaid diagrams and LLM control.
LLMermaid.zh: 围绕 Mermaid 图和 LLM 控件进行原型设计。

GenAIScript.source: Scriptable LLM workflow framework that ingests PDFs, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, files, and code, then generates structured files including Mermaid diagrams with repair loops.
GenAIScript.zh: 可编写脚本的 LLM 工作流程框架，可摄取 PDFs、DOCX、CSV、XLSX、文件和代码，然后生成结构化文件，包括带有修复循环的 Mermaid 图表。

mcp-mermaid.source: MCP server that validates Mermaid syntax and exports diagrams as Mermaid text, SVG, PNG, files, base64, or shareable URLs.
mcp-mermaid.zh: MCP 服务器，用于验证 Mermaid 语法并将图表导出为 Mermaid 文本、SVG、PNG、文件、base64 或可共享的 URLs。

mermaider.source: MCP server that gives LLMs a reusable browser-backed validate_syntax tool for checking Mermaid diagrams before committing or exporting them.
mermaider.zh: MCP 服务器为 LLMs 提供可重用的浏览器支持的 validate_syntax 工具，用于在提交或导出 Mermaid 图之前检查它们。

Mermaid Live MCP Server.source: MCP server for AI assistants to create Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, Gantt charts, and network diagrams, then return Mermaid Live URLs or save PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and PDF outputs.
Mermaid Live MCP Server.zh: MCP服务器，用于AI助手创建Mermaid流程图、时序图、类图、甘特图和网络图，然后返回Mermaid Live URLs或保存PNG、JPEG、WebP、 SVG 和 PDF 输出。

Mermaid PowerPoint Add-in.source: PowerPoint add-in for writing, previewing, inserting, and re-editing Mermaid diagrams directly inside slide decks, with persistent source storage in the presentation and high-quality PNG insertion.
Mermaid PowerPoint Add-in.zh: PowerPoint 插件，用于直接在幻灯片中编写、预览、插入和重新编辑 Mermaid 图表，在演示文稿中提供持久源存储和高质量的 PNG 插入。

gemini-diagram-mcp.source: MCP server that uses Gemini image generation on Vertex AI to create diagrams, charts, and visualizations from natural language, with smart diagram-type detection, prompt preparation, iterative refinement, and generated-image validation.
gemini-diagram-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器使用 Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 图像生成来从自然语言创建图表、图表和可视化，并具有智能图表类型检测、提示准备、迭代细化和生成图像验证。

diagrams-mcp.source: MCP server for generating cloud architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and UML-style visuals through hosted or local Graphviz, Mermaid, and PlantUML rendering engines.
diagrams-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器，用于通过托管或本地 Graphviz、Mermaid 和 PlantUML 渲染引擎生成云架构图、流程图、序列图和 UML-style 视觉效果。

drawio-skill.source: Agent skill that turns natural-language, Mermaid, codebases, IaC, SQL DDL, JSON sequence specs, and style references into editable draw.io XML plus PNG, SVG, PDF, or JPG exports with presets, official shape search, Graphviz layout, and visual self-check loops.
drawio-skill.zh: Agent Skill 将自然语言、Mermaid、代码库、IaC、SQL DDL、JSON 序列规范和样式参考转换为可编辑的draw.io XML plus PNG、SVG、PDF 或 JPG 导出时带有预设、官方形状搜索、Graphviz 布局和视觉自检循环。

Draw.io MCP Plugin.source: MCP wrapper and skill/plugin layer over the upstream draw.io MCP server, adding 13 builder tools, validation, topology correction, domain validators, codebase-to-diagram generation, and fully editable native draw.io XML output.
Draw.io MCP Plugin.zh: MCP 包装器和 Skill/插件层位于上游 draw.io MCP 服务器上，添加了 13 个构建器工具、验证、拓扑校正、域验证器、代码库到图表生成以及完全可编辑的本机 draw.io XML 输出。

Network Sketcher.source: Cisco-open AI-native network design and diagramming tool with Local MCP, online, and offline editions for generating L1/L2/L3 topology diagrams, PowerPoint diagrams, HTML device tables, and AI context files from structured or inventory-derived network data.
Network Sketcher.zh: 思科开放式 AI-native 网络设计和绘图工具，具有本地 MCP、在线和离线版本，用于从结构化或库存派生的网络数据生成 L1/L2/L3 拓扑图、PowerPoint 图、HTML 设备表和 AI 上下文文件。

diagramzu-mcp.source: MCP server for diagramzu.ai that lets AI clients list, create, update, analyze, version, and share Mermaid diagrams stored in a team Space through hosted HTTP or local stdio transport.
diagramzu-mcp.zh: 用于diagramzu.ai的MCP服务器，允许AI客户端通过托管HTTP或本地stdio传输列出、创建、更新、分析、版本和共享存储在团队空间中的Mermaid图表。

Claude Mermaid.source: MCP server and Claude Code plugin for live-reloading Mermaid previews, interactive browser review, SVG/PNG/PDF export, themes, and bundled diagram-authoring skill guidance.
Claude Mermaid.zh: MCP 服务器和 Claude Code 插件，用于实时重新加载 Mermaid 预览、交互式浏览器审查、SVG/PNG/PDF 导出、主题和捆绑图表创作 Skill 指南。

Sailor.source: Web interface and FastMCP server for natural-language Mermaid generation, live preview, validation, themes, hand-drawn styling, inline PNG returns, and Docker or remote HTTP/SSE deployment.
Sailor.zh: Web 界面和 FastMCP 服务器，用于自然语言 Mermaid 生成、实时预览、验证、主题、手绘样式、内联 PNG 返回以及 Docker 或远程 HTTP/SSE 部署。

Mermaid MCP App.source: MCP App for rendering Mermaid diagrams in Claude Desktop, VS Code, and MCP-App hosts with pan/zoom, split-view source editing, live re-render, copyable SVG, context sync back to the LLM, and 13 supported Mermaid diagram types including mind maps and timelines.
Mermaid MCP App.zh: MCP 应用程序，用于在 Claude 桌面、VS 代码和 MCP-App 主机中渲染 Mermaid 图表，具有平移/缩放、分割视图源编辑、实时重新渲染、可复制 SVG、上下文同步回 LLM 以及13 种受支持的 Mermaid 图表类型，包括思维导图和时间线。

mermaid-diagram-claude-code.source: Claude Code integration that uses Mermaid MCP coordination, automatic triggers, code-analysis context, and cross-session persistence to generate flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, state diagrams, Markdown Mermaid blocks, and zoomable HTML previews.
mermaid-diagram-claude-code.zh: Claude Code 集成，使用 Mermaid MCP 协调、自动触发器、代码分析上下文和跨会话持久性来生成流程图、序列图、架构图、状态图、Markdown Mermaid 块和可缩放的 HTML 预览。

mermaid-mcp-server.source: MCP server that converts Mermaid diagram code into PNG or SVG files with configurable theme, background color, and output format for multiple MCP clients.
mermaid-mcp-server.zh: MCP 服务器将 Mermaid 图代码转换为 PNG 或 SVG 文件，并为多个 MCP 客户端配置主题、背景颜色和输出格式。

mcp-media-forge.source: MCP server that renders Mermaid, D2, Graphviz, Vega-Lite, self-contained HTML pages, and HTML slide decks into embeddable assets for technical docs.
mcp-media-forge.zh: MCP 服务器，将 Mermaid、D2、Graphviz、Vega-Lite、独立的 HTML 页面和 HTML 幻灯片呈现为技术文档的可嵌入资产。

BriefPress.source: CLI and Agent Skill for deterministic Playwright/Chromium capture of local HTML into high-DPI PNG visual briefs, dashboards, reports, and infographics, with a safe mode for disabling JavaScript and network requests.
BriefPress.zh: CLI 和 Agent Skill 用于确定性 Playwright/Chromium 将本地 HTML 捕获为高级 DPI PNG 视觉简报、仪表盘、报告和信息图，并具有安全的功能用于禁用 JavaScript 和网络请求的模式。

MCP Chart Server.source: TypeScript MCP server and hosted HTTP/SSE endpoint for generating validated Chart.js-style business, statistical, financial, gauge, sparkline, and Sankey charts from structured data.
MCP Chart Server.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器和托管 HTTP/SSE 端点，用于从结构化数据生成经过验证的 Chart.js 样式业务、统计、财务、仪表、迷你图和 Sankey 图表。

UML-MCP.source: MCP server for natural-language or direct PlantUML, Mermaid, and Kroki diagram generation with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, and HTTP deployment examples.

Kroki-MCP.zh: 使用 MCP 服务器，通过本地或远程 Kroki 后端将文本图表定义（例如 PlantUML 和 Mermaid）转换为 PNG、SVG、PDF 和其他图像。

mcp_excalidraw.source: MCP server and Claude Code skill for Excalidraw that lets agents create, edit, export, and live-sync hand-drawn diagrams through a local canvas bridge.

AntV Infographic.zh: AI-friendly 声明性信息图生成和渲染框架，具有模板、流式渲染、可编辑输出、SVG 导出和 Agent Skill 集成。

AgentFigureGallery.source: Scientific plotting reference gallery and agent skill that lets agents query public figure examples, collect human selections, and export reference bundles before writing plotting code.
AgentFigureGallery.zh: 科学绘图参考库和 Agent Skill，允许 Agent 在编写绘图代码之前查询公众人物示例、收集人类选择并导出参考包。

amCharts 5 MCP Server.zh: 托管或本地 MCP 服务器，使 AI 助理能够按需访问 amCharts 5 文档、数百个代码示例以及用于构建图表和仪表盘产物的 API 类参考。

next-ai-draw-io.source: Next.js draw.io-style application for creating, modifying, and enhancing diagrams through natural-language AI commands.

FigJam AI.zh: AI-generated 板和 FigJam 中的图表。

System Design Visualizer.source: Upload static system-design images or architecture diagrams, have an OpenAI vision model convert them into editable Mermaid, then explore the result as an interactive React Flow graph with component deep dives.
System Design Visualizer.zh: 上传静态系统设计图像或架构图，让 OpenAI 视觉模型将其转换为可编辑的 Mermaid，然后以交互式 React 流程图的形式探索结果，并深入了解组件。

Strategy Consulting Visualization Skill.source: Agent skill that turns messy notes, metrics, prose, and process descriptions into executive-ready board slides, reports, proposals, technical diagrams, and infographics with a local SVG renderer and validation loop.

tufte-data-viz.source: Opinionated Agent Skill that applies Edward Tufte data-visualization principles to Recharts, ECharts, Chart.js, matplotlib, Plotly, D3, SVG, and HTML charts, with before/after demos and reusable rule files.

Knossos MCP.zh: 本地优先 MCP 和 CLI，将 PHP、TypeScript/JavaScript 和 Python 存储库扫描到有证据支持的架构图中，然后导出 Mermaid 或 PlantUML 图以及影响、流程、边界、运行状况和变化分析报告。

NodeSecure Report.source: NodeSecure report generator that scans Git and npm targets, visualizes security threats and quality issues over time, and emits periodic HTML and PDF reports from NodeSecure scanner data.
NodeSecure Report.zh: NodeSecure 报告生成器可扫描 Git 和 npm 目标，可视化随时间变化的安全威胁和质量问题，并根据 NodeSecure 扫描仪数据定期发出 HTML 和 PDF 报告。

media-gen-mcp.source: All-in-one Claude Code image MCP for local and API-backed image/video generation, OCR, chart and table recognition, architecture diagrams, data charts, cards, QR codes, formulas, SVG/PNG rendering, and HTML/CSS animation capture.
media-gen-mcp.zh: 一体化 Claude Code 图像 MCP，用于本地和 API-backed 图像/视频生成、OCR、图表和表格识别、架构图、数据图表、卡片、QR 代码、公式、SVG/PNG 渲染和 HTML/CSS 动画捕获。

excalidraw-skill-pack.source: Agent-agnostic Excalidraw methodology, themes, renderers, installers, and MCP server for turning prompt-driven diagrams into argument-quality editable figures with book-grade examples and themed exports.
excalidraw-skill-pack.zh: Agent 无关的 Excalidraw 方法、主题、渲染器、安装程序和 MCP 服务器，用于将提示驱动的图表转换为具有书籍级示例和主题导出的论证质量可编辑图形。

Capci MCP.source: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server that turns plain-text prompts into publish-ready architecture, flowchart, sequence, ER, class, mind map, Gantt, chart, logo, post, and animated GIF diagram artifacts with brand-aware refinement.
Capci MCP.zh: 托管 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务器，可将纯文本提示转换为可发布的架构、流程图、序列、ER、类、思维导图、甘特图、图表、徽标、帖子和动画 GIF 图表产物，并具有品牌意识的细化。

zifeiyu-ppt-skill.source: Agent Skill for design-locked HTML slide decks with registered layouts, deterministic editable PPTX export, PDF and PNG delivery, speaker mode, and Playwright quality gates.
zifeiyu-ppt-skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于设计锁定的 HTML 幻灯片，具有注册布局、确定性可编辑 PPTX 导出、PDF 和 PNG 交付、扬声器模式和 Playwright 质量门。

slides-from-video.source: Claude Code skill and CLI that extracts slide regions from lecture or conference videos, de-duplicates pages with OCR and perceptual hashes, and emits a clean PDF deck.
slides-from-video.zh: Claude Code Skill 和 CLI 从讲座或会议视频中提取幻灯片区域，使用 OCR 和感知哈希去重复页面，并发出干净的 PDF 幻灯片。

claude-code-deck-skill.source: Claude Code skill and python-pptx toolkit that turns DOCX, PDF, Markdown, or pasted text into executive-grade native editable PowerPoint decks with visual QA.
claude-code-deck-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 和 python-pptx 工具包，可将 DOCX、PDF、Markdown 或粘贴文本转换为带有可视化 QA 的执行级本机可编辑 PowerPoint 幻灯片。

getihu-p2h2p.source: Claude Code orchestration skill that rebuilds existing PPT files, rough topics, whiteboard photos, or screenshots through a PPT to HTML to PPT pipeline, coordinating template generation, editable HTML previews, PPTX conversion, and visual QA checkpoints.
getihu-p2h2p.zh: Claude Code编排Skill，通过PPT到HTML到PPT管道重建现有的PPT文件、粗略主题、白板照片或屏幕截图，协调模板生成，可编辑HTML预览， PPTX 转换，以及可视化 QA 检查点。

Talksmith.source: Claude Code presenter workflow that turns articles, papers, chat transcripts, screenshots, and notes into durable cited subject repositories, thesis-first Markdown outlines, self-contained Reveal.js decks, and optional PowerPoint exports.
Talksmith.zh: Claude Code 演示者工作流程，可将文章、论文、聊天记录、屏幕截图和注释转换为持久引用的主题存储库、论文优先的 Markdown 大纲、独立的 Reveal.js 平台和可选的 PowerPoint 导出。

skill_doc2ppt.source: Windows document-to-slide utility and skill package that converts Word documents or Markdown into simple Claude-style HTML slides or editable PowerPoint decks.
skill_doc2ppt.zh: Windows 文档到幻灯片实用程序和 Skill 软件包，可将 Word 文档或 Markdown 转换为简单的 Claude 样式的 HTML 幻灯片或可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片。

ppt-agent-skill.source: Claude Code skill for one-prompt presentation generation with 26 visual styles, 18 chart patterns, HTML-first rendering, editable PPTX export, and benchmark-inspired visual references.
ppt-agent-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于一次性生成演示文稿，具有 26 种视觉样式、18 种图表模式、HTML-first 渲染、可编辑 PPTX 导出以及基准启发的视觉参考。

slide-creator.source: Claude Code and OpenClaw skill that renders zero-dependency HTML presentations from a structured BRIEF.json workflow, style gallery, strict validation, presenter controls, PDF export, and inline editing.
slide-creator.zh: Claude Code 和 OpenClaw Skill 从结构化 BRIEF.json 工作流程、样式库、严格验证、演示者控件、PDF 导出和内联编辑呈现零依赖性 HTML 演示文稿。

animated-diagram.source: Claude Code skill and template that turns static infographic ideas into animated, interactive 16:9 HTML diagram pages with presenter-stepped beats for talks, clips, and explainers.
animated-diagram.zh: Claude Code Skill 和模板，可将静态信息图创意转化为动画、交互式 16:9 HTML 图表页面，并带有演讲者步进节拍，用于演讲、剪辑和解释。

deckproof-mcp.source: Local MCP server that creates, validates, audits, and repairs PowerPoint files against OOXML/ECMA-376 while preserving existing corporate templates, masters, layouts, and themes.
deckproof-mcp.zh: 本地 MCP 服务器，用于根据 OOXML/ECMA-376 创建、验证、审核和修复 PowerPoint 文件，同时保留现有的公司模板、母版、布局和主题。

Muse.source: Agent skill that turns dense agent output into browser-native pages for architecture diagrams, visual plans, diff reviews, project recaps, slide decks, and approval-aware MDX reviews.
Muse.zh: Agent Skill 将密集的 Agent 输出转换为浏览器本机页面，用于架构图、视觉计划、差异审查、项目回顾、幻灯片和批准感知的 MDX 审查。

vibe-diagram.source: Host-neutral agent skill and Codex plugin source for producing polished self-contained HTML diagrams from prompts with offline checks, reusable templates, and generated client packages.
vibe-diagram.zh: 主机中立的 Agent Skill 和 Codex 插件源，用于根据带有离线检查、可重用模板和生成的客户端包的提示生成精美的独立 HTML 图表。

tech-diagram.source: Agent Skill that converts JSON grid specs into validated draw.io diagrams for AWS, Azure, GCP architectures, ER models, UML classes, and flowcharts using pure Python.
tech-diagram.zh: Agent Skill，使用纯 Python 将 JSON 网格规格转换为经过验证的 draw.io 图表，适用于 AWS、Azure、GCP 架构、ER 模型、UML 类和流程图。

HTML Express.source: Zhijian Agent Skill for turning dense research, comparisons, checklists, timelines, dashboards, decision pages, and visual summaries into self-contained local HTML reports.
HTML Express.zh: 之建 Agent Skill，用于将密集的研究、比较、清单、时间表、仪表盘、决策页面和视觉摘要转换为独立的本地 HTML 报告。

remotion-motion-graphics-skill.source: Agent Skills for producing Remotion motion-graphics clips from scripts or product ideas, including kinetic text, AI workflow diagrams, UI mockups, camera moves, QA, and editor-ready renders.
remotion-motion-graphics-skill.zh: Agent Skills 用于根据脚本或产品创意生成 Remotion 运动图形剪辑，包括动态文本、AI 工作流程图、UI 模型、相机移动、QA 和编辑器就绪渲染。

Data Formulator.source: AI-assisted rich data visualization and exploration.
Data Formulator.zh: AI-assisted丰富的数据可视化和探索。

LIDA.source: LLM-based automatic generation of visualizations and infographics.
LIDA.zh: LLM-based 自动生成可视化和信息图。

tufte-claude-skill.source: Claude Code skill that turns chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile, table, sparkline, small-multiple, time-series, distribution, choropleth, and infographic requests into Tufte-style quantitative visuals with statistical-honesty and layout rules.
tufte-claude-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 将图表、图形、仪表盘、KPI 磁贴、表格、迷你图、小倍数、时间序列、分布、等值线和信息图请求转换为具有统计诚实和布局规则的 Tufte 风格的定量视觉效果。

WrenAI.source: Open context layer for agents over business data, adding semantic context, governed SQL, and agentic GenBI/dashboard workflows across many data sources.
WrenAI.zh: 面向业务数据的开放上下文层，为 Agent 提供语义上下文、受治理的 SQL，以及跨多种数据源的 GenBI 和仪表盘工作流。

Vanna.source: Agentic retrieval text-to-SQL system that turns natural-language database questions into SQL, interactive tables, Plotly charts, and natural-language summaries.
Vanna.zh: 代理检索文本到 SQL 系统，将自然语言数据库问题转换为 SQL、交互式表格、Plotly 图表和自然语言摘要。

VMind.source: VisActor LLM chart component for natural-language chart generation, editing, data insight, and chart narrative creation.
VMind.zh: VisActor LLM 图表组件，用于自然语言图表生成、编辑、数据洞察和图表叙述创建。

chart-visualization-skills.source: AntV skill collection for agent-generated charts, infographics, narrative data reports, icons, S2 tables, G2 charts, and G6 graph visualizations.
chart-visualization-skills.zh: AntV Skill 集合，用于 Agent 生成的图表、信息图、叙述性数据报告、图标、S2 表格、G2 图表和 G6 图形可视化。

Pyecharts Skills.source: Agent Skill collection for generating pyecharts visualization examples across 49 chart types, including standard, composite, 3D, and ECharts 6 chart families for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and MCP-compatible workflows.
Pyecharts Skills.zh: Agent Skill 集合，用于生成 49 种图表类型的 pyecharts 可视化示例，包括标准、复合、3D 和 ECharts 6 个图表系列，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 和MCP-compatible 工作流程。

Semiotic.source: React data-visualization library with AI-facing schemas, an MCP server, validation tooling, and components for charts, networks, streaming data, and dashboards.
Semiotic.zh: React 数据可视化库，具有 AI-facing 模式、MCP 服务器、验证工具以及图表、网络、流数据和仪表盘的组件。

mcp-server-chart.source: AntV MCP server with 26+ chart, graph, map, mind-map, flow, spreadsheet, and infographic tools for agent-driven chart generation and data analysis.
mcp-server-chart.zh: AntV MCP 服务器具有 26 种以上图表、图表、地图、思维导图、流程、电子表格和信息图工具，用于 Agent 驱动的图表生成和数据分析。

mcp-dashboards.source: MCP Apps-compatible server that renders interactive in-chat charts, dashboards, KPI widgets, live-polling views, and PNG/PPT/A4 exports from plain-language data requests.
mcp-dashboards.zh: MCP 应用程序兼容服务器，可呈现交互式聊天图表、仪表盘、KPI 小部件、实时轮询视图以及从纯语言数据请求导出的 PNG/PPT/A4。

Luminon MCP Dashboard.source: AI-first MCP dashboard builder that lets agents upload CSV/JSON, use natural-language dashboard actions, auto-layout bar/line/donut/scatter/KPI views, apply themes and filters, preview with a React renderer, serve static demo dashboards, and run stdio MCP or local web modes through the packaged CLI.
Luminon MCP Dashboard.zh: AI-first MCP 仪表盘构建器，允许 Agent 上传 CSV/JSON、使用自然语言仪表盘操作、自动布局栏/线/甜甜圈/散点/KPI 视图、应用主题和过滤器、使用 React 渲染器进行预览、提供静态演示仪表盘并运行 stdio MCP 或通过打包的 CLI 进行本地 Web 模式。

DashGen.source: Next.js AI dashboard generator that accepts CSV, JSON, or Excel uploads plus a natural-language dashboard brief, then produces interactive React dashboards with charts, KPI cards, live code preview, export, and deployment paths.
DashGen.zh: Next.js AI 仪表盘生成器，接受 CSV、JSON 或 Excel 上传以及自然语言仪表盘简介，然后生成带有图表、KPI 卡、实时代码预览、导出和部署路径的交互式 React 仪表盘。

AI Dashboard Generator.source: Open-source Next.js and GPT-powered dashboard generator that ingests existing CSV tables or datasets, infers visualization intent, and creates simple business data visualizations from the uploaded data.
AI Dashboard Generator.zh: 开源 Next.js 和 GPT-powered 仪表盘生成器，可摄取现有的 CSV 表或数据集，推断可视化意图，并根据上传的数据创建简单的业务数据可视化。

mcp-grafana.source: Official Grafana MCP server for agent access to dashboards, datasources, panel queries, annotations, snapshots, deeplinks, and PNG rendering of panels or dashboards.
mcp-grafana.zh: 官方 Grafana MCP 服务器，用于 Agent 访问仪表盘、数据源、面板查询、注释、快照、深度链接以及面板或仪表盘的 PNG 渲染。

Metabase Dashboard Skill.source: Claude Code skill for building Metabase dashboards end-to-end, including schema exploration, dashboard layout design, SQL-backed chart/KPI cards, and filter wiring through the Metabase MCP server.
Metabase Dashboard Skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于端到端构建 Metabase 仪表盘，包括模式探索、仪表盘布局设计、SQL-backed 图表/KPI 卡以及通过 Metabase MCP 服务器的过滤器接线。

Claude Data Analysis Assistant.source: Claude Code data-analysis assistant with sub-agents and slash commands for exploratory analysis, visualization, code generation, quality checks, hypotheses, and Markdown/HTML/PDF reports.
Claude Data Analysis Assistant.zh: Claude Code 数据分析助手，带有子 Agent 和斜线命令，用于探索性分析、可视化、代码生成、质量检查、假设和 Markdown/HTML/PDF 报告。

Data Analytics Skills for Claude.source: Portable Claude skill library for analytics workflows, including visualization-builder, dashboard-specification, insight synthesis, executive summaries, and data narratives that turn raw findings into charts, dashboard specs, and stakeholder-ready reports.
Data Analytics Skills for Claude.zh: 用于分析工作流程的便携式 Claude Skill 库，包括可视化生成器、仪表盘规范、洞察综合、执行摘要和数据叙述，可将原始发现转化为图表、仪表盘规格和利益相关者就绪报告。

wshm.source: Self-hosted repository operations agent that turns GitHub/GitLab/Gitea/Azure DevOps issues, PRs, and repo activity into an embedded dashboard, AI changelogs, and Markdown/HTML/PDF health reports with optional local models.
wshm.zh: 自托管存储库操作 Agent，将 GitHub/GitLab/Gitea/Azure DevOps 问题、PRs 和存储库活动转换为嵌入式仪表盘、AI 更改日志和Markdown/HTML/PDF 健康报告，可选本地型号。

MatPlotAgent.source: LLM agent framework for scientific data visualization.
MatPlotAgent.zh: LLM Agent 科学数据可视化框架。

OpenVizAI.source: Prompt to chart recommendation and rendering.
OpenVizAI.zh: 根据提示推荐并渲染图表。

generative-dashboard-builder.zh: 提示生成的图表、KPIs 和仪表盘。

DataPulse Studio.source: Privacy-first browser analytics app that turns CSV or Parquet uploads plus plain-English questions into DuckDB-Wasm SQL, Recharts dashboards, cross-filtered interactive visuals, SQL inspection, auto-fix loops, and full-screen presentation mode.
DataPulse Studio.zh: 隐私优先的浏览器分析应用程序，可将 CSV 或 Parquet 上传加上简单的英语问题转换为 DuckDB-Wasm SQL、Recharts 仪表盘、交叉过滤的交互式视觉效果、SQL 检查、自动修复循环和全屏演示模式。

OpenBI.source: AI-native BI with chat, dashboards, and reports.
OpenBI.zh: AI-native BI 带有聊天、仪表盘和报告。

powerbi-pbix-mcp.source: Windows-local Power BI MCP server that lets AI agents author complete PBIX/PBIP artifacts across semantic models, DAX, Power Query M, report pages, visuals, screenshots, validation, RLS tests, and closed-file template edits with hundreds of deterministic tools.
powerbi-pbix-mcp.zh: Windows 本地 Power BI MCP 服务器，允许 AI Agent 跨语义模型、DAX、Power Query M、报告页面、视觉效果、屏幕截图、验证、RLS 测试和封闭文件模板创作完整的 PBIX/PBIP 产物使用数百种确定性工具进行编辑。

MCP Visuals Server.source: MCP server that lets AI agents display interactive tables, Recharts charts, image previews with metadata, master-detail views, hierarchical trees, custom lists, and exportable table/chart payloads inside the host application.
MCP Visuals Server.zh: MCP 服务器，允许 AI Agent 在主机应用程序内显示交互式表格、Recharts 图表、带元数据的图像预览、主从视图、分层树、自定义列表以及可导出的表格/图表有效负载。

viz-mcp.source: Data visualization MCP server that auto-detects chart types from dict/list/nested data, generates Plotly HTML or Matplotlib PNG charts, builds multi-chart dashboards, and stores chart history.
viz-mcp.zh: 数据可视化 MCP 服务器，自动从 dict/list/nested 数据中检测图表类型，生成 Plotly HTML 或 Matplotlib PNG 图表，构建多图表仪表盘并存储图表历史记录。

data-visualization-mcp-server.source: FastMCP server that lets an AI client upload CSV data, inspect columns and distributions, transform datasets, define plots, and retrieve static PNG or interactive HTML visualizations with persisted SQLite/CSV state.
data-visualization-mcp-server.zh: FastMCP 服务器允许 AI 客户端上传 CSV 数据、检查列和分布、转换数据集、定义绘图以及检索具有持久 SQLite/CSV 状态的静态 PNG 或交互式 HTML 可视化。

MCP Reportes.source: Python MCP server for marketing-agency reporting that fetches GA4, Google Ads, and Meta Ads data into an in-memory session, then builds a polished client-ready Excel workbook with an executive summary, per-platform detail sheets, branded headers, banded rows, auto-fit columns, and default 30-day reporting windows.
MCP Reportes.zh: 用于营销机构报告的 Python MCP 服务器，将 GA4、Google Ads 和元广告数据提取到内存会话中，然后构建一个精美的客户端就绪 Excel 工作簿，其中包含执行摘要、每个平台的详细信息表、品牌标题、带状行、自动调整列和默认的 30 天报告窗口。

Egile MCP Reporter.source: FastMCP report-generation server that converts markdown or structured JSON/DataFrame sections into PDF, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, standalone Plotly/Matplotlib charts, combined reports, and prebuilt investment or business report templates.
Egile MCP Reporter.zh: FastMCP 报告生成服务器，可将 markdown 或结构化 JSON/DataFrame 部分转换为 PDF、PPTX、HTML、Markdown、独立 Plotly/Matplotlib 图表、组合报告以及预构建的投资或业务报告模板。

DataViz.source: Go charting and data-visualization library with an MCP server, CLI, SVG and terminal outputs, line/bar/scatter/heatmap/pie/stat-card components, and agent-friendly generic data types.
DataViz.zh: 使用 MCP 服务器、CLI、SVG 和终端输出、折线/条形图/散点图/热图/饼图/统计卡组件以及 Agent 友好的通用数据类型来绘制图表和数据可视化库。

QuickChart MCP Server.source: TypeScript MCP server for generating chart images through QuickChart.io, letting agents create bar, line, pie, radar, scatter, and other charts from structured data.
QuickChart MCP Server.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器，用于通过 QuickChart.io 生成图表图像，让 Agent 从结构化数据创建条形图、折线图、饼图、雷达图、散点图和其他图表。

Elastic MCP Dashbuilder.source: Elastic MCP App that lets AI assistants explore Elasticsearch with ES|QL, create Elastic Charts, preview an interactive dashboard inline in chat, and export the result to Kibana Lens dashboards.
Elastic MCP Dashbuilder.zh: Elastic MCP 应用程序可让 AI 助手使用 ES|QL 探索 Elasticsearch、创建 Elastic 图表、在聊天中预览交互式仪表盘，并将结果导出到 Kibana Lens 仪表盘。

Chart Canvas.source: MCP server and browser dashboard for AI-created charts, diagrams, and tables, using DuckDB-backed local queries over SQLite, CSV, Parquet, JSON, and NDJSON while keeping source data local.
Chart Canvas.zh: 用于 AI-created 图表、图表和表格的 MCP 服务器和浏览器仪表盘，通过 SQLite、CSV、Parquet、JSON 和 NDJSON 使用 DuckDB 支持的本地查询，同时将源数据保持在本地。

Panel Live Server.source: Local Panel web server and MCP server that executes Python snippets, validates them, renders live interactive visualization pages, stores permanent URLs, and exposes a screenshot tool for visual inspection.
Panel Live Server.zh: 本地面板 Web 服务器和 MCP 服务器，用于执行 Python 代码片段、验证它们、呈现实时交互式可视化页面、存储永久 URLs 并公开用于目视检查的屏幕截图工具。

HoloViz MCP.source: HoloViz ecosystem MCP server and standalone skill collection that gives AI assistants searchable docs, component intelligence, a display server, and guidance for building Panel, hvPlot, Lumen, HoloViews, and Datashader dashboards.
HoloViz MCP.zh: HoloViz 生态系统 MCP 服务器和独立的 Skill 集合为 AI 助手提供可搜索文档、组件智能、显示服务器以及构建 Panel、hvPlot、Lumen、HoloViews 和 Datashader 仪表盘的指南。

Data-Analysis-Agent.source: Conversational business data analysis agent that connects to Excel, CSV, or databases, discovers schemas, generates SQL, recommends charts, streams the analysis process, and produces interactive dashboards plus business insights.
Data-Analysis-Agent.zh: 对话式业务数据分析 Agent 连接到 Excel、CSV 或数据库，发现架构、生成 SQL、推荐图表、流式传输分析流程并生成交互式仪表盘和业务见解。

AI-Report-Generator.source: LangGraph-based multi-agent data analyst that profiles uploaded CSVs, plans visualizations, generates charts and insights, drafts structured analytical reports, and exports the final report as PDF through a Streamlit app.
AI-Report-Generator.zh: 基于 LangGraph 的多 Agent 数据分析师，对上传的 CSVs 进行配置文件、规划可视化、生成图表和见解、起草结构化分析报告，并通过 Streamlit 应用程序将最终报告导出为 PDF。

PedroReports.source: FastAPI and React report tool that uploads CSV datasets, runs Gemini-backed analysis, creates Matplotlib and Seaborn visualizations, performs statistical summaries, and generates polished PDF reports.
PedroReports.zh: FastAPI 和 React 报告工具，可上传 CSV 数据集、运行 Gemini 支持的分析、创建 Matplotlib 和 Seaborn 可视化、执行统计摘要并生成精美的 PDF 报告。

Amplitude MCP Server.source: Official Amplitude-hosted MCP server guide for conversational product analytics over charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments, feature flags, datasets, metrics, and session replays with OAuth-scoped permissions.
Amplitude MCP Server.zh: Amplitude 托管的官方 MCP 服务器指南，用于通过图表、仪表盘、笔记本、实验、功能标志、数据集、指标和会话重放进行对话式产品分析，并具有 OAuth 范围的权限。

many-ppt-skills.zh: 双语、数据支持的索引和路线指南比较了 HTML-native 和本机 PPTX 工作流程中的 26 个 AI 幻灯片 Skill，并提供可重复的计数和选择演示文稿生成方法的原则。

Power BI Skills for Claude Code.source: Claude Code skills for gathering Power BI requirements and building PBIR report pages, visuals, and IBCS variance charts directly in PBIP projects without hand-authoring JSON or DAX.
Power BI Skills for Claude Code.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于收集 Power BI 要求并直接在 PBIP 项目中构建 PBIR 报告页面、视觉效果和 IBCS 方差图表，而无需手动创作 JSON 或 DAX。

PPTX Generator MCP Server.source: Node-based MCP server that converts Markdown lessons, documentation, code blocks, tables, bullet lists, and branded content into professional PowerPoint presentations.
PPTX Generator MCP Server.zh: 基于节点的 MCP 服务器，可将 Markdown 课程、文档、代码块、表格、项目符号列表和品牌内容转换为专业的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

Draw.io MCP Server.source: MCP server and hosted Draw.io editor that lets AI agents create, inspect, update, import, and export diagrams, including Mermaid expansion, multi-page documents, stencils, XML, SVG, and PNG outputs.
Draw.io MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器和托管 Draw.io 编辑器，允许 AI Agent 创建、检查、更新、导入和导出图表，包括 Mermaid 扩展、多页文档、模板、XML、SVG 和 PNG输出。

Architecture Diagram Generator.source: Claude skill that turns system descriptions into standalone dark-themed HTML architecture diagrams with embedded SVG and built-in copy, PNG, and PDF export controls.
Architecture Diagram Generator.zh: Claude Skill 将系统描述转换为独立的黑暗主题 HTML 架构图，并带有嵌入式 SVG 和内置副本、PNG 和 PDF 导出控件。

FlowForge.source: Claude Code skill that turns natural-language briefs into editable draw.io XML diagrams with deterministic layouts for flowcharts, architecture diagrams, comparisons, timelines, trees, funnels, matrices, and sequence-style diagrams.
FlowForge.zh: Claude Code Skill 将自然语言摘要转换为可编辑的draw.io XML 图表，具有流程图、架构图、比较、时间线、树、漏斗、矩阵和序列式图表的确定性布局。

Dashmotion.source: Claude skill that converts plain English or Mermaid source into dependency-free animated technical diagrams as self-contained HTML/SVG files with streaming connector motion.
Dashmotion.zh: Claude Skill 将简单英语或 Mermaid 源转换为无依赖关系的动画技术图表，作为具有流连接器运动的独立 HTML/SVG 文件。

Carbone MCP Server.source: Official Carbone MCP server for generating templated reports and business documents from JSON data, converting Office/HTML/PDF formats, batch-producing PDFs, and managing reusable document templates.
Carbone MCP Server.zh: 官方 Carbone MCP 服务器，用于从 JSON 数据生成模板化报告和业务文档、转换 Office/HTML/PDF 格式、批量生成 PDFs 以及管理可重复使用的文档模板。

Sigrid Report Generator.source: Python report framework that pulls Sigrid API data into standard or custom Word and PowerPoint templates, generating IT due-diligence, objectives, modernization, maintainability, portfolio, hygiene, and custom report outputs as DOCX or PPTX.
Sigrid Report Generator.zh: Python 报告框架，将 Sigrid API 数据拉入标准或自定义 Word 和 PowerPoint 模板，生成 IT 尽职调查、目标、现代化、可维护性、投资组合、卫生和自定义报告输出为 DOCX 或 PPTX。

AIOffice.source: Local single-binary CLI and MCP engine for creating, querying, editing, rendering, previewing, validating, and converting real DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files without Microsoft Office.
AIOffice.zh: 本地单二进制 CLI 和 MCP 引擎，用于创建、查询、编辑、渲染、预览、验证和转换真实的 DOCX、XLSX 和 PPTX 文件，无需 Microsoft Office。

Architecture Discovery MCP.source: Local MCP server that statically scans Java/Maven projects and generates TOGAF application architecture inventories, Excel workbooks, and PPTX architecture and integration diagrams.
Architecture Discovery MCP.zh: 本地 MCP 服务器，静态扫描 Java/Maven 项目并生成 TOGAF 应用程序架构清单、Excel 工作簿以及 PPTX 架构和集成图。

DeepSeek-PPT-skill.source: AI-native PPTX skill built around a constraint-solving loop where LLMs declare slide intent, receive structured layout diagnostics, and iterate until the PowerPoint file passes visual correctness checks.
DeepSeek-PPT-skill.zh: AI-native PPTX Skill 围绕约束求解循环构建，其中 LLMs 声明幻灯片意图、接收结构化布局诊断并进行迭代，直到 PowerPoint 文件通过视觉正确性检查。

baoyu-design.source: Portable Agent Skill that runs a Claude Design-style workflow locally in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or other file-capable agents to produce polished HTML UI mockups, prototypes, dashboards, wireframes, landing pages, mobile apps, and slide decks.
baoyu-design.zh: 便携式 Agent Skill，在 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 或其他具有文件功能的 Agent 中本地运行 Claude 设计风格工作流程，以生成抛光的 HTML UI 模型、原型、仪表盘、线框、登陆页面、移动应用程序和幻灯片。

Open CoDesign.source: Local-first desktop app and Claude Design alternative that turns prompts into polished prototypes, slide decks, marketing assets, HTML pages, PDFs, PPTX files, ZIP packages, and Markdown using BYOK or imported Claude Code/Codex provider configs.
Open CoDesign.zh: 本地优先的桌面应用程序和 Claude 设计替代方案，可使用 BYOK 或导入将提示转换为精美的原型、幻灯片、营销资产、HTML 页面、PDFs、PPTX 文件、ZIP 包和 Markdown Claude Code/Codex 提供程序配置。

Azure Architecture Diagram Builder.source: AI-powered Azure architecture design app and MCP server that converts natural-language or imported architecture images into editable topology and whiteboard-style diagrams, cost estimates, WAF validation, deployment guides, and IaC outputs.
Azure Architecture Diagram Builder.zh: AI-powered Azure 架构设计应用程序和 MCP 服务器，可将自然语言或导入的架构图像转换为可编辑拓扑和白板式图表、成本估算、WAF 验证、部署指南和 IaC 输出。

Emboss.source: Pure-Python document engine that turns declarative specs, Markdown, or LLM-generated structured content into deterministic, accessible, print-ready PDFs with tables, charts, SVG, diagrams, embedded source data, document diffing, and optional MCP workflows.
Emboss.zh: 纯 Python 文档引擎，可将声明性规范、Markdown 或 LLM-generated 结构化内容转换为确定性、可访问、可打印的 PDFs，其中包含表格、图表、SVG、图表、嵌入式源数据、文档比较和可选的 MCP 工作流程。

StudyBros.source: MCP server and web app that ingests PDFs, PPTX, text, Markdown, video, and audio, then uses an attached LLM to generate flashcards, quizzes, practice tests, summaries, mastery tracking, Anki CSV, JSON, and Markdown exports.
StudyBros.zh: MCP 服务器和 Web 应用程序，摄取 PDFs、PPTX、文本、Markdown、视频和音频，然后使用附加的 LLM 生成抽认卡、测验、练习测试、摘要、掌握情况跟踪、Anki CSV、 JSON 和 Markdown 导出。

pdf-mcp.source: MCP server for surgical PDF access: semantic and keyword search, page-level reading, OCR, table/image extraction, chart-data extraction, page rendering, corpus search, SQLite caching, and hidden-text trust flags for agents handling large PDFs.
pdf-mcp.zh: 用于手术 PDF 访问的 MCP 服务器：语义和关键字搜索、页面级阅读、OCR、表格/图像提取、图表数据提取、页面渲染、语料库搜索、SQLite 缓存以及用于处理大型 PDFs 的 Agent 的隐藏文本信任标志。

data-analysis-skill.source: Claude Code skill for turning CSV or Excel files into publication-quality narrative HTML reports, interactive charts, expert-synthesized findings, structured profiles, and one-click PowerPoint decks.
data-analysis-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于将 CSV 或 Excel 文件转换为出版质量的叙述性 HTML 报告、交互式图表、专家综合结果、结构化配置文件和一键式 PowerPoint 平台。

Crewlyze.source: CrewAI and FastAPI data analyst platform that turns CSV, Excel, and SQLite datasets into multi-agent profiling, custom Matplotlib/Seaborn visualizations, executive PDF reports, read-only SQL workbenches, and optional Ollama-local analysis.
Crewlyze.zh: CrewAI 和 FastAPI 数据分析平台，可将 CSV、Excel 和 SQLite 数据集转换为多 Agent 分析、自定义 Matplotlib/Seaborn 可视化、执行 PDF 报告、只读 SQL 工作台以及可选的 Ollama-本地分析。

AI Data Analyst.source: Streamlit analytics suite that turns uploaded CSV datasets into data profiling, narrative insights, Plotly visual labs, AutoML results, a data assistant, and downloadable executive PDF summaries.
AI Data Analyst.zh: Streamlit 分析套件，可将上传的 CSV 数据集转换为数据分析、叙述见解、Plotly 视觉实验室、AutoML 结果、数据助手和可下载的执行 PDF 摘要。

CrushData AI.source: Cross-IDE data analyst skill and CLI with EDA, dashboard, cohort, funnel, KPI, and time-series workflows, local credential storage, searchable analysis patterns, and a React dashboard viewer for AI-generated chart JSON.
CrushData AI.zh: 跨 IDE 数据分析师 Skill 和 CLI，具有 EDA、仪表盘、群组、漏斗、KPI 和时间序列工作流程、本地凭证存储、可搜索分析模式以及用于 AI-generated 图表的 React 仪表盘查看器JSON。

Felo AI CLI and Skills.source: Felo CLI and Claude Code skill suite for real-time search, web fetch, YouTube subtitle ingestion, X search, style libraries, prompt/file-to-PPT generation, mind-map generation, landing pages, and API-backed research workflows.
Felo AI CLI and Skills.zh: Felo CLI 和 Claude Code Skill 套件，用于实时搜索、Web 获取、YouTube 字幕摄取、X 搜索、样式库、提示/文件到 PPT 生成、思维导图生成、登陆页面和 API-backed 研究工作流程。

Highcharts MCP Server.source: MCP server exposing Highcharts chart-generation tools with schema validation, natural-language chart creation, production deployment options, and export to PNG, SVG, PDF, or interactive HTML bundles.
Highcharts MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器公开 Highcharts 图表生成工具，具有架构验证、自然语言图表创建、生产部署选项以及导出到 PNG、SVG、PDF 或交互式 HTML 捆绑包。

Predictive Maintenance MCP.source: MCP server and Claude Code plugin that lets agents analyze vibration CSVs, classify bearing faults, estimate risk and remaining useful life, and generate professional diagnostic reports with charts and severity assessments.
Predictive Maintenance MCP.zh: MCP 服务器和 Claude Code 插件可让 Agent 分析振动 CSVs、对轴承故障进行分类、估计风险和剩余使用寿命，并生成带有图表和严重性评估的专业诊断报告。

AnyGen Suite Skill.source: All-in-one OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor skill that brokers AnyGen operations for PPT slides, DOCX documents, professional or hand-drawn diagrams, storybook decks, data visualization, deep-research reports, websites, finance reports, and design images.
AnyGen Suite Skill.zh: 多合一 OpenClaw、Claude Code 和 Cursor Skill，代理 AnyGen 操作，用于 PPT 幻灯片、DOCX 文档、专业或手绘图表、故事书平台、数据可视化、深入研究报告、网站、财务报告和设计图像。

MCP Diagram Agent.source: MCP stdio server and FastAPI endpoint that turn natural-language software-system descriptions into deterministic, importable Excalidraw JSON with layer-aware layout, colors, arrows, and a narrow Claude-generated node/edge spec.
MCP Diagram Agent.zh: MCP stdio 服务器和 FastAPI 端点将自然语言软件系统描述转换为确定性的、可导入的 Excalidraw JSON，具有分层感知布局、颜色、箭头和狭窄的 Claude 生成的节点/边缘规范。

Excalidraw Icons MCP.source: Excalidraw MCP server and portable agent skill with live canvas sync, 31 element tools, screenshot inspection, Mermaid import, snapshots, Excalidraw URL export, and vendor-icon search for AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Kubernetes, Simple Icons, Tabler, and Iconify diagrams.
Excalidraw Icons MCP.zh: Excalidraw MCP 服务器和便携式 Agent Skill 具有实时画布同步、31 个元素工具、屏幕截图检查、Mermaid 导入、快照、Excalidraw URL 导出和供应商图标搜索AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI、Kubernetes、简单图标、Tabler 和 Iconify 图表。

Universal AI Dashboard Generator.source: Streamlit and Plotly app that ingests CSV files, cleans and profiles data, generates ten deterministic insights, builds adaptive dashboards, creates shareable PDF reports, and can email scheduled daily reports with optional OpenAI narrative summaries.
Universal AI Dashboard Generator.zh: Streamlit 和 Plotly 应用程序，可摄取 CSV 文件、清理和分析数据、生成十个确定性见解、构建自适应仪表盘、创建可共享的 PDF 报告，并可以通过电子邮件发送带有可选 OpenAI 叙述摘要的定期每日报告。

Architecture Review Agent Sample.source: Azure sample agent that reviews YAML, Markdown, plaintext, code, design docs, and architecture descriptions, then produces prioritized risk analysis, recommendations, structured reports, editable Excalidraw diagrams, PNG exports, a React UI, REST API, and Microsoft Foundry hosted-agent deployment.
Architecture Review Agent Sample.zh: Azure 示例 Agent，用于审查 YAML、Markdown、纯文本、代码、设计文档和体系结构描述，然后生成优先风险分析、建议、结构化报告、可编辑 Excalidraw 图表、PNG 导出、React UI, REST API, and Microsoft Foundry hosted-Agent deployment.

CloudPedagogy Word-to-Mermaid Renderer.source: Python converter that extracts Mermaid diagram collections from structured Word documents using Heading styles, writes reusable .mmd files, and optionally creates standalone interactive Mermaid.js HTML pages for literature-review and documentation workflows.
CloudPedagogy Word-to-Mermaid Renderer.zh: Python 转换器，使用标题样式从结构化 Word 文档中提取 Mermaid 图表集合，写入可重用的 .mmd 文件，并可选择创建独立的交互式 Mermaid.js HTML 页面以用于文献审阅和文档工作流程。

Slide Alchemy.source: Codex skill for converting slide screenshots, scanned decks, and image-based PPT/PPTX files into editable PowerPoint decks with real text boxes, native geometry for simple shapes, AI-cleaned backgrounds, and stable generated PNG assets for complex icons.
Slide Alchemy.zh: Codex Skill 用于将幻灯片屏幕截图、扫描的平台和基于图像的 PPT/PPTX 文件转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 平台，其中包含真实的文本框、简单形状的原生几何图形、AI-cleaned 背景以及用于复杂图标的稳定生成的 PNG 资源。

statement-to-tikz.source: Python CLI and library that converts olympiad-style plane-geometry statements into GeometryIR, solves constraints with SciPy, emits standalone TikZ, IR JSON, residual reports, and optional compiled PDFs, with an offline pattern formalizer plus optional OpenAI-compatible LLM formalization.
statement-to-tikz.zh: Python CLI 和库，将奥林匹克风格的平面几何语句转换为 GeometryIR，使用 SciPy 解决约束，发出独立的 TikZ、IR JSON、残差报告和可选编译的 PDFs，具有离线模式形式化器和可选的 OpenAI-compatible LLM formalization.

FigureWeave.source: Research-engineering pipeline and web UI that turn paper method text and figure captions into editable SVG scientific figures through image drafting, local SAM3 segmentation, asset extraction, SVG reasoning/reconstruction, multi-candidate generation, and final SVG assembly.
FigureWeave.zh: 研究工程管道和网络 UI，通过图像起草、本地 SAM3 分割、资产提取、SVG 推理/重建、多候选生成和最终 SVG 组装，将纸质方法文本和图形标题转换为可编辑的 SVG 科学图形。

GenAI Drawio Creator.source: Next.js draw.io workspace that lets users generate, edit, and validate diagrams through chat, file upload, codebase-aware MCP context, non-destructive cell operations, cloud architecture icon libraries, animated connectors, and a preview MCP server for agent clients.
GenAI Drawio Creator.zh: Next.js draw.io 工作区，允许用户通过聊天、文件上传、代码库感知 MCP 上下文、非破坏性单元操作、云架构图标库、动画连接器以及用于 Agent 客户端的预览 MCP 服务器来生成、编辑和验证图表。

FlowDoc.source: TypeScript package and CLI for deterministic PRISMA, CONSORT, and STROBE reporting-guideline flow diagrams from YAML, JSON, or CSV, exporting the same layout to SVG, draw.io, Mermaid, PDF, and PNG with schema and flow-accounting validation.
FlowDoc.zh: TypeScript 包和 CLI 用于来自 YAML、JSON 或 CSV 的确定性 PRISMA、CONSORT 和 STROBE 报告指南流程图，将相同的布局导出到 SVG, draw.io, Mermaid, PDF, and PNG with schema and flow-accounting validation.

DeckMason.source: Agent-agnostic presentation skill that turns prompts, notes, and briefs into production HTML slide decks with 31 curated themes, Pyramid Principle story planning, speaker notes, local persistence, and optional PPTX or PDF export without extra API keys.
DeckMason.zh: Agent 不可知的演示文稿 Skill，可将提示、注释和简介转化为生产 HTML 幻灯片，具有 31 个策划主题、金字塔原理故事规划、演讲者注释、本地持久性以及可选的 PPTX 或 PDF 导出，无需额外API 键。

Sven presentation-skills.source: Codex-oriented skill collection for real office delivery, covering editable PowerPoint research and executive decks, formal Word reports, publishable narrated web-demo videos, Xiaohongshu image cards, native Office charts/tables, preview export, and quality checks for typography, overflow, object overlap, and screenshot backgrounds.
Sven presentation-skills.zh: 面向Codex的Skill集合，用于真正的办公交付，涵盖可编辑的PowerPoint研究和执行平台、正式的Word报告、可发布的带叙述的网络演示视频、小红书图像卡、本机Office图表/表格、预览导出以及对排版、溢出、对象重叠和屏幕截图背景的质量检查。

Interactive Presentation Skill.source: Agent skill that deconstructs research papers, technical articles, textbook sections, or technical concepts into single-file interactive HTML slide decks with MathJax equations, live HTML5 canvas simulations, sliders, and responsive command-center layouts.
Interactive Presentation Skill.zh: Agent Skill 将研究论文、技术文章、教科书部分或技术概念解构为单文件交互式 HTML 幻灯片，其中包含 MathJax 方程、实时 HTML5 画布模拟、滑块和响应式命令中心布局。
