InfoSlides.MCP.source: Dependency-free CLI and MCP server that lets agents provision digital-signage workspaces, upload PPTX or media, clone gallery decks, create live-data template slides, schedule displays, retrieve HLS stream links, and inspect PNG slide previews for TV/lobby presentation delivery.
InfoSlides.MCP.zh: 无依赖性 CLI 和 MCP 服务器，允许 Agent 配置数字标牌工作区、上传 PPTX 或媒体、克隆图库平台、创建实时数据模板幻灯片、安排显示、检索 HLS 流链接以及检查 PNG 幻灯片预览TV/lobby 演示文稿交付。

AWS Architecture Diagram MCP.source: AWS sample MCP server that converts service and connection specs into self-contained interactive HTML architecture diagrams, guided walkthroughs, editable .drawio files, PNG/SVG/PDF exports, and structured JSON/IaC handoff payloads using official AWS icon assets supplied by the user.
AWS Architecture Diagram MCP.zh: AWS 示例 MCP 服务器，使用用户提供的官方 AWS 图标资产将服务和连接规范转换为独立的交互式 HTML 架构图、指导演练、可编辑的 .drawio 文件、PNG/SVG/PDF 导出和结构化 JSON/IaC 切换有效负载。

Cloud Diagram MCP App.source: MCP Apps server for Claude.ai and Claude Code that streams AWS, Azure, GCP, SaaS, or mixed-provider cloud architecture and sequence diagrams inline, rendering an interactive single-page UI with official icon manifests and deployable Worker or Lambda MCP endpoints.
Cloud Diagram MCP App.zh: MCP 适用于 Claude.ai 和 Claude Code 的应用服务器，可内联流式传输 AWS、Azure、GCP、SaaS 或混合提供商云架构和序列图，呈现带有官方图标清单和可部署 Worker 或 Lambda 的交互式单页 UI MCP 端点。

GA4 Dashboard MCP.source: Real-time Google Analytics 4 dashboard with 3D globe visualization, traffic-spike detection, visitor/persona cards, device and geography breakdowns, privacy shielding for query strings, quota-aware caching, and a standalone MCP server for GA4 Admin/Data API reports.
GA4 Dashboard MCP.zh: 实时 Google Analytics 4 仪表盘，具有 3D 全球可视化、流量峰值检测、访客/角色卡、设备和地理位置细分、查询字符串的隐私屏蔽、配额感知缓存以及用于 GA4 管理/数据 API 报告的独立 MCP 服务器。

Workforce Data Explorer.source: Streamlit dashboard and hosted/local MCP connector that turns 89 US workforce and labor-market sources, including BLS, FRED, Census, O*NET, DOL, SEC EDGAR, Indeed, ADP, and Anthropic Economic Index data, into searchable catalogs, charts, CSV downloads, state snapshots, and AI-answerable labor-data reports.
Workforce Data Explorer.zh: Streamlit 仪表盘和托管/本地 MCP 连接器可提供 89 个 US 劳动力和劳动力市场来源，包括 BLS、FRED、人口普查、O*NET、DOL、SEC EDGAR、Indeed、ADP 和 Anthropic 经济指数数据包含在可搜索目录、图表、CSV 下载、状态快照和 AI-answerable 劳动力数据报告中。

Aniya Studio.source: Self-hosted AI slide and HTML-PPT editor that combines a Go streaming agent, FastAPI backend, React/GrapesJS visual editor, AI design mode, presenter mode, PPTX export, hook governance, 58 presentation skills, and 30+ themes so users can generate and manually refine HTML slide decks on the same canvas.
Aniya Studio.zh: 自托管 AI 幻灯片和 HTML-PPT 编辑器，结合了 Go 流媒体 Agent、FastAPI 后端、React/GrapesJS 可视化编辑器、AI 设计模式、演示者模式、PPTX 导出、挂钩治理、58 个演示文稿 Skill 和 30 多个主题，以便用户可以在同一画布上生成和手动优化 HTML 幻灯片。

awesome-presentation-skills.source: Curated presentation-agent-skills index that compares verified editable PPTX, HTML presentation, and image-first deck workflows, with method notes, candidate tracking, related-tool docs, and guidance for choosing workflows by output editability.
awesome-presentation-skills.zh: 策划的演示文稿 - Agent-Skill 索引，用于比较经过验证的可编辑 PPTX、HTML 演示文稿和图像优先平台工作流程，以及方法注释、候选跟踪、相关工具文档以及通过输出可编辑性选择工作流程的指南。

Beamer-MCP.source: MCP server for programmatic LaTeX Beamer slide decks and beamerposter research posters with themes, columns, images, custom frames, .tex saves, and PDF compilation.
Beamer-MCP.zh: 用于编程式制作 LaTeX Beamer 演示文稿与 beamerposter 科研海报的 MCP 服务，支持主题、分栏、图片、自定义框架、保存 .tex 文件及编译 PDF。

mdslides-mcp-server.source: MCP server that wraps mkslides so agents can turn Markdown into hosted Reveal.js-style HTML slide decks with theme, highlight, and Reveal.js options plus Docker deployment.
mdslides-mcp-server.zh: MCP 服务器包装 mkslides，以便 Agent 可以将 Markdown 转换为托管 Reveal.js 风格的 HTML 幻灯片，具有主题、突出显示和 Reveal.js 选项以及 Docker 部署。

Slidev MCP Server.source: MCP server for AI chat-to-Slidev workflows with business, technical, and educational deck examples, atomic slide creation, themes, code blocks, tables, math, and Playwright-backed PDF export.
Slidev MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器，用于 AI 聊天到 Slidev 工作流程，包括业务、技术和教育演示文稿示例、原子幻灯片创建、主题、代码块、表格、数学和 Playwright 支持的 PDF 导出。

Presentation Pro Designer.source: Multi-platform AI presentation design skill and CLI toolkit that routes deck type, source rules, design systems, charts, QA, accessibility, and export packaging for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, IDE agents, and generic agents.
Presentation Pro Designer.zh: 多平台 AI 演示设计 Skill 和 CLI 工具包，用于路由 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 的演示文稿类型、源规则、设计系统、图表、QA、可访问性和导出包装， IDE Agent 和通用 Agent。

Gamma MCP Server.source: NPX-ready MCP server that brings Gamma API presentation generation into Claude Desktop and other clients, with public prompt templates for pitch decks, QBRs, training, sales, conference talks, briefings, and PPTX speaker-note exports.
Gamma MCP Server.zh: NPX-ready MCP 服务器，将 Gamma API 演示文稿生成引入到 Claude 桌面和其他客户端中，并提供用于融资演讲、QBRs、培训、销售、会议演讲、简报和 PPTX 演讲者笔记导出的公共提示模板。

delafuente-skills.source: Claude skill library for data science, strategy, and communications, including XmR charts, 6-12 year-over-year charts, metric trees, companion infographic posts, and consulting-grade PowerPoint decks.
delafuente-skills.zh: Claude Skill 库，用于数据科学、策略和通信，包括 XmR 图表、6-12 年同比图表、指标树、配套信息图帖子和咨询级 PowerPoint 平台。

Slide Builder.source: VS Code Copilot MCP server, Python agent team, and Go CLI that researches topics, URLs, and local files, curates deck narratives, applies style presets, supports natural-language edits, and exports HTML, PPTX, and PDF slides.
Slide Builder.zh: VS Code Copilot MCP 服务器、Python Agent 团队和 Go CLI，用于研究主题、URLs 和本地文件、策划演示文稿叙述、应用样式预设、支持自然语言编辑和导出 HTML， PPTX 和 PDF 幻灯片。

Archy.source: MCP architectural diagram builder that generates Mermaid diagrams from natural-language descriptions, GitHub repository URLs, code snippets, diffs, or repository history, with optional OpenRouter enhancement and PNG/SVG/PDF export.
Archy.zh: MCP 架构图生成器，可根据自然语言描述、GitHub 存储库 URLs、代码片段、差异或存储库历史记录生成 Mermaid 图，并具有可选的 OpenRouter 增强和 PNG/SVG/PDF 导出。

DeepBI.source: AI-native data analysis platform that connects databases, CSV, and Excel sources, supports conversational query generation, creates persistent visualizations, and assembles them into dashboards.
DeepBI.zh: AI-native 数据分析平台，连接数据库、CSV 和 Excel 源，支持会话查询生成，创建持久可视化，并将其组装到仪表盘中。

trRUSTt.source: AI-native Power BI external tool and MCP-native dashboard studio that turns plain-English dashboard requests, schema profiles, and image-to-dashboard prompts into DAX, visuals, and production-ready PBIX reports.
trRUSTt.zh: AI-native Power BI 外部工具和 MCP-native 仪表盘工作室，可将简单的英语仪表盘请求、模式配置文件和图像到仪表盘提示转换为 DAX、视觉效果和可用于生产的 PBIX 报告。

SEO Client Report Skill.source: Claude Code and Codex skill that turns Search Console, GA4, and rank-tracker exports into branded monthly SEO client reports with KPI deltas, charts, narrative sections, publishing, and view analytics.
SEO Client Report Skill.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 将 Search Console、GA4 和排名跟踪器导出转换为品牌每月 SEO 客户报告，其中包含 KPI 增量、图表、叙述部分、发布和视图分析。

groundstation.source: Development Seed prototype that exposes public satellite imagery, active fires, disaster alerts, weather, TiTiler previews, scheduled sweeps, shareable map artifacts, and decision-ready Earth-data briefs through MCP, a Claude skill, and a web console.
groundstation.zh: 开发种子原型，通过 MCP、Claude、Skill 和 Web 控制台公开公共卫星图像、活动火灾、灾害警报、天气、TiTiler 预览、计划扫描、可共享地图产物和决策就绪地球数据简报。

3brown1blue.source: Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf/Copilot Manim skill and CLI that plans audience-aware technical explainer videos from topics or PowerPoint decks, generates scene plans, narration, Manim code, and optional rendered videos.
3brown1blue.zh: Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf/Copilot Manim Skill 和 CLI 从主题或 PowerPoint 平台规划观众感知的技术讲解视频，生成场景计划、旁白、Manim 代码和可选渲染视频。

Video Analysis MCP Service.source: MCP service that analyzes video URLs, extracts keywords, summaries, and key timestamps, then generates jsMind-compatible JSON plus static PNG and interactive HTML mind maps.
Video Analysis MCP Service.zh: MCP 服务分析视频 URLs，提取关键字、摘要和关键时间戳，然后生成 jsMind 兼容的 JSON 以及静态 PNG 和交互式 HTML 思维导图。

mcp-scapple.source: MCP server for Scapple files that parses .scap diagrams into structured JSON, creates diagrams from indented text or lists, and renders themed mind-map or brainstorming canvases to PNG.
mcp-scapple.zh: 用于 Scapple 文件的 MCP 服务器，将 .scap 图表解析为结构化 JSON，从缩进文本或列表创建图表，并将主题思维导图或头脑风暴画布渲染到 PNG。

Mermaid MCP Server by Narasimha.source: TypeScript MCP server that lets AI assistants generate Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, and other professional diagrams, then render them through Puppeteer to SVG outputs.
Mermaid MCP Server by Narasimha.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器，让 AI 助手生成 Mermaid 流程图、序列图、架构图和其他专业图表，然后通过 Puppeteer 渲染到 SVG 输出。

Metabase AI Assistant.source: MCP server for Metabase with natural-language SQL generation, query execution, dashboard templates, question/card management, workspace import/export, metadata analytics, and read-only security controls for BI automation.
Metabase AI Assistant.zh: 适用于 Metabase 的 MCP 服务器，具有自然语言 SQL 生成、查询执行、仪表盘模板、问题/卡片管理、工作区导入/导出、元数据分析和用于 BI 自动化的只读安全控制。

holoviz-viz-mcp.source: HoloViz MCP server that lets AI assistants load CSV/JSON/Parquet/Excel data, run auto-EDA and statistical tests, create 14 chart types, crossfilters, streaming views, dashboards, PNG previews, and standalone interactive Bokeh/Panel HTML exports.
holoviz-viz-mcp.zh: HoloViz MCP 服务器，允许 AI 助手加载 CSV/JSON/Parquet/Excel 数据、运行自动 EDA 和统计测试、创建 14 种图表类型、交叉过滤器、流视图、仪表盘、PNG 预览和独立交互式 Bokeh/面板HTML 出口。

uc-bq-claude-skill.source: Claude Code skill and Node CLI for UltraCart BigQuery warehouses that turns schema-backed questions into version-controlled SQL, ECharts visualizations, replayable report manifests, PDFs, executive analysis, Slack/email delivery, decks, and interactive HTML dashboards.
uc-bq-claude-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 和节点 CLI 用于 UltraCart BigQuery 仓库，将模式支持的问题转换为版本控制的 SQL、ECharts 可视化、可重播的报告清单、PDFs、执行人员分析、Slack/电子邮件传送、平台和交互式 HTML 仪表盘。

Visual Documentation Plugin.source: Claude Code visual-documentation plugin with skills for self-contained HTML architecture diagrams, flowcharts, KPI dashboards, technical docs, timelines, roadmaps, SVG diagrams, and mobile-friendly visualizations.
Visual Documentation Plugin.zh: Claude Code 可视化文档插件，带有 Skill，用于独立的 HTML 架构图、流程图、KPI 仪表盘、技术文档、时间表、路线图、SVG 图表和移动友好的可视化。

Claude Code Toolkit Data Visualization A.source: Claude Code Toolkit agent definition for turning raw datasets into interactive dashboards and visualizations with D3.js, Chart.js, Plotly, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Altair, responsive layouts, accessibility checks, and performance guidance.
Claude Code Toolkit Data Visualization A.zh: Claude Code 工具包 Agent 定义，用于通过 D3.js、Chart.js、Plotly、Matplotlib、Seaborn、Altair、响应式布局、可访问性检查和性能指导将原始数据集转换为交互式仪表盘和可视化。

mcp-charts.source: TypeScript MCP chart widget kit that lets agents query Postgres, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, DuckDB, or typed rows and render interactive charts, KPI tiles, tables, named views, and dashboards inside MCP Apps hosts.
mcp-charts.zh: TypeScript MCP 图表小部件套件，允许 Agent 查询 Postgres、BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、DuckDB 或键入的行，并在其中呈现交互式图表、KPI 磁贴、表格、命名视图和仪表盘MCP 应用程序主机。

mcp-superset.source: MCP server for Apache Superset that gives AI assistants dashboard, chart, dataset, SQL Lab, reports, annotations, asset import/export, native-filter, and access-control tools with safety confirmations.
mcp-superset.zh: 适用于 Apache Superset 的 MCP 服务器，为 AI 助手提供仪表盘、图表、数据集、SQL 实验室、报告、注释、资产导入/导出、本机过滤器和带安全确认的访问控制工具。

Lightdash.source: Open-source agentic BI platform where metrics, dashboards, and data apps live as code; agents can use Lightdash skills, CLI previews, validation, and MCP to build governed charts, dashboards, reports, workbooks, slide decks, and embedded analytics.
Lightdash.zh: 开源代理 BI 平台，其中指标、仪表盘和数据应用程序以代码形式存在； Agent 可以使用 Lightdash Skill、CLI 预览、验证和 MCP 来构建受管理的图表、仪表盘、报告、工作簿、幻灯片和嵌入式分析。

AI-in-One Dashboard.source: Microsoft Power BI template that turns preprocessed Microsoft Copilot, Agent, Purview audit, Entra, licensing, SharePoint, OneLake, and PAX exports into adoption, usage, billing, and value dashboards with scheduled-refresh variants.
AI-in-One Dashboard.zh: Microsoft Power BI 模板可将预处理的 Microsoft Copilot、Agent、Purview 审计、Entra、许可、SharePoint、OneLake 和 PAX 导出转换为具有计划刷新变体的采用、使用、计费和价值仪表盘。

pptx-viewer.source: TypeScript monorepo for parsing, creating, rendering, editing, presenting, converting, and exporting PowerPoint files in browser or Node, with React/Vue/Angular/Svelte/vanilla viewers plus a CLI/MCP package for AI agents.
pptx-viewer.zh: TypeScript monorepo，用于在浏览器或 Node 中解析、创建、渲染、编辑、呈现、转换和导出 PowerPoint 文件，带有 React/Vue/Angular/Svelte/vanilla 查看器以及 CLI/MCP 包AI Agent。

OfficeIMO.source: COM-free .NET document library family for creating, reading, editing, converting, and exporting Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, PDF, Markdown, RTF, and other office/document formats in services, agents, containers, and automation hosts.
OfficeIMO.zh: COM-free .NET 文档库系列，用于创建、读取、编辑、转换和导出 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Visio、PDF、Markdown、RTF 以及服务中的其他办公/文档格式，Agent、容器和自动化主机。

office_oxide.source: Multi-language Office document engine for DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, legacy DOC/XLS/PPT, plain text, Markdown, and intermediate representations, with Rust, Python, Go, C#, Node, WASM, CLI, and MCP server bindings for agent pipelines.
office_oxide.zh: 多语言 Office 文档引擎，支持 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、旧版 DOC/XLS/PPT、纯文本、Markdown 和中间表示，提供 Rust、Python、Go、C#、Node、WASM、CLI 及 MCP 服务绑定，可接入 Agent 工作流。

Office Coding Agent.source: Research Office add-in that brings GitHub Copilot CLI, skills, prompts, plugins, MCP servers, and host-routed tools into Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook, including PowerPoint slide, shape, text, image, table, chart, notes, layout, and visual-QA actions.
Office Coding Agent.zh: 研究办公室插件，将 GitHub Copilot CLI、Skill、提示、插件、MCP 服务器和主机路由工具引入 Excel、PowerPoint、Word 和 Outlook，包括 PowerPoint 幻灯片、形状、文本、图像、表格、图表、注释、布局和视觉 QA 操作。

MCP Diagram Server.source: Enterprise-oriented MCP server for creating, storing, retrieving, and exporting Mermaid diagrams and mind maps with a persistent diagram library, automatic saving, and multi-format rendering support.
MCP Diagram Server.zh: 面向企业的 MCP 服务器，用于创建、存储、检索和导出 Mermaid 图表和思维导图，具有持久图表库、自动保存和多格式渲染支持。

Blueprint MCP.source: Arcade MCP tool that combines Nano Banana Pro image generation with Arcade connectors so agents can extract codebase, SaaS, or system context and visualize it as architecture diagrams.
Blueprint MCP.zh: Arcade MCP 工具将 Nano Banana Pro 图像生成与 Arcade 连接器相结合，因此 Agent 可以提取代码库、SaaS 或系统上下文，并将其可视化为架构图。

PowerPoint Automation MCP.source: Python-pptx MCP server that lets AI assistants create, modify, and manage PowerPoint presentations programmatically, with demo media and presentation-generation tools exposed through MCP.
PowerPoint Automation MCP.zh: Python-pptx MCP 服务器，允许 AI 助手以编程方式创建、修改和管理 PowerPoint 演示文稿，并通过 MCP 公开演示媒体和演示文稿生成工具。

Diagram Bridge MCP.source: Prompt-and-tool MCP bridge that helps LLMs generate and render Mermaid, PlantUML, Graphviz, D2, and other diagram formats through Kroki-backed conversion.
Diagram Bridge MCP.zh: 提示和工具 MCP 桥，帮助 LLMs 通过 Kroki 支持的转换生成和渲染 Mermaid、PlantUML、Graphviz、D2 和其他图表格式。

README Generator Skill.source: Agent skill for producing polished project README artifacts with 16:9 infographic sections, SEO metadata, structured author blocks, Playwright rendering, and visual quality checks.
README Generator Skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于制作带有 16:9 信息图部分、SEO 元数据、结构化作者块、Playwright 渲染和视觉质量检查的精美项目 README 产物。

DiagrammerGPT.source: Official COLM 2024 research implementation for open-domain text-to-diagram generation with LLM planning and layout-guided rendering across diagram domains.
DiagrammerGPT.zh: 官方 COLM 2024 研究实施，用于通过 LLM 跨图域规划和布局引导渲染来生成开放域文本到图表。

Whimsical MCP Server.source: Third-party Whimsical MCP server that lets LLMs create collaborative Whimsical boards and diagrams from Mermaid markup or agent context through the Whimsical API.
Whimsical MCP Server.zh: 第三方 Whimsical MCP 服务器，允许 LLMs 通过 Whimsical API 从 Mermaid 标记或 Agent 上下文创建协作 Whimsical 板和图表。

Noodles.source: Local codebase-understanding tool that creates interactive diagrams showing how AI-generated or unfamiliar code works, so teams can inspect structure without reading every line.
Noodles.zh: 本地代码库理解工具，可创建交互式图表，显示 AI-generated 或不熟悉的代码如何工作，因此团队无需阅读每一行即可检查结构。

LLM Wiki.source: Cross-platform desktop app that incrementally turns documents and sources into an organized, interlinked local wiki instead of answering from scratch on every query.
LLM Wiki.zh: 跨平台桌面应用程序，可逐步将文档和来源转变为有组织的、相互链接的本地 wiki，而不是从头开始回答每个查询。

make-slide.source: Universal AI skill for coding agents that turns prompts and Markdown-style content into standalone HTML slide decks with bundled themes and preview examples.
make-slide.zh: 通用 AI Skill，用于编码 Agent，将提示和 Markdown 风格的内容转换为带有捆绑主题和预览示例的独立 HTML 幻灯片。

next-slide.source: Bilingual AI presentation skill for Claude Code and OpenClaw that creates standalone HTML slides with 26+ visual styles, no runtime dependencies, and browser/PDF-friendly output.
next-slide.zh: 双语 AI 演示文稿 Skill 适用于 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw，可创建具有 26 种以上视觉样式的独立 HTML 幻灯片，无运行时依赖性以及浏览器/PDF-friendly 输出。

karthik-data-visualization-skill.source: Public Codex and Claude data-visualization skill suite for chart selection, chart style, critique, annotation, explanation, and end-to-end visual-story orchestration.
karthik-data-visualization-skill.zh: 公共 Codex 和 Claude 数据可视化 Skill 套件，用于图表选择、图表样式、评论、注释、解释和端到端视觉故事编排。

Countly MCP Server.source: Countly digital-analytics MCP server for browsing apps, dashboards, cohorts, funnels, crash data, feedback, and report configurations, including dashboard email report creation and preview workflows.
Countly MCP Server.zh: Countly 数字分析 MCP 服务器，用于浏览应用程序、仪表盘、队列、渠道、崩溃数据、反馈和报告配置，包括仪表盘电子邮件报告创建和预览工作流程。

MCP-SQL-Visualization.source: MCP-backed natural-language SQL and visualization workflow for querying databases, generating dashboards or reports, and exporting results as HTML or PDF.
MCP-SQL-Visualization.zh: MCP-backed 自然语言 SQL 和可视化工作流程，用于查询数据库、生成仪表盘或报告以及将结果导出为 HTML 或 PDF。

static-ad-concept-generator.source: Claude skill that turns product or brand context into static ad concepts with template-backed angles, headlines, audience targeting, CTAs, and visual directions including infographic and comparison formats.
static-ad-concept-generator.zh: Claude Skill 将产品或品牌背景转化为静态广告概念，具有模板支持的角度、标题、受众定位、CTAs 和视觉方向（包括信息图和比较格式）。

PowerPoint Analyzer MCP Server.source: MCP server that extracts structured slide content and text formatting from PowerPoint files so agents can inspect, summarize, transform, or rebuild existing decks.
PowerPoint Analyzer MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器从 PowerPoint 文件中提取结构化幻灯片内容和文本格式，以便 Agent 可以检查、总结、转换或重建现有幻灯片。

macOS Office365 MCP Server.source: macOS MCP server for automating Microsoft Office 365 applications, especially PowerPoint and Word, through AI agents such as Claude and Cline.
macOS Office365 MCP Server.zh: macOS MCP 服务器，用于通过 AI Agent（例如 Claude 和 Cline）自动化 Microsoft Office 365 应用程序，特别是 PowerPoint 和 Word。

ktundwal presentation-skills.source: Claude Code presentation skill collection centered on Marp decks, iterative visual QA, slide rendering to images, and vision-based checks for layout, overflow, and contrast problems.
ktundwal presentation-skills.zh: Claude Code 演示 Skill 系列以 Marp 平台、迭代视觉 QA、幻灯片渲染到图像以及基于视觉的布局、溢出和对比度问题检查为中心。

Infographic Skill by kseriri.source: Claude Code skill and plugin that turns text prompts into infographic, business-diagram, slide-image, document-illustration, motif, and custom visual assets through Gemini and Imagen models with presets and aspect-ratio controls.
Infographic Skill by kseriri.zh: Claude Code Skill 和插件，可通过带有预设和纵横比控件的 Gemini 和 Imagen 模型将文本提示转换为信息图、业务图、幻灯片图像、文档插图、主题和自定义视觉资产。

Claude Visual Generator.source: Claude Code visual-material skill plugin that extracts key messages from research plans, technical reports, and seminar decks, then generates Gemini-backed infographic or diagram images with 24 layouts and 9 presentation-oriented themes.
Claude Visual Generator.zh: Claude Code 视觉材料 Skill 插件，可从研究计划、技术报告和研讨会平台中提取关键信息，然后生成 Gemini 支持的信息图或图表图像，具有 24 种布局和 9 个面向演示的主题。

MCP Data Visualization Server.source: MCP server for Claude Desktop that turns natural-language questions over DuckDB or Databricks data into Plotly-powered interactive HTML charts, smart chart suggestions, insights, and local or enterprise database visualizations.
MCP Data Visualization Server.zh: 适用于 Claude Desktop 的 MCP 服务器，可将 DuckDB 或 Databricks 数据上的自然语言问题转换为 Plotly 支持的交互式 HTML 图表、智能图表建议、见解以及本地或企业数据库可视化。

BERIL Presentation Maker Skill.source: Claude Code skill for BERIL scientific projects that converts research plans, reports, notebooks, figures, and peer-review artifacts into evidence-grounded KBase-branded talks or posters with citations, speaker notes, Q&A, and optional AI-generated concept illustrations.
BERIL Presentation Maker Skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于 BERIL 科学项目，将研究计划、报告、笔记本、图表和同行评审产物转换为有证据的 KBase 品牌演讲或海报，其中包含引文、演讲者笔记、问答和可选的 AI-generated 概念插图。

google-slides-skill.source: Claude Code skill that audits and redesigns Google Slides decks against source material and brand cues, edits through the Slides API, renders each touched slide to PNG, and performs visual QA for overflow, ragged columns, and overlap.
google-slides-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 根据源材料和品牌线索审核和重新设计 Google 幻灯片平台，通过幻灯片 API 进行编辑，将每个触摸的幻灯片渲染到 PNG，并对溢出、参差不齐的列和重叠执行可视化 QA。

deck-builder skill.source: Claude Code skill for building branded native PPTX decks from source material, data, notes, or descriptions through context gathering, narrative planning, brand profiles, PptxGenJS slide generation, optional image generation, and visual QA.
deck-builder skill.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于通过上下文收集、叙事规划、品牌简介、PptxGenJS 幻灯片生成、可选图像生成和视觉 QA，从源材料、数据、注释或描述构建品牌原生 PPTX 平台。

pdf2slides.source: Python library that converts selectable-text or scanned PDF files into editable PowerPoint slides with a three-line API, optional OCR mode, default-font controls, image retention tuning, and multilingual OCR support.
pdf2slides.zh: Python 库，可将可选文本或扫描的 PDF 文件转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片，具有三行 API、可选的 OCR 模式、默认字体控件、图像保留调整和多语言 OCR 支持。

PPT Visual Reconstruction.source: Codex skill workflow for reconstructing slide screenshots, bitmap decks, and AI-generated slide images into high-fidelity editable PPTX files by preserving complex visuals as bitmap layers while rebuilding key text, labels, shapes, and layout elements as editable PowerPoint objects.
PPT Visual Reconstruction.zh: Codex Skill 工作流程，用于将幻灯片屏幕截图、位图组和 AI-generated 幻灯片图像重建为高保真可编辑 PPTX 文件，方法是将复杂的视觉效果保留为位图图层，同时将关键文本、标签、形状和布局元素重建为可编辑的 PowerPoint 对象。

visual-assets.source: Local Claude Code skill for generating text-accurate diagrams, infographics, data visualizations, architecture maps, flowcharts, and document-embedded figures through deterministic HTML/SVG/D2/Graphviz rendering, optional local diffusion imagery, and portable self-contained exports.
visual-assets.zh: 本地 Claude Code Skill，用于通过确定性 HTML/SVG/D2/Graphviz 渲染、可选的局部扩散图像和便携式独立导出来生成文本精确图表、信息图、数据可视化、架构图、流程图和文档嵌入图形。

Gemini MCP.source: Gemini MCP server for Claude and other MCP clients that creates grounded images, editable SVG diagrams, self-contained landing pages, videos, and chart prompts with inline MCP App previews and Google Search grounding.
Gemini MCP.zh: Gemini MCP 服务器，用于 Claude 和其他 MCP 客户端，可创建接地图像、可编辑的 SVG 图表、独立的登陆页面、视频和图表提示，以及内联 MCP 应用程序预览和 Google 搜索接地。

mermaid-diagram-to-image.source: Claude Code plugin skill and slash command that converts Mermaid syntax into high-quality PNG, SVG, or PDF diagrams for documentation images, presentation flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and shareable system visuals.
mermaid-diagram-to-image.zh: Claude Code 插件 Skill 和斜杠命令，可将 Mermaid 语法转换为高质量的 PNG、SVG 或 PDF 图表，用于文档图像、演示流程图、架构图和可共享的系统视觉效果。

open-agent-hub.source: Zero-dependency CLI and metadata index for linking skills, agents, and commands across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Trae, OpenCode, Kiro, and related assistants, including indexed diagram, infographic, slide-deck, Markdown-to-HTML, and image-card skills.
open-agent-hub.zh: 零依赖性 CLI 和元数据索引，用于链接 Skill、Agent 以及 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、Cursor、Trae、OpenCode、Kiro 及相关命令助手，包括索引图、信息图、幻灯片、Markdown-to-HTML 和图像卡 Skill。

Awesome Claude Code Subagents.source: Curated Claude Code subagent collection and plugin marketplace with 154+ specialist agents, including technical-writing, data-analysis, design, documentation, and visual-communication agents that produce diagrams, screenshots, flowcharts, infographics, video content, and interactive documentation elements.
Awesome Claude Code Subagents.zh: 与超过 154 位专家 Agent 一起策划的 Claude Code 子代理集合和插件市场，包括技术写作、数据分析、设计、文档和视觉通信 Agent，可生成图表、屏幕截图、流程图、信息图、视频内容和交互式文档元素。

humanize-presentations.source: Agent skill that audits and edits existing PPTX decks to remove AI-writing tells while preserving intended deck structure, speaker-note boundaries, non-English text, and PowerPoint-openable file packaging.
humanize-presentations.zh: Agent Skill 审核和编辑现有的 PPTX 演示文稿以删除 AI-writing 提示，同时保留预期的演示文稿结构、演讲者注释边界、非英语文本和 PowerPoint 可打开的文件包装。

Paper Share Skills.source: Cross-agent paper-sharing skill suite that turns arXiv/PDF papers into SUSTech Beamer slides, video cover posters, narrated landscape/portrait MP4 explainers, and Bilibili publishing metadata.
Paper Share Skills.zh: 跨 Agent 论文共享 Skill 套件，可将 arXiv/PDF 论文转换为 SUSTech Beamer 幻灯片、视频封面海报、旁白横向/纵向 MP4 解释器和 Bilibili 发布元数据。

SlideForge MCP.source: Remote MCP server and REST API that compiles typed slide intents into native editable PowerPoint files with previews, fidelity manifests, template upload, dry-run validation, translation, and deck inspection/repair tools.
SlideForge MCP.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器和 REST API 将键入的幻灯片意图编译为本机可编辑 PowerPoint 文件，并具有预览、保真度清单、模板上传、试运行验证、翻译和套牌检查/修复工具。

mermaid-mcp by tci-nebula.source: MCP server that renders Mermaid syntax to PNG, SVG, PDF, or editable draw.io XML using Mermaid CLI/Chromium or Docker, with base64 inline results and optional file output paths.
mermaid-mcp by tci-nebula.zh: MCP 服务器，使用 Mermaid CLI/Chromium 或 Docker 将 Mermaid 语法呈现为 PNG、SVG、PDF 或可编辑的draw.io XML，具有 Base64 内联结果和可选的文件输出路径。

YAML Infographic.source: Agent skill and validation toolkit that locks an infographic's information architecture, layout, exact data, citations, alt text, and visual rules in YAML before compiling image-generation prompts and checking final outputs.
YAML Infographic.zh: Agent Skill 和验证工具包，在编译图像生成提示和检查最终输出之前，将信息图的信息架构、布局、精确数据、引文、替代文本和视觉规则锁定在 YAML 中。

Open Visualization Protocol.source: Agent-first visualization protocol with 74 chart skills, 16 design languages, deterministic SVG/PPTX renderers, golden data/spec fixtures, and validation gates for repeatable, honest charts.
Open Visualization Protocol.zh: Agent-第一个可视化协议，具有 74 个图表 Skill、16 种设计语言、确定性 SVG/PPTX 渲染器、黄金数据/规格固定装置以及可重复、诚实图表的验证门。

Vela Slides.source: Agent-native presentation engine and skill that turns conversational deck briefs into interactive React slide apps, local browser/desktop presentations, editable structured deck JSON, and vector PDF exports.
Vela Slides.zh: Agent 原生演示引擎和 Skill，可将对话式演示文稿简报转换为交互式 React 幻灯片应用程序、本地浏览器/桌面演示、可编辑结构化演示文稿 JSON 和矢量 PDF 导出。

Lab Meeting Report Skill.source: Research workflow skill that turns weekly notes, papers, results, figures, and blockers into evidence-grounded Markdown lab-meeting reports, optional Marp/Quarto/editable-PPTX deck content, and Feishu/Notion publishing outputs.
Lab Meeting Report Skill.zh: 研究工作流程 Skill 将每周笔记、论文、结果、图表和阻碍转化为有证据支持的 Markdown 实验室会议报告、可选的 Marp/Quarto/可编辑的 PPTX 幻灯片内容以及 Feishu/Notion 发布输出。

Echo Slides Skill.source: Agent skill that recovers deduplicated slide images and timestamp manifests from talk recordings or local videos using stable-interval detection, perceptual hashes, color signatures, ffmpeg, and yt-dlp.
Echo Slides Skill.zh: Agent Skill，使用稳定间隔检测、感知哈希、颜色签名、ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 从谈话录音或本地视频中恢复重复数据删除的幻灯片图像和时间戳清单。

lecture-to-notes.source: Local-first lecture/conference pipeline that turns mixed recordings, audio, slide images, and PDF decks into grounded Markdown notes and a synced offline HTML viewer linking video, transcript, summary, and slide evidence.
lecture-to-notes.zh: 本地优先的讲座/会议管道，将混合录音、音频、幻灯片图像和 PDF 幻灯片转换为基础的 Markdown 笔记和链接视频、文字记录、摘要和幻灯片证据的同步离线 HTML 查看器。

Markdown Exporter.source: Agent Skill, Dify plugin, OpenClaw skill, and CLI that transforms Markdown text and Markdown tables into DOCX, PPTX, PDF, PNG, SVG, HTML, XLSX, CSV, JSON, XML, LaTeX, notebooks, and code files with local processing and optional document templates.
Markdown Exporter.zh: Agent Skill、Dify 插件、OpenClaw、Skill 和 CLI，将 Markdown 文本和 Markdown 表转换为 DOCX、PPTX、 PDF、PNG、SVG、HTML、XLSX、CSV、JSON、XML、LaTeX、笔记本以及具有本地处理和功能的代码文件可选的文档模板。

Graphify.source: Cross-agent /graphify skill and CLI that maps code, docs, PDFs, images, video, and audio into a local-first explained knowledge graph, producing an interactive graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and queryable graph.json.
Graphify.zh: 交叉 Agent /graphify Skill 和 CLI，将代码、文档、PDFs、图像、视频和音频映射到本地优先解释的知识图谱中，生成交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和可查询的 graph.json。

AgentDoc.source: MCP server and prompt/tool set for walking legacy codebases, generating per-directory README.C4Diagrammer.md summaries, C4Component diagrams, root C4Context/C4Container diagrams, Mermaid validation, and browser previews.
AgentDoc.zh: MCP 服务器和提示/工具集，用于遍历遗留代码库、生成每个目录的 README.C4Diagrammer.md 摘要、C4Component 图、根 C4Context/C4Container 图、Mermaid 验证和浏览器预览。

ClaudeSkills by StarU.source: Curated 13-skill Agent Skills collection with deep-research, deck-studio, product-document, WeChat article, PDF parsing, sales, architecture, and quality-gated workflows, including deck examples, style previews, scripts, and acceptance checks.
ClaudeSkills by StarU.zh: 精心策划的 13-Skill Agent Skills 集合，包含深入研究、演示文稿工作室、产品文档、WeChat 文章、PDF 解析、销售、架构和质量控制工作流程，包括演示文稿示例、样式预览、脚本和验收检查。

Claude Trading Skills.source: Claude Skills trading workflow toolkit that turns market breadth CSVs, chart images, portfolio data, news, trade journals, and research inputs into daily market checks, portfolio reviews, screeners, trade plans, performance digests, dashboards, and evidence-backed strategy reports.
Claude Trading Skills.zh: Claude Skills 交易工作流程工具包，可将市场广度 CSVs、图表图像、投资组合数据、新闻、贸易期刊和研究输入转化为日常市场检查、投资组合审查、筛选器、交易计划、绩效摘要、仪表盘和有证据支持的策略报告。

root-ext-viz.source: Data-visualization MCP tool server with a sessional Python kernel, pandas/numpy/scipy/matplotlib/plotly/altair, Vega-Lite chart specs, local PNG rendering through vl-convert, data profiling, and bounded artifact-directory outputs.
root-ext-viz.zh: 数据可视化 MCP 工具服务器，具有会话 Python 内核、pandas/numpy/scipy/matplotlib/plotly/altair、Vega-Lite 图表规格、通过 vl-convert 进行本地 PNG 渲染、数据分析和有界产物目录输出。

Re:port Flow MCP.source: MCP server that turns Re:port Flow templates into invoices, contracts, statements, and other PDF reports from Claude or compatible AI agents, with remote OAuth and local npx transport options.
Re:port Flow MCP.zh: MCP 服务器将 Re:port Flow 模板从 Claude 或兼容的 AI Agent 转换为发票、合同、报表和其他 PDF 报告，并具有远程 OAuth 和本地 npx 传输选项。

regulated-reporting-mcp.source: Workiva-focused MCP server for regulated financial reporting with OAuth, async polling, guarded write contracts, verified readback, redacted receipts, and a credential-free demo path for statement-workbook workflows.
regulated-reporting-mcp.zh: 以 Workiva 为中心的 MCP 服务器，用于使用 OAuth 进行受监管的财务报告、异步轮询、受保护的写入合约、验证读回、编辑收据以及报表工作簿工作流程的无凭据演示路径。

Office Reporting MCP Kit.source: Reusable MCP contracts, Agent Skill guidance, and Python adapter protocols for backend-authorized Office report creation, rendering, artifact lifecycle checks, and controlled delivery of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF outputs.
Office Reporting MCP Kit.zh: 可重复使用的 MCP 合约、Agent Skill 指南和 Python 适配器协议，用于后端授权的 Office 报告创建、渲染、产物生命周期检查以及 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 或 PDF 输出的受控交付。

PDF Reporter MCP.source: TypeScript MCP server for rendering Mermaid diagrams to SVG and composing Markdown with callout blocks into styled PDF reports through stdio or SSE transports, with Docker images and strict test coverage.
PDF Reporter MCP.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器，用于将 Mermaid 图表渲染为 SVG，并通过 stdio 或 SSE 传输将带有标注块的 Markdown 组合成样式化的 PDF 报告，具有 Docker 图像和严格的测试覆盖率。

Hypermnesia MCP Viz.source: Read-only Cortex visualization MCP for Codex, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and other MCP hosts that renders memory stores, activity streams, session archives, and codebase graphs as trace galaxies, execution traces, knowledge browsers, consolidation boards, and wiki views.
Hypermnesia MCP Viz.zh: 用于 Codex、Gemini、CLI、Claude Code 和其他 MCP 主机的只读 Cortex 可视化 MCP，将内存存储、活动流、会话存档和代码库图呈现为跟踪星系、执行跟踪、知识浏览器、整合板和维基视图。

quickai.source: Local Claude Code profiler, CLI, plugin, and MCP server that indexes transcript JSONL files and turns token, model, tool-use, cache, cost-equivalent, and timeline data into project statistics and self-contained HTML reports.
quickai.zh: 本地 Claude Code 分析器、CLI、插件和 MCP 服务器，用于索引转录 JSONL 文件并将令牌、模型、工具使用、缓存、成本等价和时间线数据转换为项目统计数据和独立的 HTML 报告。

Oh My PPT.source: Local-first desktop HTML presentation generator and editor that imports old PPTX templates, creates AI-planned decks from topics or uploaded txt/md/csv/docx documents, adds AI images, and exports editable PPTX, PDF, PNG, long images, MP4, HTML, or packaged presentations.
Oh My PPT.zh: 本地优先的桌面 HTML 演示文稿生成器和编辑器，可导入旧的 PPTX 模板、从主题或上传的 txt/md/csv/docx 文档创建 AI-planned 幻灯片、添加 AI 图像并导出可编辑的 PPTX、PDF、 PNG、长图像、MP4、HTML 或打包演示文稿。

Smart Illustrator.source: Claude Code article-illustration skill that analyzes Markdown article structure, selects Gemini, Excalidraw, or Mermaid engines, places contextual illustrations and covers, and exports PNG assets for articles, technical explainers, social posts, and thumbnails.
Smart Illustrator.zh: Claude Code 文章插图 Skill，用于分析 Markdown 文章结构，选择 Gemini、Excalidraw 或 Mermaid 引擎，放置上下文插图和封面，并导出文章、技术解释、社交帖子和内容的 PNG 资产缩略图。

Beamer Skill.source: AI coding-assistant skill for academic Beamer LaTeX presentations with create, compile, review, polish, and verify lifecycle steps, quality scoring, pedagogical review, TikZ audit, and multi-agent-assistant setup files.
Beamer Skill.zh: AI 编码助理 Skill，用于学术 Beamer LaTeX 演示，包括创建、编译、审查、完善和验证生命周期步骤、质量评分、教学审查、TikZ 审核和多 Agent 助理设置文件。

PowerPoint Slides Skill.source: Claude Code PowerPoint skill for academic papers, research notes, or structured content that generates native PPTX through PptxGenJS, OMML math, LaTeX fallback rendering, Graphviz/Mermaid/TikZ diagrams, figure extraction, visual audits, and validation loops.
PowerPoint Slides Skill.zh: Claude Code PowerPoint Skill 用于学术论文、研究笔记或结构化内容，通过 PptxGenJS、OMML 数学、LaTeX 后备渲染生成本机 PPTX， Graphviz/Mermaid/TikZ 图表、图形提取、视觉审核和验证循环。

DataViz by SCKelemen.source: Go charting library, CLI, and dataviz MCP server with 29 chart-generation tools, SVG and terminal output, stat cards, galleries, and reusable line, area, bar, scatter, heatmap, pie, donut, hierarchical, financial, and specialized chart renderers.
DataViz by SCKelemen.zh: Go 图表库、CLI 和 dataviz MCP 服务器，带有 29 个图表生成工具、SVG 和终端输出、统计卡、图库以及可重复使用的折线图、面积图、条形图、散点图、热图、饼图、甜甜圈图、分层图、财务图和专用图表渲染器。

Microsoft MCP Interactive UI Samples.source: Microsoft sample repository for MCP servers that render rich interactive widgets in Microsoft 365 Copilot and OpenAI Apps SDK hosts, including expense reports, dispatch maps, approval queues, HR dashboards, claims dashboards, media cards, and enterprise LOB UIs.
Microsoft MCP Interactive UI Samples.zh: MCP 服务器的 Microsoft 示例存储库，可在 Microsoft 365 Copilot 和 OpenAI 应用 SDK 主机中呈现丰富的交互式小部件，包括费用报告、调度地图、审批队列、HR 仪表盘、索赔仪表盘、媒体卡和企业 LOB UIs。

Thesis Defense PPTX Skill.source: Codex and Claude skill that turns thesis PDFs or LaTeX projects into editable defense PPTX decks while preserving a supplied PowerPoint template, then exports rendered slide checks, overview images, overflow scans, and stale-template text audits.
Thesis Defense PPTX Skill.zh: Codex 和 Claude Skill 将论文 PDFs 或 LaTeX 项目转换为可编辑的防御 PPTX 平台，同时保留提供的 PowerPoint 模板，然后导出渲染的幻灯片检查、概述图像、溢出扫描和陈旧模板文本审计。

dashiai-ppt-skill.source: Agent skill for document-to-presentation workflows with twelve visual themes, a browser editing console, safe snapshot-based rework, HTML/PDF export, and editable PPTX export for research, pitch, project, and training decks.
dashiai-ppt-skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于文档到演示的工作流程，具有 12 个视觉主题、浏览器编辑控制台、基于快照的安全返工、HTML/PDF 导出以及用于研究、推介、项目和培训平台的可编辑 PPTX 导出。

Frontend Slides Editable.source: Codex and Claude Code skill for single-file HTML presentations with an embedded browser editor for dragging, resizing, editing text, reordering slides, local save/export, media placeholders, and PPTX-to-web conversion.
Frontend Slides Editable.zh: Codex 和 Claude Code Skill 用于单文件 HTML 演示，带有嵌入式浏览器编辑器，用于拖动、调整大小、编辑文本、重新排序幻灯片、本地保存/导出、媒体占位符和 PPTX-to-web 转换。

XHS Images Skill.source: Claude skill for turning a topic or content brief into cohesive Xiaohongshu-style infographic image series with unified visual style for social publishing and knowledge-card communication.
XHS Images Skill.zh: Claude Skill 用于将主题或内容简介转化为具有统一视觉风格的有凝聚力的小红书式信息图图像系列，用于社交发布和知识卡传播。

IG Card Generator.source: Agent skill that distills articles, notes, or transcripts into Instagram carousel knowledge cards using a Markdown DSL, lint checks, Puppeteer rendering, and light or dark 1080 by 1350 PNG exports.
IG Card Generator.zh: Agent Skill，使用 Markdown DSL、lint 检查、Puppeteer 渲染以及浅色或深色 1080 x 1350 PNG 导出将文章、笔记或文字记录提取到 Instagram 轮播知识卡中。

Google MCP.source: TypeScript Google Workspace MCP server with OAuth tools for Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar, Meet, Chat, Forms, YouTube, Tasks, and Contacts so agents can create, edit, and manage Google Slides and document artifacts.
Google MCP.zh: TypeScript Google Workspace MCP 服务器，配备用于云端硬盘、文档、表格、幻灯片、Gmail、日历、会议、聊天、表单、YouTube、任务和联系人的 OAuth 工具，以便 Agent 可以创建、编辑和管理 Google 幻灯片和文档产物。

UseIt Agent.source: Open-source creative-work assistant that connects agents to professional desktop tools and MCP workflows, including recreating reference pipeline figures as fully editable PowerPoint slides and drawing technical diagrams in native apps.
UseIt Agent.zh: 开源创意工作助手，可将 Agent 连接到专业桌面工具和 MCP 工作流程，包括将参考管道图重新创建为完全可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片以及在本机应用程序中绘制技术图表。

image2editable.source: Codex and Claude Code skill plus local CLI that converts images, PDFs, image-based PPTX files, and mixed PPTX decks into editable PowerPoint presentations with OCR, visual understanding, local-agent mode, and quality-gated repair loops.
image2editable.zh: Codex 和 Claude Code Skill 加上本地 CLI，可将图像、PDFs、基于图像的 PPTX 文件以及混合 PPTX 演示文稿转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 演示文稿OCR、视觉理解、本地 Agent 模式和质量门控修复循环。

DCC MCP PowerPoint.source: DCC-MCP PowerPoint application layer for structured deck IR generation, slide composition, deck modification, semantic layer operations, plugin execution, COM rendering, PDF/PNG previews, and structural validation.
DCC MCP PowerPoint.zh: DCC-MCP PowerPoint 应用层，用于结构化演示文稿 IR 生成、幻灯片合成、演示文稿修改、语义层操作、插件执行、COM 渲染、PDF/PNG 预览和结构验证。

Diagram Builder.source: MCP App powered by Mermaid.js for creating and editing live-rendered diagrams inside chat, including flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, pie, mind map, and timeline diagrams with hosted or local deployment.
Diagram Builder.zh: MCP 应用程序由 Mermaid.js 提供支持，用于在聊天中创建和编辑实时渲染图表，包括流程图、序列、类、状态、ER、甘特图、饼图、思维导图和具有托管或本地部署的时间线图。

Reference HTML PPTX Skills.source: Paired Codex skills for reference-driven 16:9 HTML slide design and structurally editable PowerPoint export, with semantic layout planning, visual-token extraction, PPTX reconstruction, screenshots, and overflow/QA checks.
Reference HTML PPTX Skills.zh: 配对 Codex Skill，用于参考驱动的 16:9 HTML 幻灯片设计和结构上可编辑的 PowerPoint 导出，具有语义布局规划、视觉标记提取、PPTX 重建、屏幕截图和溢出/QA 检查。

Hand-drawn Infographic Restyler.source: Cross-platform Codex and Claude Code skill for restyling infographics, slide-like images, framework diagrams, comparison charts, and article covers into a consistent hand-drawn editorial image style while preserving text, hierarchy, relationships, and meaning.
Hand-drawn Infographic Restyler.zh: 跨平台 Codex 和 Claude Code Skill 用于将信息图、幻灯片式图像、框架图、比较图表和文章封面重新设计为一致的手绘编辑图像风格，同时保留文本、层次结构、关系和含义。

Jira OKR Dashboard MCP.source: Jira-over-MCP toolkit with a multi-workspace React dashboard, direct Jira REST aggregation, AI status summaries, MCP issue/progress tools, and a CLI that writes static OKR status reports through an agentic tool-use loop.
Jira OKR Dashboard MCP.zh: Jira-over-MCP 工具包，具有多工作区 React 仪表盘、直接 Jira REST 聚合、AI 状态摘要、MCP 问题/进度工具以及通过写入静态 OKR 状态报告的 CLI代理工具使用循环。

Oracle FDI ADW AI Dashboard MCP.source: MCP-powered Oracle FDI and Autonomous Data Warehouse reporting workflow with read-only governed SQL controls, approval/audit steps, reusable join maps, static dashboard generation, and CSV/JSON report exports.
Oracle FDI ADW AI Dashboard MCP.zh: MCP-powered Oracle FDI 和自治数据仓库报告工作流程，具有只读管理的 SQL 控件、批准/审核步骤、可重用连接图、静态仪表盘生成和 CSV/JSON 报告导出。

High-Density Infographic Skill.source: OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Codex skill for generating high-density information graphics from topics or structured briefs, with ten visual styles, 2K/4K output options, multi-ratio support, Gemini/NanoBanana API configuration, and official example galleries.
High-Density Infographic Skill.zh: OpenClaw、Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 用于从主题或结构化摘要生成高密度信息图形，具有十种视觉样式、2K/4K 输出选项、多比例支持、Gemini/NanoBanana API 配置，和官方示例画廊。

Flint Chart.source: Microsoft visualization language, charting library, and MCP server that lets AI agents produce expressive, human-editable chart specs with interactive previews, examples, and reliable rendered chart output.
Flint Chart.zh: Microsoft 可视化语言、图表库和 MCP 服务器，使 AI Agent 能够生成具有表现力、人工可编辑的图表规格，并具有交互式预览、示例和可靠的渲染图表输出。

Talk-to-Your-Slides.source: ACL Findings 2026 PowerPoint slide-editing agent that uses LLM planning, MCP-style tool access, and visual feedback to inspect, edit, and improve existing presentation decks.
Talk-to-Your-Slides.zh: ACL 调查结果 2026 PowerPoint 幻灯片编辑 Agent，使用 LLM 规划、MCP-style 工具访问和视觉反馈来检查、编辑和改进现有演示文稿。

chart-ocr-mcp.source: PaddleOCR-based CLI, FastAPI app, and local MCP tools for extracting chart and table structure from images and PowerPoint slides so agents can analyze or rebuild visual source material.
chart-ocr-mcp.zh: 基于 PaddleOCR 的 CLI、FastAPI 应用程序和本地 MCP 工具，用于从图像和 PowerPoint 幻灯片中提取图表和表格结构，以便 Agent 可以分析或重建视觉源材料。

html-infographic.source: Claude Code skill for turning a technical concept or brief into a single-screen, animation-rich self-contained HTML infographic with inline visual structure for explainers and shareable teaching artifacts.
html-infographic.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于将技术概念或简介转变为单屏、动画丰富的独立 HTML 信息图，具有用于解释者和可共享教学产物的内嵌视觉结构。

Claude Setup Dashboard.source: Claude Code skill that scans a local Claude setup and refreshes a capabilities dashboard so teams can inspect installed skills, commands, hooks, agents, MCP servers, and configuration state as a visual inventory.
Claude Setup Dashboard.zh: Claude Code Skill 扫描本地 Claude 设置并刷新功能仪表盘，以便团队可以检查已安装的 Skill、命令、挂钩、Agent、MCP 服务器和配置状态作为可视清单。

ECharts Bigscreen Skill.source: Claude Code and Cursor skill for generating offline-deployable ECharts big-screen dashboards, monitoring boards, and data command centers from a short natural-language brief as a single HTML artifact.
ECharts Bigscreen Skill.zh: Claude Code 和 Cursor Skill，用于从简短的自然语言简介作为单个 HTML 产物生成可离线部署的 ECharts 大屏幕仪表盘、监控板和数据命令中心。

mcp-apps-render.source: Terminal CLI for rendering MCP Apps interactive UI payloads, including dashboards, forms, and visualizations, giving agent workflows a local inspection surface for MCP-generated visual artifacts.
mcp-apps-render.zh: 用于渲染 MCP 应用程序交互式 UI 有效负载（包括仪表盘、表单和可视化）的终端 CLI，为 Agent 工作流程提供 MCP-generated 视觉产物的本地检查表面。

html-mcp-web.source: MCP review surface for agent-generated HTML slides and reports, with rendered-page anchored comments, overlap/off-page checks, live agent replies, and HTML/PDF/editable-PPTX export.
html-mcp-web.zh: MCP 审阅界面，用于 Agent 生成的 HTML 幻灯片和报告，具有渲染页面锚定注释、重叠/页外检查、实时 Agent 回复和 HTML/PDF/editable-PPTX 导出。

Helx.source: CLI, MCP server, and TypeScript SDK for AI agents to create, edit, validate, diff, render, and convert DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, HTML, CSV, charts, diagrams, and templates.
Helx.zh: CLI、MCP 服务器和 TypeScript SDK 用于 AI Agent 创建、编辑、验证、比较、渲染和转换 DOCX、XLSX、 PPTX、PDF、Markdown、HTML、CSV、图表、图表和模板。

document-adapter.source: Python adapter and MCP server that lets LLM agents inspect, fill, template, edit tables, duplicate slides, and update chart data across DOCX, PPTX, HWPX, and XLSX files.
document-adapter.zh: Python 适配器和 MCP 服务器，允许 LLM Agent 检查、填充、模板、编辑表格、复制幻灯片以及更新 DOCX、PPTX、HWPX 和 XLSX 文件中的图表数据。

dashboard-it.source: Claude Code skill that turns conversation ideas, comparisons, plans, and data into a single-page HTML and JavaScript dashboard artifact with visual hierarchy and offline saving.
dashboard-it.zh: Claude Code Skill 将对话想法、比较、计划和数据转换为单页 HTML 和 JavaScript 仪表盘产物，具有可视层次结构和离线保存。

chart-dashboard.source: Claude Agent Skill and plugin for turning tables, CSVs, pasted numbers, or meeting notes into one self-contained offline HTML dashboard or illustrated report with interactive SVG charts.
chart-dashboard.zh: Claude Agent Skill 和转台插件、CSVs、粘贴数字或会议记录到一个独立的离线 HTML 仪表盘或带有交互式 SVG 图表的插图报告中。

web-accessibility-audit.source: Claude Skill for auditing rendered web pages with Playwright, axe-core, heuristics, WCAG citations, element screenshots, and prioritized dashboard-style Markdown reports.
web-accessibility-audit.zh: Claude Skill 用于审核使用 Playwright、axe-core、启发式、WCAG 引用、元素屏幕截图和优先仪表盘样式 Markdown 报告呈现的网页。

TOP-SKILLS.source: Auto-synced Claude Code skills directory with 3900-plus skills from multiple sources, bilingual search, filters, charts, trend views, hot-repo rankings, and a public static dashboard.
TOP-SKILLS.zh: 自动同步 Claude Code Skill 目录与来自多个来源的 3900 多个 Skill、双语搜索、过滤器、图表、趋势视图、热门回购排名和公共静态仪表盘。

slideshot.source: CLI, web app, MCP server, and REST API that turn AI-generated HTML carousels and slide pages into high-resolution PNG, WebP, PDF, and PPTX exports with reusable prompt presets.
slideshot.zh: CLI、Web 应用程序、MCP 服务器和 REST API，将 AI-generated HTML 轮播和幻灯片页面转换为高分辨率 PNG、WebP、PDF 和PPTX 导出可重复使用的提示预设。

slides-grab.source: Agent skill bundle, editor, linter, and CLI for AI-generated HTML slide workspaces, with region-based agent edits, design gates, PDF/PNG export, and experimental PPTX/Figma conversion.
slides-grab.zh: Agent Skill 捆绑包、编辑器、linter 和 CLI，用于 AI-generated HTML 幻灯片工作区，具有基于区域的 Agent 编辑、设计门、PDF/PNG 导出和实验性 PPTX/Figma转换。

docu.md Markdown Viewer.source: Local-first Markdown viewer and Node/Chrome CLI that renders AI-generated Markdown, technical notes, diagrams, charts, math, tables, and code into polished DOCX, PDF, self-contained HTML, and visual-block exports.
docu.md Markdown Viewer.zh: 本地优先的 Markdown 查看器和 Node/Chrome CLI，将 AI-generated Markdown、技术说明、图表、数学、表格和代码渲染为精美的 DOCX、PDF、独立的 HTML 和视觉块出口。

Infrastructure Diagram MCP Server.source: MCP server for generating multi-cloud infrastructure diagrams across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Helm charts, and diagrams-as-code workflows using Python Diagrams, Graphviz, and optional Docker.
Infrastructure Diagram MCP Server.zh: MCP 服务器，用于使用 Python 图、Graphviz 和可选的 Docker 跨 AWS、Azure、GCP、Kubernetes、Helm 图表和图表即代码工作流程生成多云基础设施图表。

Azure Diagram MCP.source: MCP server that turns natural-language prompts or generated Python Diagrams code into Microsoft Azure architecture, sequence, flow, and class diagrams saved as PNG files through Graphviz.
Azure Diagram MCP.zh: MCP 服务器将自然语言提示或生成的 Python 图代码转换为 Microsoft Azure 架构、序列、流程和类图，并通过 Graphviz 保存为 PNG 文件。

Claude Code Usage Analyzer.source: Claude Code tokenomics dashboard skill and CLI that reads ccusage data, resolves LiteLLM pricing, and emits JSON, Markdown reports, a self-contained HTML dashboard, and optional PNG charts.
Claude Code Usage Analyzer.zh: Claude Code Token经济学仪表盘 Skill 和 CLI，读取费用数据，解析 LiteLLM 定价，并发出 JSON、Markdown 报告、独立的 HTML 仪表盘和可选PNG 图表。

ai-netcafe.source: Hosted MCP and CLI tool packs for table cleanup, developer transforms, China reachability facts, and doc-flow conversions including Markdown to PDF, Word, PowerPoint, EPUB, and HTML.
ai-netcafe.zh: 托管 MCP 和 CLI 工具包，用于表清理、开发人员转换、中国可达性事实和文档流转换，包括 Markdown 到 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、EPUB 和 HTML。

ip-diagram-creator.source: Agent Skill for turning authorized photos, profile screenshots, articles, course outlines, scripts, or old decks into reusable personal-IP character assets, knowledge cards, long-form illustrations, posters, and PPT page plans.
ip-diagram-creator.zh: Agent Skill 用于将授权照片、个人资料屏幕截图、文章、课程大纲、脚本或旧套牌转换为可重复使用的个人 IP 角色资产、知识卡、长格式插图、海报和 PPT 页面计划。

Content Pipeline.source: AI-powered research-to-social-content app that searches fresh web/news sources, lets users select source articles, streams Claude-generated LinkedIn posts, and renders branded 1080x1350 infographics server-side with Satori.
Content Pipeline.zh: AI-powered 研究社交内容应用程序，可搜索新鲜的网络/新闻来源，让用户选择源文章，流式传输 Claude 生成的 LinkedIn 帖子，并使用 Satori 在服务器端渲染品牌 1080x1350 信息图。

lithium-kb.source: Zero-dependency project knowledge-base generator and MCP server that builds structured agent memory, compact architecture indexes, symbol maps, and a browser neural-graph visualizer for live memory hits and token savings.
lithium-kb.zh: 零依赖性项目知识库生成器和 MCP 服务器，可构建结构化 Agent 内存、紧凑架构索引、符号映射和浏览器神经图可视化工具，以实现实时内存命中和令牌节省。

dataviz-mcp.source: D3-powered MCP App server that turns compact columnar tabular data into sandboxed, responsive in-chat visualizations with validated encodings, legends, tooltips, zooming, and bar, line, area, scatter, pie, and heatmap chart types.
dataviz-mcp.zh: D3-powered MCP 应用程序服务器，可将紧凑的柱状表格数据转换为沙盒、响应式聊天内可视化效果，具有经过验证的编码、图例、工具提示、缩放以及条形图、折线图、面积图、散点图、饼图和热图图表类型。

TableKit.source: Remote MCP server for asking ChatGPT or Claude database questions and receiving interactive in-chat charts, SQL review widgets, JSON/CSV export, read-only query controls, OAuth, SSH tunneling, and Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, and BigQuery connectors.
TableKit.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器，用于询问 ChatGPT 或 Claude 数据库问题并接收交互式聊天图表、SQL 审阅小部件、JSON/CSV 导出、只读查询控件、OAuth、SSH 隧道和 Postgres， MySQL、MariaDB 和 BigQuery 连接器。

Harnss.source: Cross-platform desktop UI for Claude Code, Codex, and ACP agents that renders tool calls as interactive cards, visualizes word-level diffs, tracks background task agents, manages MCP servers, and keeps terminal, browser, git, and file panels in one workspace.
Harnss.zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 ACP 的跨平台桌面 UI，将工具调用呈现为交互式卡，可视化字级差异，跟踪后台任务 Agent，管理 MCP 服务器，并保留终端、浏览器、 git 和文件面板位于一个工作区中。

Claude Plugins.source: Claude Code plugin collection with a Skillbook dashboard that auto-tracks skill usage, visualizes cards, category progress, achievements, and seven-day trends, plus notification panels and publish-readiness skill audit reports.
Claude Plugins.zh: Claude Code 插件集合，带有技能手册仪表盘，可自动跟踪 Skill 使用情况、可视化卡片、类别进度、成就和 7 天趋势，以及通知面板和发布准备 Skill 审核报告。

project-tracker.source: Local Claude Code skill that scans project session metadata, memories, handovers, planning files, and recent git commits to produce a sorted Markdown dashboard of projects, recency, session counts, current status, and next steps.
project-tracker.zh: 本地 Claude Code Skill 扫描项目会话元数据、内存、移交、计划文件和最近的 git 提交，以生成项目、新近度、会话计数、当前状态和后续步骤的排序 Markdown 仪表盘。

Visualization MCP Server.source: Python MCP server for creating matplotlib relationship graphs, scatter and classification plots, 3D charts, histograms, lines, and heatmaps, with live display plus high-resolution timestamped PNG exports.
Visualization MCP Server.zh: Python MCP 服务器，用于创建 matplotlib 关系图、散点图和分类图、3D 图表、直方图、线条和热图，具有实时显示以及高分辨率时间戳 PNG 导出。

banana-slides.source: AI-native Nano Banana Pro slide generator that accepts prompts, outlines, template images, and uploaded assets, supports region-level natural-language edits, and exports editable PowerPoint decks.
banana-slides.zh: AI-native Nano Banana Pro 幻灯片生成器，接受提示、轮廓、模板图像和上传的资源，支持区域级自然语言编辑，并导出可编辑的 PowerPoint 幻灯片。

pptpress.source: DSH plugin, Claude Code plugin, and CLI for stable editable PPTX generation from semantic presentation IR into native DrawingML PowerPoint output.
pptpress.zh: DSH 插件、Claude Code 插件和 CLI 用于从语义表示 IR 生成稳定的可编辑 PPTX 到本机 DrawingML PowerPoint 输出。

AppAutomaton Presentation.source: Claude Code and Codex presentation skill suite for turning business questions into consulting-grade decks through strategy storyboarding, brand identity, pixel-perfect PDF, and native editable PPTX workflows.
AppAutomaton Presentation.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 演示 Skill 套件，用于通过战略故事板、品牌标识、像素完美的 PDF 和本机可编辑 PPTX 工作流程将业务问题转化为咨询级平台。

visualkan.source: Installable AI-coding-assistant skill that converts arbitrary content into visual explanations, including whiteboard sketches, infographics, presentations, diagrams, mind maps, and UI mockups.
visualkan.zh: 可安装的 AI-coding-assistant Skill，可将任意内容转换为视觉解释，包括白板草图、信息图、演示文稿、图表、思维导图和 UI 模型。

Hexwright.source: CLI, MCP server, and web UI that renders branch-level architecture changes for hexagonal and ports-and-adapters codebases as reviewable dependency pictures with agent boundary verdicts.
Hexwright.zh: CLI、MCP 服务器和 Web UI 将六边形和端口和适配器代码库的分支级架构更改呈现为具有 Agent 边界判决的可审查依赖关系图片。

Tableau Lineage.source: Privacy-first in-browser Tableau TWBX lineage visualizer that maps calculated-field dependencies, parameters, stored SQL, metadata, and searchable data dictionaries without uploading workbooks.
Tableau Lineage.zh: 隐私优先的浏览器内 Tableau TWBX 沿袭可视化工具，可映射计算字段依赖关系、参数、存储的 SQL、元数据和可搜索数据字典，而无需上传工作簿。

open-gamma.source: Open-source AI slide agent that generates presentation slides in Google Slides-style workflows from prompts and structured presentation context.
open-gamma.zh: 开源 AI 幻灯片 Agent 可根据提示和结构化演示上下文在 Google 幻灯片式工作流程中生成演示幻灯片。

exploded-view.source: Claude presentation skill for web-native 3D explainers with model-viewer, Three.js, Draco compression, orbit viewers, exploded assemblies, and animated camera walkthroughs without a build step.
exploded-view.zh: Claude 演示 Skill 用于网络原生 3D 解释器，具有模型查看器、Three.js、Draco 压缩、轨道查看器、分解装配和动画相机演练，无需构建步骤。

clayz-presentation-skills.source: Five-stage agent presentation system for evidence-based decks, separating logic, copy, art direction, editable output, and supervisor QA, with source traceability, visual adaptation, layout contracts, and metadata tooling.
clayz-presentation-skills.zh: 五阶段 Agent 演示系统，用于基于证据的套牌、分离逻辑、复制、艺术指导、可编辑输出和主管 QA，具有源可追溯性、视觉适应、布局合同和元数据工具。

Korean Presentation Skill.source: Agent presentation skill for Korean typography-optimized consulting decks, domain-specific layouts, Marp-based PPTX/PDF/PNG compilation, PPTX extraction, schema validation, and gallery QA.
Korean Presentation Skill.zh: Agent 演示 Skill，用于韩国版式优化的咨询平台、特定于域的布局、基于 Marp 的 PPTX/PDF/PNG 编译、PPTX 提取、模式验证和图库 QA。

generate-ai-presentations-skill.source: Codex Agent Skill that turns Markdown, transcripts, course notes, Word/PDF files, web articles, or existing slide text into 16:9 presentation images, PPTX decks, per-slide image prompts, or slide planning tables.
generate-ai-presentations-skill.zh: Codex Agent Skill 将 Markdown、成绩单、课程笔记、Word/PDF 文件、网络文章或现有幻灯片文本转换为 16:9 演示图像、PPTX 幻灯片、每张幻灯片图像提示或幻灯片规划表。

Dokki Slides.source: Agent-compatible presentation skill for publishing structured decks as interactive HTML while exporting editable native PPTX objects, with layouts, semantic roles, speaker notes, and deterministic quality checks.
Dokki Slides.zh: Agent 兼容演示文稿 Skill，用于将结构化演示文稿发布为交互式 HTML，同时导出可编辑的本机 PPTX 对象，包括布局、语义角色、演讲者注释和确定性质量检查。

mzyx-presentation-skills.source: Claude Code presentation skill for building browser-presented React deck apps with responsive slides, live data, embedded prototypes, 3D scenes, presenter mode, thumbnail rails, and themed components.
mzyx-presentation-skills.zh: Claude Code 演示 Skill 用于构建浏览器呈现的 React 平台应用程序，具有响应式幻灯片、实时数据、嵌入式原型、3D 场景、演示者模式、缩略图栏和主题组件。

LangChat Slides.source: Vue and AntV infographic slide generator that converts natural-language prompts into streaming WYSIWYG slide syntax, multi-page infographic decks, conversational edits, manual code editing, and PDF/PNG/SVG/JPG/WebP/PPT export.
LangChat Slides.zh: Vue 和 AntV 信息图幻灯片生成器，可将自然语言提示转换为流式 WYSIWYG 幻灯片语法、多页信息图平台、对话式编辑、手动代码编辑和 PDF/PNG/SVG/JPG/WebP/PPT 导出。

Editorial Infographics.source: Agent Skill for evidence-led editorial infographics, news/data cards, social explainers, annotated charts, product screenshots with callouts, diagrams, batch-diverse layouts, and anti-slop quality gates.
Editorial Infographics.zh: Agent Skill 用于以证据为主导的编辑信息图、新闻/数据卡、社交解释、带注释的图表、带有标注的产品屏幕截图、图表、批量多样化布局和防倾斜质量门。

Claude Memory Knowledge Graph Visualizer.source: Local browser visualizer that turns Claude Memory MCP NDJSON into an interactive Cytoscape knowledge graph with type filters, search, tooltips, node sizing, physics controls, and demo-data fallback.
Claude Memory Knowledge Graph Visualizer.zh: 本地浏览器可视化工具，可将 Claude 内存 MCP NDJSON 转换为交互式 Cytoscape 知识图，具有类型过滤器、搜索、工具提示、节点大小调整、物理控制和演示数据回退。

Epic Infographics.source: Agent skill for polished infographic PNGs with chart vocabularies, reusable design languages, self-contained HTML/CSS/SVG generation, Playwright rendering, and render-review-fix QA loops.
Epic Infographics.zh: Agent Skill 用于精美的信息图 PNGs，具有图表词汇、可重复使用的设计语言、独立的 HTML/CSS/SVG 生成、Playwright 渲染和渲染-审核-修复 QA 循环。

slidev-mcp.source: Local MCP server for creating, editing, validating, theming, diagramming, and exporting Slidev decks through agent tools and Codex/Claude/OpenCode installer support.
slidev-mcp.zh: 本地 MCP 服务器，用于通过 Agent 工具和 Codex/Claude/OpenCode 安装程序支持创建、编辑、验证、主题化、图表化和导出 Slidev 平台。

tl-draw-mcp.source: MCP server and agent guide for drawing live tldraw canvases from prompts, with automatic graph layout, label sizing, bound connectors, shape editing, and browser canvas feedback.
tl-draw-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器和 Agent 指南，用于根据提示绘制实时 tldraw 画布，具有自动图形布局、标签大小调整、绑定连接器、形状编辑和浏览器画布反馈。

Mermaid MCP by fay-i.source: TypeScript MCP server that renders Mermaid source into durable SVG, PDF, and multi-page deck artifacts with Puppeteer, Mermaid CLI, local or S3 storage, themes, fonts, and download URLs.
Mermaid MCP by fay-i.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器，将 Mermaid 源渲染为持久的 SVG、PDF 以及带有 Puppeteer、Mermaid CLI 的多页演示文稿产物，本地或S3 存储、主题、字体以及下载 URLs。

Lucid MCP Server.source: Lucid API MCP bridge for discovering LucidChart, LucidSpark, and LucidScale documents, exporting diagram pages as PNG image blocks, and creating new Lucid diagrams from Standard Import JSON.
Lucid MCP Server.zh: Lucid API MCP 桥用于发现 LucidChart、LucidSpark 和 LucidScale 文档、将图表页面导出为 PNG 图像块以及从标准导入 JSON 创建新的 Lucid 图表。

Convex MCP Visual.source: MCP server, CLI, and Claude plugin for Convex schema browsers, component views, real-time metric dashboards, Mermaid ER diagrams, codebase subway maps, heatmaps, drift views, and kanban boards.
Convex MCP Visual.zh: MCP 服务器、CLI 和 Claude 插件，用于凸架构浏览器、组件视图、实时指标仪表盘、Mermaid ER 图表、代码库地铁地图、热图、漂移视图和看板。

Power BI PBIR MCP.source: Local stdio MCP server for Power BI PBIP/PBIR report projects, reading semantic models, applying page/visual/theme/layout plans, scaffolding projects, and validating Desktop-compatible report edits.
Power BI PBIR MCP.zh: 用于 Power BI PBIP/PBIR 报告项目的本地 stdio MCP 服务器、读取语义模型、应用页面/视觉/主题/布局计划、脚手架项目以及验证桌面兼容的报告编辑。

pbix-mcp.source: Python MCP server for creating, reading, editing, documenting, and evaluating Power BI PBIX/PBIT/PBIP files, including pages, visuals, DAX measures, data sources, themes, custom HTML/SVG visuals, and report documentation.
pbix-mcp.zh: Python MCP 服务器，用于创建、读取、编辑、记录和评估 Power BI PBIX/PBIT/PBIP 文件，包括页面、视觉效果、DAX 度量、数据源、主题、自定义 HTML/SVG 视觉效果和报告文档。

tldr-skill.source: Claude Code skill that turns a repository into a self-hosted interactive explainer website with architecture diagrams, Cytoscape dependency graphs, D3 directory mind maps, search, workflows, and module walkthroughs.
tldr-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 将存储库转变为自托管交互式解释器网站，其中包含架构图、Cytoscape 依赖关系图、D3 目录思维导图、搜索、工作流程和模块演练。

ChartPane.source: Hosted MCP App for rendering Chart.js charts and multi-chart dashboard grids inline in MCP clients, with client-side rendering and no server-side data storage.
ChartPane.zh: 托管 MCP 应用程序，用于在 MCP 客户端中内联渲染 Chart.js 图表和多图表仪表盘网格，具有客户端渲染且无服务器端数据存储。

PowerPoint MCP by Ayushmaniar.source: Windows-only PowerPoint MCP server using pywin32 COM automation for live slide creation, reading, visual snapshots, LaTeX equations, templates, animations, and real-time editing.
PowerPoint MCP by Ayushmaniar.zh: 仅适用于 Windows 的 PowerPoint MCP 服务器，使用 pywin32 COM 自动化进行实时幻灯片创建、阅读、视觉快照、LaTeX 方程、模板、动画和实时编辑。

mindmap-markmap-viewer.source: Claude Code skill that turns hierarchical Markdown into a self-contained offline markmap HTML mind map with search, expand controls, zoom, and SVG/PNG export.
mindmap-markmap-viewer.zh: Claude Code Skill 将分层 Markdown 转换为独立的离线标记图 HTML 思维导图，具有搜索、扩展控件、缩放和 SVG/PNG 导出功能。

SimpleMindMap MCP Server.source: SimpleMindMap MCP server that lets AI agents open an editor, set mind-map data, theme and layout, and export maps as image, PDF, Markdown, SVG, TXT, or XMind.
SimpleMindMap MCP Server.zh: SimpleMindMap MCP 服务器，允许 AI Agent 打开编辑器，设置思维导图数据、主题和布局，并将导图导出为图像、PDF、Markdown、SVG、TXT 或XMind。

Diagram Designer.source: MCP server that transforms Mermaid architecture descriptions into polished cloud, dark-mode, and isometric diagram images for presentations, documentation, blogs, and README files.
Diagram Designer.zh: MCP 服务器将 Mermaid 架构描述转换为精美的云、暗模式和等距图图像，用于演示文稿、文档、博客和 README 文件。

mcp-powerpoint.source: JavaScript MCP plugin and CLI for creating PowerPoint files, adding slides, reading slide metadata, and exporting presentations to PDF.
mcp-powerpoint.zh: JavaScript MCP 插件和 CLI 用于创建 PowerPoint 文件、添加幻灯片、读取幻灯片元数据以及将演示文稿导出到 PDF。

Skill Atlas.source: Local React canvas for browsing, editing, and understanding Claude Skills from a GitHub repository, with grouped skill nodes, GitHub-backed saves, and Claude-generated Mermaid flowcharts.
Skill Atlas.zh: 本地 React 画布，用于浏览、编辑和理解 GitHub 存储库中的 Claude Skills，具有分组的 Skill 节点、GitHub 支持的保存以及 Claude 生成的 Mermaid流程图。

all2md.source: Python library, CLI, and MCP server that converts PDFs, Office files, HTML, email, spreadsheets, and 40+ formats into LLM-ready Markdown, then renders Markdown back to DOCX, PDF, PPTX, HTML, and browser previews.
all2md.zh: Python 库、CLI 和 MCP 服务器，可将 PDFs、Office 文件、HTML、电子邮件、电子表格和 40 多种格式转换为 LLM-ready Markdown，然后将 Markdown 渲染回DOCX、PDF、PPTX、HTML 和浏览器预览。

Google Workspace MCP Server.source: Google Workspace MCP server and CLI with OAuth, local or remote deployment, and 120+ tools for agents to read, create, edit, and manage Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive files, Forms, and related Workspace artifacts.
Google Workspace MCP Server.zh: Google Workspace MCP 服务器和 CLI 与 OAuth、本地或远程部署以及 120 多种工具，供 Agent 读取、创建、编辑和管理 Google 文档、表格、幻灯片、云端硬盘文件、表单和相关 Workspace 产物。

claude-code-video-toolkit.source: Claude Code video-production workspace with skills, commands, templates, Remotion, FFmpeg, Playwright recording, voice, image, music, and open-model video tools for turning prompts, demos, and explainers into rendered MP4s.
claude-code-video-toolkit.zh: Claude Code 视频制作工作区，包含 Skill、命令、模板、Remotion、FFmpeg、Playwright 录制、语音、图像、音乐和开放模型视频工具，用于将提示、演示和解释转换为渲染的 MP4s。

local-dashboard-builder.source: Claude Code plugin and skill that walks a repo through a manifest-tracked workflow to scaffold zero-dependency local HTML decision dashboards from CSV, SQLite, git, subprocess, filesystem, or custom collectors.
local-dashboard-builder.zh: Claude Code 插件和 Skill 通过清单跟踪工作流程引导存储库，以从 CSV、SQLite、git、子进程、文件系统或自定义收集器构建零依赖本地 HTML 决策仪表盘。

PPT-KIT.source: PowerPoint Office add-in with an MCP bridge server, WebSocket bridge, Markdown editor, code highlighting, Mermaid rendering, and Office.js operations for creating, syncing, and manipulating live PowerPoint slides.
PPT-KIT.zh: PowerPoint Office 插件，带有 MCP 桥服务器、WebSocket 桥、Markdown 编辑器、代码突出显示、Mermaid 渲染和 Office.js 操作，用于创建、同步和操作实时 PowerPoint 幻灯片。

Xmind Generator MCP Server.source: Node.js MCP server that lets LLM clients generate editable Xmind mind maps with hierarchical topics, notes, labels, markers, and relationships, and read existing .xmind files back out as Markdown outlines.
Xmind Generator MCP Server.zh: Node.js MCP 服务器，允许 LLM 客户端生成可编辑的 Xmind 思维导图，其中包含分层主题、注释、标签、标记和关系，并读取现有 .xmind 文件作为 Markdown 轮廓。

Token Dashboard.source: Local, no-telemetry dashboard that reads Claude Code JSONL transcripts and turns them into per-prompt cost analytics, tool and file heatmaps, subagent attribution, cache analytics, project comparisons, and rule-based tips.
Token Dashboard.zh: 本地非遥测仪表盘，可读取 Claude Code JSONL 记录并将其转换为每个提示的成本分析、工具和文件热图、子代理归因、缓存分析、项目比较和基于规则的提示。

Claude Usage Dashboard.source: Dependency-free local web app and VS Code extension that scans Claude Code session logs and visualizes token usage, model mix, sessions, projects, costs, hourly activity, and collapsible Chart.js dashboard sections.
Claude Usage Dashboard.zh: 无依赖性本地 Web 应用程序和 VS 代码扩展，可扫描 Claude Code 会话日志并可视化令牌使用情况、模型组合、会话、项目、成本、每小时活动和可折叠的 Chart.js 仪表盘部分。

Napkin AI MCP Server.source: Community MCP server for Napkin AI that turns text prompts into SVG, PNG, or PPT visuals, including mind maps, flowcharts, timelines, and comparison diagrams, with local, S3, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Telegram, or Discord storage targets.
Napkin AI MCP Server.zh: 用于 Napkin AI 的社区 MCP 服务器，可将文本提示转换为 SVG、PNG 或 PPT 视觉效果，包括思维导图、流程图、时间线和比较图，与本地、S3、Google Drive、Slack、 Notion、Telegram 或 Discord 存储目标。

Infographic MCP Server by byebyebruce.source: MCP server that renders prompt-driven AntV Infographic outputs as local images or URL-served assets over stdio, Streamable HTTP, or SSE transports.
Infographic MCP Server by byebyebruce.zh: MCP 服务器，通过 stdio、Streamable HTTP 或 SSE 传输将提示驱动的 AntV Infographic 输出呈现为本地图像或 URL-served 资产。

mcp-icon.source: MCP server for semantic SVG icon search over 100,000+ infographic icons, returning SVG URLs that agents can use as visual assets in reports, diagrams, dashboards, or slide decks.
mcp-icon.zh: MCP 服务器，用于语义 SVG 图标搜索超过 100,000 个信息图图标，返回 SVG URLs，Agent 可以将其用作报告、图表、仪表盘或幻灯片中的视觉资产。

Timeline Generator MCP.source: CLI and MCP server that turns milestone data into horizontal, vertical, Gantt, roadmap, and infographic timelines exported as PNG, SVG, GIF, or MP4 with themes, animation, and collision-aware layout.
Timeline Generator MCP.zh: CLI 和 MCP 服务器将里程碑数据转换为水平、垂直、甘特图、路线图和信息图时间线，导出为 PNG、SVG、GIF 或 MP4，具有主题、动画和碰撞感知布局。

figurify-mcp.source: Python MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot Gemini/Imagen-backed generation for diagrams, infographics, and plots when the host lacks native image generation.
figurify-mcp.zh: Python MCP 服务器，当主机缺乏本机图像生成时，可提供 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 和 VS Code Copilot Gemini/Imagen 支持的图表、信息图和绘图生成。

Vibe Deck MCP.source: Template-free MCP plugin that lets local LLM agents write HTML/CSS and render visual cards, presentation pages, infographics, social carousels, and reports through Puppeteer.
Vibe Deck MCP.zh: 无模板 MCP 插件，允许本地 LLM Agent 编写 HTML/CSS 并通过 Puppeteer 渲染视觉卡、演示页面、信息图、社交轮播和报告。

Arcanea InfoGenius.source: MCP server that combines Gemini grounding with visual generation to research a topic, extract findings, and create publication-ready infographics, diagrams, charts, or styled visuals from coding-agent workflows.
Arcanea InfoGenius.zh: MCP 服务器将 Gemini 基础与视觉生成相结合，用于研究主题、提取结果，并通过编码 Agent 工作流程创建可发布的信息图、图表、图表或风格视觉效果。

VibeGraphics.source: MCP server and Gemini CLI extension that fetches GitHub repository structure, README, code, and metadata, then produces themed project infographics and optional short animated videos with generated image and animation prompts.
VibeGraphics.zh: MCP 服务器和 Gemini CLI 扩展可获取 GitHub 存储库结构、README、代码和元数据，然后生成主题项目信息图和可选的动画短片，并生成图像和动画提示。

Scientific Illustrator.source: Codex plugin and MCP toolkit that redraws uploaded scientific reference figures as editable PowerPoint, WPS Presentation, or draw.io objects with iterative preview checks and export.
Scientific Illustrator.zh: Codex 插件和 MCP 工具包，可将上传的科学参考图重新绘制为可编辑的 PowerPoint、WPS 演示文稿或带有迭代预览检查和导出的 draw.io 对象。

HermesOffice.source: Local-first AI office suite for DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF where an embedded Hermes Agent proposes auditable document, workbook, slide, and PDF edits through open-standard engines.
HermesOffice.zh: 适用于 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和 PDF 的本地优先 AI 办公套件，其中嵌入式 Hermes Agent 通过开放标准引擎提出可审核文档、工作簿、幻灯片和 PDF 编辑。

Pireel Studio.source: Open-source AI video editor with canvas and timeline editing plus chat/agent control for turning clips, media collections, captions, graphics, and reusable frames into exported videos.
Pireel Studio.zh: 开源 AI 视频编辑器，具有画布和时间线编辑功能以及聊天/Agent 控件，用于将剪辑、媒体集合、字幕、图形和可重复使用的帧转换为导出的视频。

video-shotcraft.source: Claude Code and Codex skill that turns a product brief or live page captures into cinematic Remotion promo videos using shot recipe cards, storyboards, motion previews, captions, SFX, and export templates.
video-shotcraft.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 使用拍摄配方卡、故事板、动作预览、字幕、SFX 和导出模板将产品简介或实时页面捕获转换为电影级 Remotion 宣传视频。

Cowrite.source: Local AI co-writing canvas where Codex or Claude Code use MCP and bundled skills to edit Markdown, generate article illustrations, HTML logic diagrams, editable PPTX decks, PDF previews, and social image sets.
Cowrite.zh: 本地AI共同写作画布，其中Codex或Claude Code使用MCP和捆绑的Skill来编辑Markdown，生成文章插图，HTML逻辑图，可编辑的PPTX演示文稿， PDF 预览和社交图像集。

scroll-craft.source: Claude Code skill for producing scroll-driven websites with page grammars, generated or user-provided media, ffmpeg/Playwright verification, contact sheets, and reusable scroll engines.
scroll-craft.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于生成滚动驱动的网站，具有页面语法、生成或用户提供的媒体、ffmpeg/Playwright 验证、联系表和可重复使用的滚动引擎。

drama-skills.source: Claude Code and Codex skill suite that converts ideas or long-form source material into short-drama scripts, visual bibles, asset lists, storyboards, image prompts, video prompts, and production previews.
drama-skills.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 套件可将想法或长格式源材料转换为短剧脚本、视觉圣经、资产列表、故事板、图像提示、视频提示和制作预览。

Open Science Desktop.source: Local-first AI research workbench that connects agents, notebooks, files, figures, reports, runs, and review into auditable workflows for literature surveys, experiments, manuscripts, charts, and mind maps.
Open Science Desktop.zh: 本地优先的 AI 研究工作台，将 Agent、笔记本、文件、图形、报告、运行和审查连接到文献调查、实验、手稿、图表和思维导图的可审核工作流程中。

viz-pack.source: Claude skill pack that turns notes, reports, plans, and pasted source content into diagrams, infographics, interactive explainers, and shareable dashboards.
viz-pack.zh: Claude Skill 包可将笔记、报告、计划和粘贴的源内容转换为图表、信息图、交互式解释器和可共享的仪表盘。

Claude BI Skills.source: Certified business-intelligence skill set whose Honest Dataviz skill builds reconciled charts, dashboards, and single-file HTML reports from raw business exports.
Claude BI Skills.zh: 经过认证的商业智能 Skill 集其 Honest Dataviz Skill 根据原始业务导出构建协调的图表、仪表盘和单文件 HTML 报告。

Coursewright.source: Plain-file course authoring toolkit that publishes Markdown lessons as a website, styled PDF or DOCX handouts, Canvas LMS modules, and AI-assisted course materials.
Coursewright.zh: 纯文件课程创作工具包，将 Markdown 课程发布为网站、样式为 PDF 或 DOCX 讲义、Canvas LMS 模块和 AI-assisted 课程材料。

Loopy.source: Local-first graph harness that captures agent traces, extracts editable execution graphs, and lets teams inspect, edit, replay, and run those graphs visually.
Loopy.zh: 本地优先的图形工具，可捕获 Agent 跟踪、提取可编辑的执行图形，并让团队以可视方式检查、编辑、重播和运行这些图形。

Noodle Biomedical Literature Discovery M.source: Remote MCP server and companion agent skill for biomedical literature discovery over PubMed, citation, co-citation, co-mention, and semantic graph neighborhoods.
Noodle Biomedical Literature Discovery M.zh: 远程 MCP 服务器和配套 Agent Skill，用于通过 PubMed 发现生物医学文献、引用、共同引用、共同提及和语义图邻域。

lightbrowse.source: Featherweight browser core with CLI, HTTP, and MCP interfaces that turns web pages into readability text, accessibility snapshots, screenshots, downloads, and structured session state for agents.
lightbrowse.zh: 具有 CLI、HTTP 和 MCP 接口的轻量级浏览器核心，可将网页转换为 Agent 的可读文本、可访问性快照、屏幕截图、下载和结构化会话状态。

Agent Tools Playground.source: Visual debugger for AI-agent tool calls with timeline views, input/output diffs, and performance statistics rendered in a Next.js playground.
Agent Tools Playground.zh: 用于 AI-Agent 工具调用的可视化调试器，具有时间线视图、输入/输出差异以及在 Next.js 游乐场中呈现的性能统计数据。

Agent Trace Viewer.source: Local visual debugger for LangGraph runs that loads traces, shows the executed graph path, and breaks down node, model, tool-call, and graph-overhead timings.
Agent Trace Viewer.zh: LangGraph 的本地可视化调试器运行加载跟踪，显示执行的图形路径，并分解节点、模型、工具调用和图形开销时序。

Anchor Deck.source: Local-first HTML deck editor and MCP workspace that converts AI-generated HTML or ZIP slide projects into editable decks with browser editing, AI adaptation, local agent collaboration, and HTML, PDF, PNG, or JPG export.
Anchor Deck.zh: 本地优先的 HTML 演示文稿编辑器和 MCP 工作区，可将 AI-generated HTML 或 ZIP 幻灯片项目转换为可编辑的演示文稿，具有浏览器编辑、AI 适应、本地 Agent 协作和 HTML， PDF、PNG 或 JPG 导出。

StarryKit Plugin.source: Agent plugin and hosted MCP workflow that turns an idea, image, website, or source file into editable presentations, posters, social graphics, diagrams, dashboards, and web designs with PPTX, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, HTML, or Google Slides export.
StarryKit Plugin.zh: Agent 插件和托管 MCP 工作流程，可使用 PPTX、PDF、SVG、PNG 将想法、图像、网站或源文件转换为可编辑的演示文稿、海报、社交图形、图表、仪表盘和网页设计， JPEG、HTML 或 Google 幻灯片导出。

SeaSlides.source: Typst/Touying presentation skill that reads a topic, document, or URL, plans a coherent story, selects or creates a theme, authors slides with speaker notes, compiles deliverables, and supports PDF, PNG, and PPTX output.
SeaSlides.zh: Typst/Touying 演示文稿 Skill，读取主题、文档或 URL，计划连贯的故事，选择或创建主题，作者使用演讲者注释制作幻灯片，编译可交付成果，并支持 PDF、PNG 和 PPTX 输出。

Amaroad.source: AI-first MDX slide authoring environment where Claude Code or Codex edits deck files and a Next.js browser UI previews, presents, and exports widescreen decks as PDF or PPTX with notes, components, charts, tables, and timeline layouts.
Amaroad.zh: AI-first MDX 幻灯片创作环境，其中 Claude Code 或 Codex 编辑幻灯片文件，Next.js 浏览器 UI 预览、呈现和导出宽屏幻灯片作为 PDF 或 PPTX，并带有注释，组件、图表、表格和时间线布局。

SlideFlow.source: Python reporting automation toolkit that connects CSV, JSON, Databricks, DuckDB, Redshift, and dbt sources to YAML-defined Google Slides, Google Docs, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets artifacts with Plotly charts, tables, AI text replacements, batch variants, and source citations.
SlideFlow.zh: Python 报告自动化工具包，可将 CSV、JSON、Databricks、DuckDB、Redshift 和 dbt 源连接到 YAML-defined Google Slides、Google Docs、PowerPoint 和 Google Sheets 产物以及 Plotly 图表、表格、 AI 文本替换、批次变体和源引用。

Tableau Dashboard Creator Skill.source: Claude Code plugin whose eight approval-gated skills turn a free-text dashboard request and real CSV or Tableau-published data into PRDs, data models, interactive HTML mocks, implementation specs, and experimental Replace-Data-Source-ready Tableau TWBX workbooks.
Tableau Dashboard Creator Skill.zh: Claude Code 插件，其八个经过批准的 Skill 将自由文本仪表盘请求和真实的 CSV 或 Tableau 发布的数据转换为 PRDs、数据模型、交互式 HTML 模拟、实现规范和实验性替换数据源就绪 Tableau TWBX作业簿。

CLEAR.source: IBM open-source toolkit for LLM and agentic error analysis that turns prompt/response CSVs or LangGraph, CrewAI, MLflow, and Langfuse traces into per-record critiques, recurring issue categories, scores, Streamlit dashboards, and NiceGUI workflow visualizations.
CLEAR.zh: IBM 用于 LLM 和代理错误分析的开源工具包，可将提示/响应 CSVs 或 LangGraph、CrewAI、MLflow 和 Langfuse 跟踪转换为每条记录的评论、重复出现的问题类别、分数、 Streamlit 仪表盘和 NiceGUI 工作流程可视化。

Tokdash.source: Local token and cost dashboard for AI coding tools that reads Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Kimi, Cline, and other local logs into heatmaps, session explorers, quota bars, cost views, 3D contribution calendars, and multi-server dashboards.
Tokdash.zh: AI 编码工具的本地令牌和成本仪表盘，可将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Gemini、CLI、Antigravity、Kimi、Cline 和其他本地日志读取到热图、会话资源管理器、配额栏、成本视图、3D 贡献日历中，以及多服务器仪表盘。

Auto-Slides.source: ICME 2026 multi-agent research system that converts academic PDFs into pedagogically optimized Beamer slide decks with OCR/layout extraction, content planning, verification/repair, interactive natural-language revision, themes, and optional speech scripts.
Auto-Slides.zh: ICME 2026 多 Agent 研究系统，可将学术 PDFs 转换为教学优化的 Beamer 幻灯片，具有 OCR/layout 提取、内容规划、验证/修复、交互式自然语言修订、主题和可选语音脚本。

SlideAgent.source: ACL Findings 2026 agent framework and DynaSlide benchmark for updating user-provided PowerPoint templates from natural-language instructions and database-backed chart, table, and summary changes while preserving slide layout and style.
SlideAgent.zh: ACL 调查结果 2026 Agent 框架和 DynaSlide 基准，用于根据自然语言指令和数据库支持的图表、表格和摘要更改更新用户提供的 PowerPoint 模板，同时保留幻灯片布局和样式。

PPTWork.source: Portable Anthropic-style skill pair for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Cursor that plans decks, authors slide HTML, screenshots each page, and exports PowerPoint decks through editable html2pptx-pro or pixel-faithful raster pipelines.
PPTWork.zh: 便携式 Anthropic 式 Skill 对，适用于 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 和 Cursor，用于规划演示文稿、作者幻灯片 HTML、对每个页面进行屏幕截图并通过导出 PowerPoint 演示文稿可编辑的 html2pptx-pro 或像素忠实的光栅管道。

OpenDeck.source: Portable SKILL.md deck kit for building animated, narrated HTML presentations with step reveals, tooltips, thumbnail navigation, browser-generated voice clips, offline standalone HTML export, and optional .deck packaging.
OpenDeck.zh: 便携式 SKILL.md 演示文稿套件，用于构建动画、解说 HTML 演示文稿，包括步骤显示、工具提示、缩略图导航、浏览器生成的语音剪辑、离线独立 HTML 导出和可选的 .deck 包装。

Generative UI MCP.source: MCP server that gives AI hosts on-demand design guidelines and compact prompts for generating interactive widgets, Chart.js dashboards, UI mockups, SVG art, and diagram types such as flowcharts, timelines, hierarchies, cycles, and matrices.
Generative UI MCP.zh: MCP 服务器为 AI 主机提供按需设计指南和紧凑提示，用于生成交互式小部件、Chart.js 仪表盘、UI 模型、SVG 艺术和图表类型，例如流程图、时间线、层次结构、循环和矩阵。

straightedge.source: Pure-Python diagram library, CLI, and optional MCP server that turns structured hints or agent prompts into deterministic, machine-checkable SVG diagrams and optional Manim/animated-SVG lessons with legibility and geometric proof checks.
straightedge.zh: 纯 Python 图表库、CLI 和可选的 MCP 服务器，可将结构化提示或 Agent 提示转换为确定性的、可机器检查的 SVG 图表和可选的 Manim/动画 SVG 课程，并具有易读性和几何校样检查。

MockFlow IdeaBoard MCP.source: Local MCP server for MockFlow IdeaBoard that lets agents create hosted flowcharts, mind maps, kanban boards, cloud architecture diagrams, charts, tables, spreadsheets, Gantt timelines, calendars, customer journeys, storyboards, ER diagrams, maps, and Markdown boards.
MockFlow IdeaBoard MCP.zh: 用于 MockFlow IdeaBoard 的本地 MCP 服务器，允许 Agent 创建托管流程图、思维导图、看板、云架构图、图表、表格、电子表格、甘特时间表、日历、客户旅程、故事板、ER 图表、地图和Markdown 板。

arch-viewer.source: Local MCP-native architecture viewer that scans codebases, builds a Neo4j/Qdrant-backed architecture model, serves a live dashboard, and exports standalone interactive HTML/SVG architecture diagrams with component, dependency, route, score, and anti-pattern analysis.
arch-viewer.zh: 本地 MCP-native 架构查看器，可扫描代码库、构建 Neo4j/Qdrant 支持的架构模型、提供实时仪表盘，并导出独立的交互式 HTML/SVG 架构图（包含组件、依赖项、路由、评分和反模式分析）。

whitedeck.source: Markdown-first deck compiler with a CLI, Claude skill, and MCP server that renders Keynote-style slides to self-contained HTML, PDF, editable PPTX, and native Keynote files with validation and source-note support.
whitedeck.zh: Markdown-first 演示文稿编译器，带有 CLI、Claude、Skill 和 MCP 服务器，可将 Keynote 风格的幻灯片渲染为独立的 HTML、PDF，可编辑PPTX 和本机 Keynote 文件，具有验证和源注释支持。

Presentation Delivery Skills.source: Three-skill Codex package that audits user intent, builds high-fidelity HTML decks, editable PPTX files, PDFs, prototypes, and visual demos, then reports owner-readable delivery evidence.
Presentation Delivery Skills.zh: 三个 Skill Codex 软件包可审核用户意图，构建高保真 HTML 平台、可编辑 PPTX 文件、PDFs、原型和视觉演示，然后报告所有者可读的交付证据。

techdeck.source: Agent Skill for technical-solution decks that turns a brief into a self-contained HTML presentation with PDF export, WCAG-aware themes, chart recipes, architecture-diagram support, and browser layout verification.
techdeck.zh: Agent Skill 用于技术解决方案平台，将简介转变为独立的 HTML 演示文稿，其中包含 PDF 导出、WCAG-aware 主题、图表配方、架构图支持和浏览器布局验证。
