Academic Presentation Skill.source: Codex/Claude skill that converts a source paper, thesis, or technical report into an academic conference or seminar PPTX deck plus a DOCX speaker script with figure, equation, algorithm, and render-QA guidance.
Academic Presentation Skill.zh: Codex/Claude Skill 将源论文、论文或技术报告转换为学术会议或研讨会 PPTX 演示文稿以及带有图形、方程、算法和渲染 QA 指导的 DOCX 演讲脚本。

Dia-GramV.source: Local MCP server and Svelte Flow viewer for agent-maintained, typed architecture diagrams stored as repo JSON files, with linting, flags, history, layout, and SVG export for system planning and review.
Dia-GramV.zh: 本地 MCP 服务器和 Svelte 流查看器，用于 Agent 维护的类型化架构图，存储为存储库 JSON 文件，具有 linting、标志、历史记录、布局和 SVG 导出，以供系统规划和审查。

EditItAll MCP.source: Local MCP bridge for EditItAll that lets agents drive in-browser photo, vector, PDF, spreadsheet, Word, and slide editors while keeping files on the user's machine.
EditItAll MCP.zh: EditItAll 的本地 MCP 桥接器允许 Agent 驱动浏览器内的照片、矢量、PDF、电子表格、Word 和幻灯片编辑器，同时将文件保留在用户的计算机上。

agenttrail.source: Local zero-dependency dashboard that turns Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and repo activity into a zoomable live map of repositories, components, file changes, run cards, todos, ownership, status, and dependencies.
agenttrail.zh: 本地零依赖仪表盘，可将 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 和存储库活动转换为存储库、组件、文件更改、运行卡、待办事项、所有权、状态和依赖项的可缩放实时地图。

FlexViz.source: AI-native Python dashboard library that lets agents build interactive Polars-backed dashboards for 100M-row datasets, serve the result locally, and read user zoom, brush, and selection state as structured context.
FlexViz.zh: AI 原生的 Python 仪表盘库，支持 Agent 为基于 Polars 的 1 亿行数据集构建交互式仪表盘，在本地提供页面，并将用户的缩放、框选与选择状态转成结构化上下文。

Deckary PowerPoint MCP.source: Hosted MCP server and Office add-in that lets Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents inspect, render, create, and make targeted edits to the live PowerPoint presentation already open on the user's computer.
Deckary PowerPoint MCP.zh: 托管 MCP 服务器和 Office 插件，允许 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和其他 Agent 检查、渲染、创建已在用户计算机上打开的实时 PowerPoint 演示文稿并进行有针对性的编辑。

KitchenSink4PPT.source: PowerPoint MCP server with 138 tools for native PPTX reading, editing, tables, charts, comments, animations, exports, and SVG-to-editable-PowerPoint-shape compilation with glued connectors.
KitchenSink4PPT.zh: PowerPoint MCP 服务器，带有 138 个工具，用于本机 PPTX 读取、编辑、表格、图表、注释、动画、导出以及使用粘合连接器进行 SVG-to-editable-PowerPoint-shape 编译。

Pacific Data Hub Agent MCP.source: General-purpose MCP server and analyst workflow that searches the live Pacific Data Hub SDMX catalog, retrieves real data, analyzes evidence, and writes sourced PowerPoint report decks with editable native charts.
Pacific Data Hub Agent MCP.zh: 通用 MCP 服务器和分析师工作流程，用于搜索实时太平洋数据中心 SDMX 目录、检索真实数据、分析证据并使用可编辑的本机图表编写来源 PowerPoint 报告。

pptlive.source: Windows Python library, CLI, and MCP server for driving a running Microsoft PowerPoint instance through COM automation, including live reads, slide edits, charts, SmartArt, comments, snapshots, PDF export, and video export.
pptlive.zh: Windows Python 库、CLI 和 MCP 服务器，用于通过 COM 自动化驱动正在运行的 Microsoft PowerPoint 实例，包括实时阅读、幻灯片编辑、图表、SmartArt、评论、快照、PDF 导出和视频导出。

Deckyard.source: Self-hosted MCP-native presentation platform for creating, presenting, publishing, collaborating on, and iterating typed slide decks with BYO LLM providers, themes, comments, audience interactions, and HTML previews.
Deckyard.zh: 自托管 MCP-native 演示平台，用于使用 BYO LLM 提供程序、主题、评论、观众互动和 HTML 预览来创建、演示、发布、协作和迭代类型幻灯片。

Keynote Harvest MCP.source: Local stdio MCP server that turns Keynote exports and PDFs into portable slide previews, extracted text, embedded-image assets, and versioned manifests with path-safe resource boundaries.
Keynote Harvest MCP.zh: 本地 stdio MCP 服务器，可将 Keynote 导出和 PDFs 转换为便携式幻灯片预览、提取的文本、嵌入图像资源以及具有路径安全资源边界的版本化清单。

DotMD Skills.source: Official DotMD skill suite and MCP setup for live Markdown-native Docs, Slides, and Sheets collaboration, letting AI assistants draft, revise, comment, prepare decks, update trackers, and preserve GitHub-synced portable content.
DotMD Skills.zh: 官方 DotMD Skill 套件和 MCP 设置，用于实时 Markdown 原生文档、幻灯片和表格协作，让 AI 助手起草、修改、评论、准备幻灯片、更新跟踪器并保留 GitHub 同步的便携式内容。

HTML Slide Studio.source: Markdown-first React, Marp, and CodeMirror presentation workspace with live slide previews, Mermaid editing, style presets, offline self-contained HTML export, and a constrained local MCP server for agent deck authoring.
HTML Slide Studio.zh: Markdown-第一个 React、Marp 和 CodeMirror 演示工作区，具有实时幻灯片预览、Mermaid 编辑、样式预设、离线独立 HTML 导出以及用于 Agent 平台的受限本地 MCP 服务器创作。

PPT Agent Kit.source: Provider-neutral PowerPoint toolkit that separates deck planning, PPTX building, inspection, QA, MCP serving, reusable agent skills, and Codex/Claude adapters for agent-driven editable presentation workflows.
PPT Agent Kit.zh: 提供商中立的 PowerPoint 工具包，可分离演示文稿规划、PPTX 构建、检查、QA、MCP 服务、可重复使用的 Agent、Skill 和 Codex/Claude 适配器适用于 Agent 驱动的可编辑演示工作流程。

OutSlide MCP.source: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for Codex, Claude, and other agents that turns topics or inline CSV/JSON into structured 3-8 slide presentation outlines plus continuation links into the OutSlide web workspace.
OutSlide MCP.zh: 用于 Codex、Claude 和其他 Agent 的托管 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务器，将主题或内联 CSV/JSON 转换为结构化的 3-8 幻灯片演示大纲以及指向 OutSlide Web 工作区的连续链接。

decklet.source: Claude Code and Codex skill plus plain-Node CLI that turns arbitrary content into a self-contained editable HTML slide deck with JSON model, in-file editor, PDF writer, and layout verification gate.
decklet.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 加上普通节点 CLI，可将任意内容转换为独立的可编辑 HTML 幻灯片，其中包含 JSON 模型、文件内编辑器、PDF 编写器和布局验证门。

Mirofy.source: Agent skill and CLI that scans repositories into evidence graphs, models system structure, and renders searchable self-contained HTML architecture, dataflow, sequence, state-machine, and dependency diagrams with cited source coverage.
Mirofy.zh: Agent Skill 和 CLI 将存储库扫描为证据图，对系统结构进行建模，并呈现可搜索的独立 HTML 架构、数据流、序列、状态机和具有引用源覆盖范围的依赖关系图。

codex-tldraw-mcp.source: Local Codex stdio MCP server that scans repositories or prompt specs into editable repo-local tldraw boards, SVG previews, runtime architecture diagrams, workflow canvases, and trackable JavaScript/TypeScript code graphs with drift markers.
codex-tldraw-mcp.zh: 本地 Codex stdio MCP 服务器，可将存储库或提示规范扫描到可编辑的存储库本地 tldraw 板、SVG 预览、运行时架构图、工作流程画布以及带有漂移标记的可跟踪 JavaScript/TypeScript 代码图。

Agent Review Panel.source: Claude Code plugin and skill that runs a multi-agent adversarial review panel over code, plans, or docs, then writes Markdown process records plus an interactive HTML dashboard with issue cards, charts, and review evidence.
Agent Review Panel.zh: Claude Code 插件和 Skill，在代码、计划或文档上运行多个 Agent 对抗性审查小组，然后写入 Markdown 流程记录以及带有问题卡、图表和审查证据的交互式 HTML 仪表盘。

eval-layer.source: Claude Code skill that adds rubric-based evaluation to agent projects, generating calibrated test cases, judge prompts, harness outputs, Markdown reports, and self-contained Chart.js dashboards for multi-subject benchmark comparisons.
eval-layer.zh: Claude Code Skill 为 Agent 项目添加基于标题的评估，生成校准测试用例、判断提示、利用输出、Markdown 报告和用于多主题基准比较的独立 Chart.js 仪表盘。

ArchLex.source: Cloud-diagram DSL, hosted MCP server, and agent skill for asking Claude, Cursor, or Codex to validate AWS, GCP, or Kubernetes architecture descriptions and render official-icon SVG diagrams plus playground links.
ArchLex.zh: 云图 DSL、托管 MCP 服务器和 Agent Skill，用于请求 Claude、Cursor 或 Codex 验证 AWS， GCP，或 Kubernetes 架构描述和渲染官方图标 SVG 图表以及游乐场链接。

diag-agent.source: LLM-agnostic CLI, MCP server, and Python library that turns natural-language architecture descriptions into PlantUML, C4, BPMN, Mermaid, and other Kroki-rendered diagrams with autonomous syntax validation and optional vision-based design feedback.
diag-agent.zh: LLM-agnostic CLI、MCP 服务器和 Python 库，可将自然语言架构描述转换为 PlantUML、C4、BPMN、Mermaid 和其他 Kroki 渲染图，具有自主语法验证和可选的基于视觉的设计反馈。

Diagrammo MCP.source: Local MCP server for Claude and MCP-compatible tools that renders DGMO text markup into sequence, flowchart, ER, C4, Gantt, and other diagrams as SVG/PNG, previews them in HTML, and hands them to Diagrammo editors.
Diagrammo MCP.zh: 用于 Claude 和 MCP-compatible 工具的本地 MCP 服务器，将 DGMO 文本标记渲染为序列、流程图、ER、C4、甘特图和其他图表作为 SVG/PNG，在中预览它们HTML，并将它们交给Diagrammo编辑。

metro-map-tool.source: Browser designer, CLI, MCP server, and agent skill for transforming JSON transit-map specs into standalone light/dark-aware SVG diagrams for landscapes, pipelines, migrations, docs, and slide-friendly process maps.
metro-map-tool.zh: 浏览器设计器、CLI、MCP 服务器和 Agent Skill，用于将 JSON 交通地图规范转换为独立的明/暗感知 SVG 图表，用于景观、管道、迁移、文档和幻灯片友好的流程图。

Data Science Agent.source: Verifiable AI data scientist for CSVs and databases that executes SQL, statistics, machine learning, and visualizations, then returns claim-level evidence, reproducible reports, notebooks, plots, and inspectable artifacts through CLI and hosted demo flows.
Data Science Agent.zh: CSVs 和数据库的可验证 AI 数据科学家，执行 SQL、统计、机器学习和可视化，然后通过 CLI 和托管演示流程返回声明级证据、可重复报告、笔记本、绘图和可检查产物。

Harness Anything.source: Windows-oriented AI agent control hub for WPS, Microsoft Office, Zotero, and Illustrator automation, including PowerPoint slide creation, SVG-to-PPTX, academic visualization skills, and export to PPTX, PDF, HTML, images, and vector files.
Harness Anything.zh: 面向 Windows 的 AI Agent 控制中心，用于 WPS、Microsoft Office、Zotero 和 Illustrator 自动化，包括 PowerPoint 幻灯片创建、SVG-to-PPTX、学术可视化 Skill 以及导出到 PPTX， PDF、HTML、图像和矢量文件。

speaker.source: Codex skill project that reads real PowerPoint decks, renders slides, extracts text, charts, tables, and OCR evidence, then writes grounded rehearsal documents and clean speaker notes back into the PPTX notes pane.
speaker.zh: Codex Skill 项目读取真实的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，渲染幻灯片，提取文本、图表、表格和 OCR 证据，然后将基础排练文档和干净的演讲者笔记写回到 PPTX 笔记窗格中。

scholar-ppt-cn.source: Chinese academic PPT skill for Codex and ChatGPT that turns papers, reports, outlines, figures, and existing decks into editable, template-aware PPTX files with preview rendering and quality checks.
scholar-ppt-cn.zh: 中国学者 PPT Skill 用于 Codex 和 ChatGPT，将论文、报告、大纲、图表和现有平台转换为可编辑、模板感知的 PPTX 文件，并具有预览渲染和质量检查功能。

paper-analyst.source: Claude Code paper-analysis skill with quick, standard, extended, presentation, and presentation-with-figures modes, producing evidence-tagged summaries, slide outlines, extracted figures, and automated PPTX decks via a PPTX skill.
paper-analyst.zh: Claude Code 论文分析 Skill 具有快速、标准、扩展、演示和图形演示模式，通过 PPTX Skill 生成带证据标记的摘要、幻灯片大纲、提取的图形和自动化 PPTX 平台。

Paper Figure PPTX Skill.source: Codex skill for reconstructing academic paper figures, screenshots, and technical diagrams into visually faithful editable PowerPoint slides with LibreOffice-rendered validation, side-by-side comparisons, diff images, and source scripts.
Paper Figure PPTX Skill.zh: Codex Skill 用于将学术论文图表、屏幕截图和技术图表重建为视觉上忠实的可编辑 PowerPoint 幻灯片，并具有 LibreOffice 渲染的验证、并排比较、差异图像和源脚本。

Academic Poster Generator Skill.source: Claude Code skill and reference implementation for generating publication-quality academic conference posters as editable PPTX files from paper source, figures, and iterative design requests, with terminal preview rendering.
Academic Poster Generator Skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 和参考实现，用于根据纸张来源、图形和迭代设计请求生成出版质量的学术会议海报作为可编辑的 PPTX 文件，并具有终端预览渲染。

WorkBuddy Skills.source: WorkBuddy agent-skill collection with frontend-slides for self-contained HTML presentations, pptx-generator for PptxGenJS decks and existing PPTX edits, and academic-research pipelines for long-form research artifacts.
WorkBuddy Skills.zh: WorkBuddy Agent-Skill 集合，包含用于独立 HTML 演示的前端幻灯片、用于 PptxGenJS 演示文稿和现有 PPTX 编辑的 pptx 生成器，以及用于长格式研究产物的学术研究管道。

Data-to-Dashboard.source: Research prototype for automating the data-to-dashboard pipeline with modular LLM agents for domain detection, concept extraction, multi-perspective analysis generation, self-reflection, and human-in-the-loop validation.
Data-to-Dashboard.zh: 使用模块化 LLM Agent 实现数据到仪表盘管道自动化的研究原型，用于领域检测、概念提取、多视角分析生成、自我反思和人机交互验证。

DashboardQA.source: Benchmark and dataset for evaluating multimodal agents on interactive Tableau dashboard question answering, including OSWorld-based environment setup, 112 dashboards, 405 QA pairs, and open/closed-model inference scripts.
DashboardQA.zh: 用于在交互式 Tableau 仪表盘问答中评估多模式 Agent 的基准和数据集，包括基于 OSWorld 的环境设置、112 个仪表盘、405 个 QA 对以及开放/封闭模型推理脚本。

Power BI Visualization Expert Mode.source: GitHub Copilot custom agent for Power BI report design and visualization guidance, using Microsoft documentation to advise chart selection, page layout, interactivity, mobile design, and performance patterns for dashboards.
Power BI Visualization Expert Mode.zh: GitHub Copilot 定制 Agent for Power BI 报告设计和可视化指南，使用 Microsoft 文档为仪表盘的图表选择、页面布局、交互性、移动设计和性能模式提供建议。

keynot.source: Claude Code skill that turns prompts, brand guides, and presentation briefs into single-file HTML decks with navigation, fullscreen mode, reveal animations, PDF export, and optional python-pptx export.
keynot.zh: Claude Code Skill 将提示、品牌指南和演示简介转换为单文件 HTML 平台，具有导航、全屏模式、显示动画、PDF 导出和可选的 python-pptx 导出。

html-to-editable-pptx.source: Agent skill and Python CLI that converts HTML slide decks into editable PowerPoint objects, preserving native text, shapes, tables, fonts, and side-by-side visual audit material instead of flattening every slide to screenshots.
html-to-editable-pptx.zh: Agent Skill 和 Python CLI 将 HTML 幻灯片组转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 对象，保留原生文本、形状、表格、字体和并排视觉审核材料，而不是将每张幻灯片展平为屏幕截图。

CF DevTools.source: Claude Code plugin with a Slidev presentation skill for developer-focused decks, including planning commands, codebase-to-presentation workflow, presenter notes, and PDF/PNG export.
CF DevTools.zh: Claude Code 插件，带有 Slidev 演示 Skill，适用于以开发人员为中心的平台，包括规划命令、代码库到演示的工作流程、演示者注释和 PDF/PNG 导出。

TD Skills.source: Treasure Data Claude Code skill collection with Plotly visualization guidance, grid-dashboard and action-report references, SEO/AEO dashboards, brand-compliance visual dashboards, and React dashboard rendering workflows.
TD Skills.zh: Treasure Data Claude Code Skill 集合，包含 Plotly 可视化指南、网格仪表盘和行动报告参考、SEO/AEO 仪表盘、品牌合规性可视化仪表盘和 React 仪表盘渲染工作流程。

PowerPoint MCP by kzarzycki.source: MCP server and Codex/Claude plugin that manipulates live open PowerPoint decks on macOS and PowerPoint Web through Office.js, with instant slide edits through an HTTP MCP bridge and Office add-in.
PowerPoint MCP by kzarzycki.zh: MCP 服务器和 Codex/Claude 插件，通过 Office.js 操作 macOS 和 PowerPoint Web 上实时打开的 PowerPoint 平台，通过 HTTP MCP 桥和 Office 进行即时幻灯片编辑插件。

dsh-ppt.source: DeepSeek Harness presentation skill and tool plugin that turns a sentence, paragraph, or Markdown document into bilingual HTML slideshows, editable PPTX decks, slide manifests, speaker notes, and themed motion.
dsh-ppt.zh: DeepSeek 利用演示文稿 Skill 和工具插件，将句子、段落或 Markdown 文档转换为双语 HTML 幻灯片、可编辑的 PPTX 幻灯片、幻灯片清单、演讲者注释和主题运动。

Spec-Driven Presentation Maker.source: AWS sample toolkit for spec-driven presentation generation, routing agents through briefing, outline, art direction, composition, review, PPTX import/edit sync, style guides, translation, local MCP, and optional AWS deployment.
Spec-Driven Presentation Maker.zh: AWS 示例工具包，用于生成规范驱动的演示文稿，通过简报、大纲、艺术指导、构图、审阅、PPTX 导入/编辑同步、风格指南、翻译、本地 MCP 和可选的 AWS 路由 Agent。

2slides Skills.source: Claude Code skill for 2slides API presentation generation from text, reference images, custom PDFs, documents, and multilingual themes, with slide PNG export, voice narration, async generation, and optional MCP integration.
2slides Skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于从文本、参考图像、自定义 PDFs、文档和多语言主题生成 2 张幻灯片 API 演示文稿，并具有幻灯片 PNG 导出、语音旁白、异步生成和可选的 MCP 集成。

Squinch.source: Agent-native architecture-diagram DSL and renderer that lets coding agents write checked .squinch models, then produces deterministic SVG and interactive zoomable HTML diagrams with vendor icons and C4-style drill-down.
Squinch.zh: Agent-本机架构图 DSL 和渲染器，允许编码 Agent 写入检查的 .squinch 模型，然后生成确定性 SVG 和交互式可缩放 HTML 图表，其中包含供应商图标和 C4-style 深入分析。

codebase-mindmap.source: Agent Skill that scans codebases and has the agent write a single-file interactive HTML mind map with file-tree facts, imports, LOC, expandable modules, search, hover previews, and a detail sidebar.
codebase-mindmap.zh: Agent Skill 扫描代码库并让 Agent 编写单文件交互式 HTML 思维导图，其中包含文件树事实、导入、LOC、可扩展模块、搜索、悬停预览和详细侧边栏。

Diagram Design.source: Agent Skill for Claude Code, Codex, and compatible hosts that turns architecture, flow, journey, data, Sankey, Wardley, Kanban, UML, database, and Mermaid/draw.io sources into self-contained editorial HTML and SVG diagrams.
Diagram Design.zh: Agent Skill，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和兼容主机，可将架构、流程、旅程、数据、Sankey、Wardley、看板、UML、数据库和 Mermaid/draw.io 源转换为独立的编辑HTML 和 SVG 图。

Knowledge Cat PPT Skill.source: Story-first Agent Skill for Codex and Claude Code that plans, creates, reviews, and repairs native PPTX, HTML deck, and image-first presentation workflows with evidence tracking, lane routing, and validation scripts.
Knowledge Cat PPT Skill.zh: 故事优先的 Agent Skill 适用于 Codex 和 Claude Code，可规划、创建、审查和修复本机 PPTX、HTML 平台和图像优先演示工作流程，并具有证据跟踪、通道路由和验证脚本。

open-kimi-ppt-skill.source: Unofficial Kimi Slides skill for compatible coding agents that creates, edits, reproduces, reads, and exports editable PPTD projects plus embedded-font PPTX decks, with element animations, preset themes, local browser editing, and visual QA before export.
open-kimi-ppt-skill.zh: 非官方 Kimi Slides Skill，用于兼容编码 Agent，可创建、编辑、复制、读取和导出可编辑的 PPTD 项目以及嵌入字体 PPTX 平台，具有元素动画、预设主题、本地浏览器编辑和导出前的视觉 QA。

Infographic Creator for Codex.source: Situation-aware Codex skill that routes information-design requests to AntV or Graphviz, selects patterns by semantics, and delivers editable sources plus inspected SVG outputs using a reviewed Graphviz gallery index and original DOT starters.
Infographic Creator for Codex.zh: 情境感知 Codex Skill 将信息设计请求路由到 AntV 或 Graphviz，按语义选择模式，并使用经过审查的 Graphviz 图库索引和原始 DOT 启动器提供可编辑源以及经过检查的 SVG 输出。

Show Anywhere Slide.source: Claude Code and Codex slide-generation skill that turns topics, articles, PDFs, or PPTX files into self-contained portrait-first HTML decks with a browsable 46-style gallery, click-to-edit text, embedded assets, PDF export, and optional PPTX conversion.
Show Anywhere Slide.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 幻灯片生成 Skill，可将主题、文章、PDFs 或 PPTX 文件转换为独立的纵向优先 HTML 平台，具有可浏览的 46 风格图库、点击编辑文本、嵌入式资源、 PDF 导出，以及可选的 PPTX 转换。

Codex PPT by qybaihe.source: Codex skill that builds 16:9 presentation decks through image-first and editable-PPTX modes, planning a brief, storyline, design system, storyboard, per-slide prompts, QA loop, PDF packaging, and optional native PowerPoint reconstruction.
Codex PPT by qybaihe.zh: Codex Skill 通过图像优先和可编辑的 PPTX 模式构建 16:9 演示文稿，规划简介、故事情节、设计系统、故事板、每张幻灯片提示、QA 循环、PDF 打包和可选的本机 PowerPoint 重建。

PPT Design Skill.source: Design-process-centered PowerPoint skill that uses the pptx-designer engine to plan, generate, render, visually inspect, and revise native editable PPTX/PDF/PNG decks across Build, FreeStyle, and template-driven VI modes.
PPT Design Skill.zh: 以设计流程为中心的 PowerPoint Skill，使用 pptx-designer 引擎在构建、FreeStyle 和模板驱动的 VI 模式中规划、生成、渲染、视觉检查和修改本机可编辑 PPTX/PDF/PNG 平台。

SlideCraft by wellkilo.source: AI presentation skill that turns topics, outlines, notes, and Markdown into zero-dependency animated HTML decks or fully editable PowerPoint files, with twelve curated themes, eight slide types, viewport-fit navigation, multilingual typography, and reduced-motion support.
SlideCraft by wellkilo.zh: AI 演示文稿 Skill 将主题、大纲、注释和 Markdown 转换为零依赖性动画 HTML 幻灯片或完全可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件，具有十二个精选主题、八种幻灯片类型、适合视口的导航、多语言排版和简化运动支持。

huashu-slide-codex.source: Codex-only visual-material skill that uses built-in image generation to produce image-first PPTX decks, full-screen HTML image decks, editable HTML-to-PPTX outputs, and cover images for WeChat, Bilibili, YouTube, and Xiaohongshu.
huashu-slide-codex.zh: Codex 专用视觉材料 Skill，使用内置图像生成功能来生成图像优先的 PPTX 套牌、全屏 HTML 图像套牌、可编辑的 HTML-to-PPTX 输出以及 WeChat、Bilibili、 YouTube和小红书。

deck.md.source: Open deck brief format plus deck-architect agent skill that turns approved Markdown production contracts into designer-mode PDFs or editable PowerPoint outputs, with data-analysis artifacts, asset declarations, rendered review, and versioned repair loops.
deck.md.zh: 开放式演示文稿简报格式加上演示文稿建筑师 Agent Skill，将批准的 Markdown 生产合同转换为设计师模式 PDFs 或可编辑的 PowerPoint 输出，具有数据分析产物、资产声明、渲染审查和版本化修复循环。

Instructional Agents Skills.source: Claude Code skill pack wrapping the Instructional Agents multi-agent pipeline, including LaTeX-to-editable-PPTX conversion, slide compilation, Program Chair and student slide evaluation, and full course generation with PDF and editable LaTeX outputs.
Instructional Agents Skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 包包含教学 Agent 多 Agent 管道，包括 LaTeX-可编辑-PPTX 转换、幻灯片编译、程序主席和学生幻灯片评估，以及使用 PDF 和可编辑的完整课程生成LaTeX 输出。

pptx-cn.source: Chinese-first Claude Code PPTX skill for research presentations that uses Node and PptxGenJS, with verified academic palettes, result-table and chart templates, speaker notes, existing-deck style-copy recipes, and file-corruption pitfalls.
pptx-cn.zh: 中国首个 Claude Code PPTX Skill，用于使用 Node 和 PptxGenJS 进行研究演示，具有经过验证的学术调色板、结果表和图表模板、演讲者注释、现有演示文稿样式复制配方和文件损坏陷阱。

cjl-slides.source: Claude Code skill for single-file HTML presentations with twenty-four international design styles, strict fixed-stage layout rules, multilingual style previews, and optional python-pptx conversion for editable PowerPoint output.
cjl-slides.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于单文件 HTML 演示文稿，具有二十四种国际设计风格、严格的固定阶段布局规则、多语言样式预览以及用于可编辑 PowerPoint 输出的可选 python-pptx 转换。

Git Work Report.source: Agent Skill that turns git commits from a month or sprint into a presentation-ready single-file HTML report with executive summaries, KPI cards, charts, module-grouped deliveries, migration timelines, and commit logs.
Git Work Report.zh: Agent Skill 将 git 提交从一个月或 sprint 转换为可演示的单文件 HTML 报告，其中包含执行摘要、KPI 卡、图表、模块分组交付、迁移时间表和提交日志。

HTML to PPT Deck Export.source: Preview-first Codex skill and Node.js toolkit that maps planned HTML report blocks into 16:9 PNG previews, contact sheets, image-based PowerPoint decks, and full-bleed QA reports.
HTML to PPT Deck Export.zh: 预览优先 Codex Skill 和 Node.js 工具包，将计划的 HTML 报告块映射到 16:9 PNG 预览、联系表、基于图像的 PowerPoint 平台和全出血 QA 报告。

slides-skill by Rich627.source: Agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor that separates deck content into a JSON spec and renders native editable PPTX decks with slide-type templates, evidence rules, contact-sheet rendering, and visual QA.
slides-skill by Rich627.zh: Agent Skill 适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor，将演示文稿内容分离到 JSON 规范中，并使用幻灯片类型模板、证据规则、接触表渲染和视觉呈现本机可编辑 PPTX 演示文稿QA。

LunaCore HUD.source: Electron dashboard wrapper for the Claude Code CLI with live terminal tabs, action buttons, context and usage gauges, skill/tool run tracking, active-file heatmaps, MCP server health, git status, session timelines, and media decks.
LunaCore HUD.zh: Claude Code CLI 的电子仪表盘包装器，带有实时终端选项卡、操作按钮、上下文和使用量表、Skill/工具运行跟踪、活动文件热图、MCP 服务器运行状况、git 状态、会话时间线和媒体平台。

DataGrout Smart Panels.source: Rust smart-panel model for DataGrout that stores declarative UI as logic-cell facts and renders dashboards, forms, plots, tables, and agent-authored MCP App panels through egui or MCP transports.
DataGrout Smart Panels.zh: DataGrout 的 Rust 智能面板模型，将声明性 UI 存储为逻辑单元事实，并通过 egui 或 MCP 传输呈现仪表盘、表单、绘图、表格和 Agent 创作的 MCP 应用程序面板。

Arabic Editorial Infographic.source: Claude Code skill that preserves supplied Arabic copy verbatim while mapping it into RTL editorial poster or carousel layouts, scene-only prompts, combined image prompts, archetype palettes, and sample poster/timeline renders.
Arabic Editorial Infographic.zh: Claude Code Skill 保留提供的阿拉伯文逐字副本，同时将其映射到 RTL 编辑海报或轮播布局、仅场景提示、组合图像提示、原型调色板和示例海报/时间线渲染。

affiliate-skills.source: Affiliate-marketing agent skill collection that researches programs and trends, writes data-backed content, generates infographics and landing pages, builds distribution assets, and feeds analytics back into the content flywheel.
affiliate-skills.zh: 联盟营销 Agent Skill 集合，用于研究计划和趋势、编写数据支持的内容、生成信息图和登陆页面、构建分发资产并将分析反馈到内容飞轮中。

DataInk.source: Claude Code plugin with modular data-communication skills for chart design, infographic creation, dashboard layout, table design, visualization review, and data storytelling with accessibility and RTL checks.
DataInk.zh: Claude Code 插件，具有模块化数据通信 Skill，用于图表设计、信息图创建、仪表盘布局、表格设计、可视化审查以及具有可访问性和 RTL 检查的数据故事讲述。

LightningChart JS MCP Server.source: Official LightningChart JS MCP server that gives coding agents maintained LCJS guidance for building, reviewing, or migrating high-performance charts, dashboards, and data visualizations without guessing outdated APIs.
LightningChart JS MCP Server.zh: 官方 LightningChart JS MCP 服务，为编码 Agent 提供持续维护的 LCJS 指南，用于构建、评审和迁移高性能图表、仪表盘与数据可视化，减少对过时 API 的误用。

Presentation by eruto-skills.source: Claude Code skill that plans presentation requirements, story arcs, one-claim-per-slide outlines, structure QA, and handoff routes to Marp or PPTX implementation skills.
Presentation by eruto-skills.zh: Claude Code Skill，规划演示要求、故事弧、每幻灯片一个声明大纲、结构 QA 以及到 Marp 或 PPTX 实施 Skill 的切换路线。

Create Hand-drawn AI Infographic.source: Codex skill for Chinese hand-drawn AI explainers that extracts reference-image design DNA, compresses a topic into 3-6 visual nodes, supports deterministic 4:5 normalization, and archives prompt/source evidence.
Create Hand-drawn AI Infographic.zh: Codex Skill 用于中文手绘 AI 解释器，提取参考图像设计 DNA，将主题压缩为 3-6 个视觉节点，支持确定性 4:5 标准化，并归档提示/源证据。

diagram-studio-mcp.source: MCP server that renders Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, and D2 sources through Kroki into PNG or SVG diagram artifacts for Cursor, Claude, VS Code, and other MCP clients.
diagram-studio-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器，通过 Kroki 将 Mermaid、Graphviz、PlantUML 和 D2 源渲染为 Cursor 的 PNG 或 SVG 图表产物， Claude、VS 代码和其他 MCP 客户端。

DevOps Flow Viz MCP.source: TypeScript MCP server with pure generators that turn structured DevOps pipeline, state-machine, sequence, and permission data into Mermaid diagrams, plus optional AgentCraftworks REST integration.
DevOps Flow Viz MCP.zh: TypeScript MCP 服务器具有纯生成器，可将结构化 DevOps 管道、状态机、序列和权限数据转换为 Mermaid 图表，以及可选的 AgentCraftworks REST 集成。

AgenticMap.source: MCP-backed architecture map server where Claude agents push structured graph data into per-repository diagram namespaces, version history, Mermaid fallback output, and an interactive React Flow UI.
AgenticMap.zh: MCP-backed 架构映射服务器，其中 Claude Agent 将结构化图形数据推送到每个存储库图表命名空间、版本历史记录、Mermaid 后备输出和交互式 React 流 UI。

CN Exec Dashboard Skill.source: Chinese executive-dashboard Claude Code skill that converts screenshots or business data into one-page, no-scroll, offline HTML dashboards with hand-authored SVG charts and vector-PDF print output.
CN Exec Dashboard Skill.zh: 中文执行仪表盘 Claude Code Skill，可将屏幕截图或业务数据转换为一页、无滚动、离线 HTML 仪表盘，并带有手工编写的 SVG 图表和矢量 PDF 打印输出。

PBI Claude Toolkit.source: Claude Code toolkit for Power BI PBIP projects that reads TMDL models, designs native visual plans, inserts visuals into report.json through Python scripts, and validates dashboard layouts after explicit approval.
PBI Claude Toolkit.zh: 适用于 Power BI PBIP 项目的 Claude Code 工具包，可读取 TMDL 模型、设计本机视觉计划、通过 Python 脚本将视觉效果插入到 report.json 中，并在明确批准后验证仪表盘布局。

claude-prospector.source: Claude Code plugin and Python CLI that reads local session JSONL logs to generate usage-analysis reports, interactive token dashboards, skill/adoption breakdowns, and configuration-overlap audits.
claude-prospector.zh: Claude Code 插件和 Python CLI 读取本地会话 JSONL 日志以生成使用分析报告、交互式令牌仪表盘、Skill/采用故障和配置重叠审核。

Vizboard.source: AgentSkills-compatible skill for turning Excel, CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, or pasted data into standalone interactive HTML dashboards with VChart, KPI cards, themes, tables, and automatic chart selection.
Vizboard.zh: AgentSkills 兼容 Skill，用于将 Excel、CSV、TSV、JSON、JSONL 或粘贴数据到带有 VChart 的独立交互式 HTML 仪表盘中， KPI 卡片、主题、表格和自动图表选择。

Kubedian.source: Kubernetes manifest topology tool that indexes Kustomize, Helm, Istio, Ingress, NetworkPolicy, and docs evidence into a SQLite service graph, then exposes CLI, MCP, Mermaid diagrams, and Markdown docs.
Kubedian.zh: Kubernetes 清单拓扑工具，可将 Kustomize、Helm、Istio、Ingress、NetworkPolicy 索引，并将证据记录到 SQLite 服务图中，然后公开 CLI、MCP、Mermaid 图表和 Markdown 文档。

Decksmith.source: MCP server for Claude Code that turns Markdown briefs into reviewed slide plans, gated visual briefs, consistent on-brand slide images, reusable visual systems, prompt previews, and resumable per-slide generation artifacts.
Decksmith.zh: 适用于 Claude Code 的 MCP 服务器，可将 Markdown 简报转换为审阅的幻灯片计划、门控视觉简报、一致的品牌幻灯片图像、可重复使用的视觉系统、提示预览和可恢复的每幻灯片生成产物。

Agent Dashboard.source: Self-hosted browser dashboard where AI agents report MCP status updates with markdown, images, video, tasks, project feeds, approval forms, themed project pages, and shareable update cards.
Agent Dashboard.zh: 自托管的浏览器仪表盘，供 AI Agent 通过 MCP 报告状态更新，支持 Markdown、图片、视频、任务、项目动态、审批表单、主题项目页和可分享的更新卡片。

Agent Reliability Lab.source: Reliability-engineering platform for tool-using agents that runs deterministic fault injection, stateful invariant checks, reproducible replay, CLI/CI gates, MCP access, and dashboard-style trace/report artifacts.
Agent Reliability Lab.zh: 用于使用 Agent 工具的可靠性工程平台，运行确定性故障注入、状态不变检查、可重现重放、CLI/CI 门、MCP 访问和仪表盘式跟踪/报告产物。

PowerPoint Generator Skill.source: Agent skill over a PowerPoint MCP server that blocks until requirements and outlines are approved, batch-builds editable slides, enforces presentation design standards, and runs whole-deck QA for overlap, readability, and text fit.
PowerPoint Generator Skill.zh: Agent Skill 通过 PowerPoint MCP 服务器进行阻塞，直至需求和大纲获得批准，批量构建可编辑幻灯片，强制执行演示设计标准，并运行整套 QA 以实现重叠、可读性和文本适合。

Findings Visualizer.source: Devin and Claude Code skill that converts structured audit findings, feature trackers, release checklists, and tool comparisons into self-contained offline HTML dashboards with filters, charts, themes, branding, print/PDF, and JSON export.
Findings Visualizer.zh: Devin 和 Claude Code Skill 将结构化审计结果、功能跟踪器、发布清单和工具比较转换为独立的离线 HTML 仪表盘，其中包含筛选器、图表、主题、品牌、打印/PDF 和 JSON 导出。

PowerPoint Design Power.source: Kiro Power that layers presentation-specific instructions, workflows, design guidelines, template handling, and natural-language deck editing on top of a local PowerPoint MCP server for .pptx creation and export.
PowerPoint Design Power.zh: Kiro Power 在本地 PowerPoint MCP 服务器之上分层演示特定指令、工作流程、设计指南、模板处理和自然语言平台编辑，以进行 .pptx 创建和导出。

AI Presentation Generator by Amit.source: Self-hosted web app and MCP server that route a topic through an n8n workflow, render service, Playwright, and pptxgenjs to produce previewable PDF and editable PowerPoint decks with tone themes, photos, and varied layouts.
AI Presentation Generator by Amit.zh: 自托管 Web 应用程序和 MCP 服务器，通过 n8n 工作流程、渲染服务、Playwright 和 pptxgenjs 路由主题，以生成具有色调主题、照片和各种布局的可预览 PDF 和可编辑 PowerPoint 平台。

canva-slide-layouts.source: Markdown-first slide layout library and ontology with flat frontmatter, geometry tables, per-presentation projects, an Obsidian vault, PowerShell tooling, and a batch Canva MCP upload pipeline.
canva-slide-layouts.zh: Markdown-第一个幻灯片布局库和本体，具有平面前台内容、几何表、每个演示项目、Obsidian 库、PowerShell 工具和批量 Canva MCP 上传管道。

Tenet Skills.source: Claude Code plugin with coordinated application-health audit skills that aggregate deterministic tool output and AI judgment into structured JSON reports, per-dimension scores, actionable findings, and optional Tenet dashboard uploads.
Tenet Skills.zh: Claude Code 插件具有协调的应用程序运行状况审核 Skill，可将确定性工具输出和 AI 判断聚合到结构化 JSON 报告、每维度分数、可操作的结果和可选的 Tenet 仪表盘上传中。

dashboard-canvas.source: Claude Code skill that profiles spreadsheets, cleans CSV/XLSX inputs with standard-library Python, chooses KPI questions, renders dependency-free inline SVG charts, and lays them out as Claude Design dashboard artboards.
dashboard-canvas.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于分析电子表格、使用标准库 Python 清理 CSV/XLSX 输入、选择 KPI 问题、渲染无依赖性内联 SVG 图表，并将其布局为 Claude Design 仪表盘画板。

ADHDev.source: Self-hosted agent control plane with browser and phone dashboards for launching, watching, approving, steering, and merging Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi, Antigravity, and other coding-agent sessions across isolated worktrees.
ADHDev.zh: 自托管 Agent 控制平面，带有浏览器和电话仪表盘，用于跨隔离工作树启动、观看、批准、引导和合并 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi、Antigravity 和其他编码 Agent 会话。

KinetAios.source: Local-first multi-engine desktop dashboard for running Claude Code, Codex, Direct ReAct, and DeepSeek Harness side by side with session history, token/cost dashboards, memory graph visualization, screenshots, plugins, and text-to-video tools.
KinetAios.zh: 本地优先的多引擎桌面仪表盘，用于运行 Claude Code、Codex、Direct ReAct 和 DeepSeek 并排利用会话历史记录、令牌/成本仪表盘、内存图形可视化、屏幕截图、插件和文本到视频工具。

README Showcase.source: Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode skill that scans repository evidence, plans a claim-bound README redesign, generates bilingual candidates, and validates local preview assets, diagrams, screenshots, and fingerprints before any remote publishing.
README Showcase.zh: Codex、Claude Code 和 OpenCode Skill 扫描存储库证据、计划声明绑定的 README 重新设计、生成双语候选，并在任何远程发布之前验证本地预览资产、图表、屏幕截图和指纹。

hermes-web-themes.source: Theme pack and converter for Hermes Agent web dashboards, supplying 101 validated YAML dashboard themes, a preview cover, theme index, and reusable palette/layout tokens generated from the Hermes skins pack.
hermes-web-themes.zh: Hermes Agent Web 仪表盘的主题包和转换器，提供 101 个经过验证的 YAML 仪表盘主题、预览封面、主题索引以及从 Hermes 皮肤包生成的可重用调色板/布局令牌。

Mermaid Project Diagram MCP.source: MCP server that lets agents list and read local or GitHub repository files, generate Mermaid diagrams from project structure, render them through Kroki, and save the resulting PNG diagrams inside a bounded output directory.
Mermaid Project Diagram MCP.zh: MCP 服务器允许 Agent 列出并读取本地或 GitHub 存储库文件，从项目结构生成 Mermaid 图，通过 Kroki 渲染它们，并将生成的 PNG 图保存在有界输出目录中。

Mermaid MCP Server by zhouhui.source: Python MCP server for converting Mermaid chart code into PNG, JPG, SVG, and PDF artifacts with theme controls, syntax validation, built-in examples, and stdio or SSE transports backed by mermaid.ink and mermaid-cli.
Mermaid MCP Server by zhouhui.zh: Python MCP 服务器，用于将 Mermaid 图表代码转换为 PNG、JPG、SVG 和 PDF 产物，具有主题控件、语法验证、内置示例以及由 mermaid.ink 支持的 stdio 或 SSE 传输美人鱼-cli。

concept-skills.source: Agent Skills collection for concept design, semantic knowledge modeling, and presentation authoring, including an html-slides skill that turns outlines and page tables into single-file HTML decks with optional PPTX export.
concept-skills.zh: Agent Skills 集合，用于概念设计、语义知识建模和演示文稿创作，包括 html 幻灯片 Skill，可将大纲和页表转换为单文件 HTML 幻灯片，并具有可选的 PPTX 导出功能。

DocuGraph MCP.source: Rust MCP server that converts technical PDFs into hierarchical document knowledge graphs with outlines, hybrid search, adaptive context budgeting, and page/section evidence tools for AI agents.
DocuGraph MCP.zh: Rust MCP 服务器，可将技术 PDFs 转换为分层文档知识图，其中包含 AI Agent 的大纲、混合搜索、自适应上下文预算和页面/部分证据工具。

Paper2Seminar.source: Windows-focused workflow for turning research-paper PDFs into editable PowerPoint seminar decks, with PDF selection, automated slide generation, and PowerPoint handoff.
Paper2Seminar.zh: 以 Windows 为中心的工作流程，用于将研究论文 PDFs 转换为可编辑的 PowerPoint 研讨会资料，具有 PDF 选择、自动幻灯片生成和 PowerPoint 切换。

Ontology Atlas.source: Local-first ontology workspace for codebases that keeps a shared Markdown ontology, visualizes architecture and change impact for humans, and exposes the same project model to coding agents through MCP.
Ontology Atlas.zh: 用于代码库的本地优先本体工作空间，保留共享的 Markdown 本体，可视化架构和变更对人类的影响，并通过 MCP 公开相同的项目模型以编码 Agent。

chartbrew-mcp.source: MCP bridge that lets AI agents query Chartbrew teams, workspaces, datasets, dashboards, and chart configurations, with restricted modes for safer dashboard access.
chartbrew-mcp.zh: MCP 桥接器允许 AI Agent 查询 Chartbrew 团队、工作区、数据集、仪表盘和图表配置，并具有限制模式以实现更安全的仪表盘访问。

pdf-to-editable-word-skill.source: Local-first agent skill and desktop workflow for converting PDFs into editable Word documents while preserving layout, fonts, and images for downstream document editing.
pdf-to-editable-word-skill.zh: 本地优先 Agent Skill 和桌面工作流程，用于将 PDFs 转换为可编辑的 Word 文档，同时保留布局、字体和图像以供下游文档编辑。

GenOffice.source: Open-source AI Office suite and agent-ready CLI for creating, converting, reading, and editing real DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, Markdown, and HTML files locally with reviewable AI edits.
GenOffice.zh: 开源 AI Office 套件和 Agent-ready CLI，用于创建、转换、读取和编辑真实的 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、PDF、Markdown 和HTML 文件在本地进行可审阅的 AI 编辑。

Power BI Agentic Development.source: Marketplace of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric skills, subagents, hooks, and plugins for AI-assisted semantic models, DAX/TMDL workflows, reports, dashboards, and deployment pipelines.
Power BI Agentic Development.zh: Power BI 和 Microsoft Fabric Skill、AI-assisted 语义模型、DAX/TMDL 工作流、报告、仪表盘和部署管道的子代理、挂钩和插件的市场。

minidoc.source: Compact LLM-friendly DSL that compiles to polished self-contained HTML reports, dashboards, system-design docs, postmortems, experiment logs, and chart-rich documents.
minidoc.zh: 紧凑型 LLM-friendly DSL，可编译为完善的独立 HTML 报告、仪表盘、系统设计文档、事后分析、实验日志和图表丰富的文档。

SlickFast.source: Deterministic local MCP and SVG render engine for tiny chart/page specs, with 47 chart types, dashboard tiling, live chart URLs, and byte-identical image output.
SlickFast.zh: 适用于小型图表/页面规格的确定性本地 MCP 和 SVG 渲染引擎，具有 47 种图表类型、仪表盘平铺、实时图表 URLs 和字节相同的图像输出。

Bang Motion.source: Agent skill for browser motion graphics that turns prompts, brands, product demos, and explainers into a single playable index.html with video-like motion and optional MP4 export.
Bang Motion.zh: Agent Skill 用于浏览器动态图形，可将提示、品牌、产品演示和解释转换为单个可播放的 index.html，具有类似视频的动作和可选的 MP4 导出。

skills-slides.source: Claude Code skill for offline single-file HTML presentations, using tokenized aesthetics, palettes, fonts, layouts, effects, and an anti-slop checklist for varied deck designs.
skills-slides.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于离线单文件 HTML 演示，使用标记化的美学、调色板、字体、布局、效果和防倾斜清单，用于各种演示文稿设计。

Beamer Academic.source: Claude Code and Codex skill that converts thesis PDFs, Word documents, or LaTeX sources into professional Beamer defense slides with layouts, color schemes, TikZ figures, and PDF output.
Beamer Academic.zh: Claude Code 和 Codex Skill 将论文 PDFs、Word 文档或 LaTeX 源转换为专业的 Beamer 防御幻灯片，其中包含布局、配色方案、TikZ 图形和 PDF 输出。

img2ppt-lite.source: Agent-as-VLM workflow and deterministic Python pipeline that reconstructs a slide mockup image into an editable PPTX with native text boxes, draggable sprites, inpainted backgrounds, and validation reports.
img2ppt-lite.zh: Agent-as-VLM 工作流程和确定性 Python 管道，可将幻灯片模型图像重建为可编辑的 PPTX，其中包含本机文本框、可拖动精灵、修复背景和验证报告。

Archify.source: Agent skill and deterministic renderer that turns typed JSON IR into self-contained HTML/SVG architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams with PNG/SVG/WebM export.
Archify.zh: Agent Skill 与确定性渲染工具，将带类型的 JSON 中间表示转成独立 HTML/SVG 架构图、工作流图、时序图、数据流图及生命周期图，支持导出 PNG、SVG 和 WebM。

HTML Anything.source: Local-first agentic HTML editor with 75 skill templates across magazine articles, decks, posters, data reports, prototypes, cards, and Hyperframes video/storyboard surfaces.
HTML Anything.zh: 本地优先的代理 HTML 编辑器，具有 75 个 Skill 模板，涵盖杂志文章、演示文稿、海报、数据报告、原型、卡片和超帧视频/故事板表面。

Effective HTML.source: Agent skill collection for self-contained HTML artifacts, including reports, explainers, presentations, low-fidelity wireframes, working prototypes, plans, roadmaps, timelines, and diagrams.
Effective HTML.zh: Agent Skill 独立 HTML 产物的集合，包括报告、解释器、演示文稿、低保真线框图、工作原型、计划、路线图、时间表和图表。

Scientific Figure Library.source: Local-first MCP server and MCP App for importing, reviewing, publishing, searching, previewing, and materializing exact scientific figure templates across Claude Science, Wisp Science, Codex, and Cursor.
Scientific Figure Library.zh: 本地优先的 MCP 服务器和 MCP 应用程序，用于跨 Claude Science、Wisp Science、Codex 和 Cursor 导入、审阅、发布、搜索、预览和具体化精确的科学图形模板。

MCP Vega.source: Read-only Spring AI MCP server that inspects PostgreSQL schemas, executes bounded SELECT queries, and returns Vega-Lite chart specifications for bar, line, pie, area, histogram, and scatterplot visualizations.
MCP Vega.zh: 只读 Spring AI MCP 服务器，用于检查 PostgreSQL 架构、执行有界 SELECT 查询并返回条形图、折线图、饼图、面积图、直方图和散点图可视化的 Vega-Lite 图表规范。

OraViz MCP.source: Visualization-first Oracle AI Database MCP server that profiles tables and turns SQL result sets into PNG bar, line, area, scatter, pie, histogram, and vector charts with bounded read-only queries.
OraViz MCP.zh: 可视化优先的 Oracle AI 数据库 MCP 服务器，用于分析表并将 SQL 结果集转换为 PNG 条形图、折线图、面积图、散点图、饼图、直方图和带有有限只读查询的矢量图。

Mellos Mapping.source: MCP server and terminal pane for live layered dependency maps, letting coding agents declare ghost designs and light nodes up as bottom-up implementation layers are built and verified.
Mellos Mapping.zh: MCP 服务器和终端窗格用于实时分层依赖关系图，让编码 Agent 在构建和验证自下而上的实现层时声明幽灵设计和轻节点。

plot-mcp-worker.source: Cloudflare Worker MCP chart renderer that lets agents create PNG/SVG function plots, data charts, subplot grids, STEM diagrams, physics force diagrams, circuits, 3D geometry, and Venn diagrams from JSON calls.
plot-mcp-worker.zh: Cloudflare Worker MCP 图表渲染器，允许 Agent 通过 JSON 调用创建 PNG/SVG 函数图、数据图表、子图网格、STEM 图、物理力图、电路、3D 几何和维恩图。

html-deck.source: Claude Code skill for conference-quality standalone HTML slide decks with per-slide files, speaker notes, PDF export, and headless 1920x1080 overflow verification.
html-deck.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于会议质量的独立 HTML 幻灯片平台，带有每张幻灯片文件、演讲者注释、PDF 导出和无头 1920x1080 溢出验证。

fp-infographic-agent-kit.source: Backend-agnostic compiler and MCP server that turns structured briefs and data into audited fp-plan/1 infographic frames, SVG output, and native Figma Plugin API scripts.
fp-infographic-agent-kit.zh: 与后端无关的编译器和 MCP 服务器，可将结构化摘要和数据转换为经过审核的 fp-plan/1 信息图框架、SVG 输出和本机 Figma 插件 API 脚本。

aws-architecture-diagram.source: Claude Code skill for checked, print-ready AWS architecture diagrams from Python data files, with PNG, draw.io, Eraser, Figma Plugin API, and Mermaid exports plus geometry audits.
aws-architecture-diagram.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于来自 Python 数据文件的已检查、可打印的 AWS 架构图，以及 PNG、draw.io、Eraser、Figma 插件 API 和 Mermaid 导出以及几何审核。

human-review.source: Claude Code plugin skill that builds a local tabbed review page for a branch or PR, combining review decisions, diagram deltas, traces, API diffs, Code City, complexity, tests, and feature video.
human-review.zh: Claude Code 插件 Skill 为分支或 PR 构建本地选项卡式审核页面，结合审核决策、图表增量、跟踪、API 差异、代码城市、复杂性、测试和功能视频。

Turboslide.source: Agent-native slide editor with a block-document deck model, generated CLI/MCP/HTTP agent actions, browser studio, and PowerPoint export checked against the web render.
Turboslide.zh: Agent - 具有块文档平台模型的本机幻灯片编辑器、生成的 CLI/MCP/HTTP Agent 操作、浏览器工作室和针对 Web 渲染进行检查的 PowerPoint 导出。

Design Buddy.source: Visual-production Agent Skills collection for brand systems, GPT-image-2 images, diagrams, infographics, logos, slide decks, WeChat layouts, and social-image workflows across skills-compatible runtimes.
Design Buddy.zh: 视觉制作 Agent Skills 系列，适用于品牌系统、GPT-image-2 图像、图表、信息图、徽标、幻灯片、WeChat 布局以及跨 Skill 兼容运行时的社交图像工作流程。

text-to-comic.source: Agent skill draft and install snapshot for turning text, dialogs, diary/photo notes, or briefs into comics, picture books, infographics, and long-image visual narratives with structured style and storyboard schemas.
text-to-comic.zh: Agent Skill 起草并安装快照，用于将文本、对话、日记/照片笔记或简报转换为具有结构化风格和故事板模式的漫画、图画书、信息图和长图像视觉叙述。

ig-carousel-skill.source: Claude Code skill that converts articles, websites, repos, notes, reference images, or existing posts into 1080x1350 Instagram carousel artifacts with an AI-generated cover and HTML-coded value slides.
ig-carousel-skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 将文章、网站、存储库、注释、参考图像或现有帖子转换为 1080x1350 Instagram 轮播产物，并带有 AI-generated 封面和 HTML-coded 值幻灯片。

paper-to-podium.source: Script-first academic presentation skill that turns a paper and time budget into a timed talk script, distilled slides, fact checks, visual QA renders, and a print-ready podium script with page-turn cues.
paper-to-podium.zh: 脚本优先的学术演示 Skill 将论文和时间预算转化为定时演讲脚本、精炼幻灯片、事实检查、可视化 QA 渲染以及带有翻页提示的可打印讲台脚本。

claude-video-generator.source: Claude Code skill for narrated demo, walkthrough, and capability films that combine terminal recordings, browser tours, HTML slides, document captures, offline TTS narration, and audio-driven assembly.
claude-video-generator.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于解说演示、演练和功能影片，结合了终端录音、浏览器游览、HTML 幻灯片、文档捕获、离线 TTS 解说和音频驱动组件。

Markdy.source: Diagram-native DSL, browser studio, CLI, and MCP workflow for turning architecture scripts into animated step-by-step system diagrams and standalone HTML explanations.
Markdy.zh: 图本机 DSL、浏览器工作室、CLI 和 MCP 工作流程，用于将架构脚本转换为动画分步系统图和独立的 HTML 说明。

zumen.source: Text-source desktop diagram editor with automatic layout, SVG output, Mermaid and draw.io export, Markdown embeds, and an MCP server so agents can keep architecture, UML, ER, network, and UI-structure diagrams in sync.
zumen.zh: 文本源桌面图表编辑器，具有自动布局、SVG输出、Mermaid和draw.io导出、Markdown嵌入和MCP服务器，因此Agent可以保留架构、UML、ER、网络和UI-structure 图同步。

Univer.source: Office SDK and shared runtime for AI-agent-facing spreadsheets, documents, presentations, bases, boards, and embeddable productivity surfaces with canvas rendering and facade APIs.
Univer.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Office SDK 与共享运行时，覆盖电子表格、文档、演示、多维表格和画板等可嵌入的生产力界面，提供画布渲染与 facade API。

DECKBench.source: KDD 2026 benchmark and evaluation code for academic paper-to-slide generation plus multi-turn slide editing, with paper/slide metadata, simulated edit trajectories, metrics, and baseline agent pipeline.
DECKBench.zh: KDD 2026 基准和评估代码，用于学术论文到幻灯片生成以及多轮幻灯片编辑，具有论文/幻灯片元数据、模拟编辑轨迹、指标和基线 Agent 管道。

SlideForge RL.source: Reinforcement-learning environment for agentic HTML slide generation with multi-step tool use, render/aesthetic/content rewards, GRPO training, and SlideRL rollout data.
SlideForge RL.zh: 用于代理 HTML 幻灯片生成的强化学习环境，具有多步骤工具使用、渲染/美学/内容奖励、GRPO 训练和 SlideRL 推出数据。

SLIDEFORGE.source: Official implementation for controllable slide editing with Deck State Graph construction, PPTX-native object grounding, theme-preserving reconstruction, rendered verification, and self-repair.
SLIDEFORGE.zh: 正式实现可控幻灯片编辑，包括 Deck State Graph 构建、PPTX-native 对象接地、主题保留重建、渲染验证和自我修复。

DeckVoice.source: AI meeting presentation agent that ingests PPTX/PDF decks, joins Meet/Zoom/Teams through Recall.ai, presents slides as bot camera output, and answers questions grounded in indexed slide content.
DeckVoice.zh: AI 会议演示 Agent 摄取 PPTX/PDF 平台，通过 Recall.ai 加入 Meet/Zoom/Teams，将幻灯片呈现为机器人相机输出，并回答基于索引幻灯片内容的问题。

Aspose.Slides Agentic .NET Examples.source: AI-friendly validated C# example corpus for generating, analyzing, converting, charting, securing, and automating PowerPoint presentations through Aspose.Slides for .NET.
Aspose.Slides Agentic .NET Examples.zh: AI-friendly 验证了 C# 示例语料库，用于通过 Aspose.Slides for .NET 生成、分析、转换、绘制图表、保护和自动化 PowerPoint 演示文稿。

Slidra.source: Shared presentation workspace where humans edit visually and agents operate through an inspectable .slidra document, CLI actions, skills, and executable validators.
Slidra.zh: 共享演示工作区，人类可以在其中进行可视化编辑，Agent 通过可检查的 .slidra 文档、CLI 操作、Skill 和可执行验证器进行操作。

Preflight Decks.source: Agent skill for HTML presentations that asks for three concrete design directions, creates a single-file deck, and verifies projector and phone readiness before delivery.
Preflight Decks.zh: Agent Skill 用于 HTML 演示，要求提供三个具体设计方向，创建单文件平台，并在交付前验证投影仪和电话准备情况。

Claude Slides and Docs.source: Claude artifact tools for creating editable decks, documents, dashboards, designs, and small interactive tools from conversation context, with direct slide editing, in-Claude presenting, share links, and PowerPoint/PDF export.
Claude Slides and Docs.zh: Claude 产物工具，用于从对话上下文创建可编辑的平台、文档、仪表盘、设计和小型交互式工具，具有直接幻灯片编辑、Claude 内演示、共享链接和 PowerPoint/PDF 导出。

Genspark AI Slides.source: Genspark workspace feature for researching, generating, and designing presentations from prompts, with export paths to PDF, PPTX, and Google Slides.
Genspark AI Slides.zh: Genspark 工作区功能用于根据提示研究、生成和设计演示文稿，并提供 PDF、PPTX 和 Google 幻灯片的导出路径。

Pitch MCP and API.source: Pitch agent surface, MCP server, and API that let Claude turn call notes or CRM records into polished Pitch decks, edit the current slide, and trigger deck delivery from external workflows.
Pitch MCP and API.zh: 推介 Agent 界面、MCP 服务器和 API，让 Claude 将通话记录或 CRM 记录转换为精美的推介资料、编辑当前幻灯片并从外部工作流程触发资料传送。

Plus AI.source: AI assistant inside PowerPoint and Google Slides for creating presentations from prompts or uploaded PDF/DOCX/PPTX/text files, then rewriting, remixing, inserting layouts, and adding images, icons, charts, or tables.
Plus AI.zh: AI 助手位于 PowerPoint 和 Google 幻灯片中，用于根据提示或上传的 PDF/DOCX/PPTX/text 文件创建演示文稿，然后重写、重新混合、插入布局以及添加图像、图标、图表或表格。

Prezi AI.source: AI-assisted presentation platform that drafts from prompts, imports PowerPoint, Google Slides, Canva, PDF, and Word files, restyles decks, adds polls/quizzes/Q&A, and turns presentations into reusable narrated video, podcast, quiz, and share-link experiences.
Prezi AI.zh: AI-assisted 演示平台，可根据提示起草、导入 PowerPoint、Google 幻灯片、Canva、PDF 和 Word 文件、重新设计幻灯片、添加民意调查/测验/问答，并将演示文稿转变为可重复使用的旁白视频、播客、测验和共享链接体验。

postward-creative-mcp.source: Local-first MCP server that lets assistants edit video and images with ffmpeg and ImageMagick through natural language, producing portable local files without accounts, API keys, uploads, telemetry, or watermarks.
postward-creative-mcp.zh: 本地优先的 MCP 服务器，让助手通过自然语言使用 ffmpeg 和 ImageMagick 编辑视频和图像，生成便携式本地文件，无需帐户、API 密钥、上传、遥测或水印。

MaxVideoAI Plugin.source: Remote MCP/plugin package for assistant-led AI video and image production that plans shots, compares current models, budgets work, prepares exact quotes, submits one approved generation, recovers jobs, and stores outputs in the connected MaxVideoAI Library.
MaxVideoAI Plugin.zh: 远程 MCP/plugin 软件包，用于助理主导的 AI 视频和图像制作，计划镜头、比较当前模型、预算工作、准备准确的报价、提交批准的一代、恢复作业并将输出存储在连接的 MaxVideoAI 库中。

pymol-visualize-skill.source: Agent skill for headless macromolecular visualization that turns PDB, mmCIF, AlphaFold, or structure IDs into publication PNG renders, PyMOL session files, and a standalone HTML/WebGL inspection dashboard.
pymol-visualize-skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于无头大分子可视化，将 PDB、mmCIF、AlphaFold 或结构 IDs 转换为出版物 PNG 渲染、PyMOL 会话文件和独立的HTML/WebGL 检查仪表盘。

AlphaGenome Variant Visualization Skill.source: Agent skill and workbench for interpreting genetic variants across molecular modalities, then compiling Markdown interpretation plus a standalone six-panel HTML5/WebGL dashboard with 3D DNA, genome tracks, splicing views, motif inspection, and causal evidence links.
AlphaGenome Variant Visualization Skill.zh: Agent Skill 和工作台，用于解释跨分子模式的遗传变异，然后编译 Markdown 解释以及带有 3D DNA、基因组跟踪、剪接视图、基序检查和因果证据链接的独立六面板 HTML5/WebGL 仪表盘。

show-me.source: Claude Code and Claude Cowork skill that audits every number, citation, or claim by finding primary sources, capturing screenshots with highlighted passages, and embedding proof cards with source, publisher, date, excerpt, and exact link into reports or decks.
show-me.zh: Claude Code 和 Claude Cowork Skill 通过查找主要来源、捕获突出显示段落的屏幕截图以及将带有来源、出版商、日期、摘录和确切链接的证明卡嵌入到报告或平台中来审核每个数字、引文或声明。

krrish-skills.source: Claude Code skill pack whose branding skill designs SVG logo and icon marks, exports PNG sizes, and validates visual output with measurable checks for ink coverage, monochrome collapse, 16px counters, blank renders, and prior-art similarity.
krrish-skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 包的品牌 Skill 设计 SVG 徽标和图标标记，导出 PNG 尺寸，并通过可测量的检查墨水覆盖、单色折叠、16 像素计数器、空白渲染和现有技术相似性来验证视觉输出。

prax.source: Self-hosted personal knowledge base that ingests files, web pages, PDFs, figures, talks, and libraries, then searches passages and visual readings, builds evidence-linked relation graphs, and answers questions with source-cited pages and MCP access for agents.
prax.zh: 自托管个人知识库，摄取文件、网页、PDFs、图表、演讲和图书馆，然后搜索段落和视觉读物，构建证据关联的关系图，并通过引用来源的页面和 MCP 访问 Agent 来回答问题。

TokenPulse.source: Self-hosted cross-platform platform for collecting, syncing, and visualizing Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor token usage with a local agent, Go server, Vue web dashboard, device login, deduped usage events, and metadata-only upload boundaries.
TokenPulse.zh: 自托管跨平台平台，用于通过本地 Agent、Go 服务器、Vue Web 仪表盘、设备登录、重复数据删除的使用事件和仅元数据上传边界来收集、同步和可视化 Codex、Claude Code 和 Cursor 令牌使用情况。

nano-banana-pro.source: Claude Code skill for generating, editing, and compositing up to fourteen input images through Gemini image models, with explicit output filenames, selectable quality tiers, 0.5K to 4K resolution, and local file handoff for diagrams, covers, visual references, and presentation assets.
nano-banana-pro.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于通过 Gemini 图像模型生成、编辑和合成多达 14 个输入图像，具有明确的输出文件名、可选择的质量等级、0.5K 至 4K 分辨率以及图表、封面、视觉参考和演示资源的本地文件切换。

skill-generate.source: Claude Code image-generation skill for fal.ai that creates banners, covers, illustrations, and posters; it can fan out a prompt across cheaper models, require explicit confirmation before expensive final renders, and write prompt, parameter, and cost sidecars beside the generated files.
skill-generate.zh: Claude Code 图像生成 Skill for fal.ai，用于创建横幅、封面、插图和海报；它可以在更便宜的模型上扇出提示，在昂贵的最终渲染之前需要明确确认，并在生成的文件旁边写入提示、参数和成本边车。

Voice of Customer Skills.source: Claude Code skill pipeline for voice-of-customer synthesis that normalizes call recordings, reviews, chat, notes, surveys, tickets, and CRM context; clusters corroborated themes; then routes them into evidence-backed PM one-pagers, executive memos, testimonial briefs, objection maps, and dispatch drafts with exact customer quotes attached.
Voice of Customer Skills.zh: Claude Code Skill 客户语音合成管道，可规范化通话录音、评论、聊天、笔记、调查、票证和 CRM 上下文；集群证实的主题；然后将它们发送到有证据支持的 PM 单页寻呼机、执行备忘录、感言摘要、异议地图和附有准确客户报价的调度草稿中。

MCP Mermaid Validator.source: MCP server that lets AI clients validate Mermaid syntax with Mermaid CLI and return a rendered PNG image or detailed validation errors, giving agents a local feedback loop before diagrams are embedded in reports, docs, or slides.
MCP Mermaid Validator.zh: MCP 服务器允许 AI 客户端使用 Mermaid CLI 验证 Mermaid 语法，并返回渲染的 PNG 图像或详细的验证错误，从而在图表嵌入报告、文档或幻灯片之前为 Agent 提供本地反馈循环。

pptx-mcp-server by knorq-ai.source: Python MCP server and optional library for creating, reading, editing, validating, and rendering PowerPoint decks with 37 tools, composite layouts, slide previews, and built-in McKinsey, Deloitte, neutral, and IR-style themes.
pptx-mcp-server by knorq-ai.zh: Python MCP 服务器和可选库，用于创建、读取、编辑、验证和渲染 PowerPoint 平台，具有 37 个工具、复合布局、幻灯片预览以及内置 McKinsey、Deloitte、neutral 和 IR-style 主题。

html2pptx-mcp.source: MCP server and CLI that converts fixed-size, slide-oriented HTML into editable or hybrid PPTX decks by measuring the DOM in Chromium, preserving text boxes, shapes, images, SVG/canvas/video captures, and raster fallbacks for complex visual blocks.
html2pptx-mcp.zh: MCP 服务器和 CLI，通过测量 Chromium 中的 DOM，将固定大小、面向幻灯片的 HTML 转换为可编辑或混合 PPTX 平台，保留文本框、形状、图像、SVG/canvas/video 捕获和光栅复杂视觉块的后备。

VizCharter.source: Local-first Claude Code MCP studio for presentation-grade architecture diagrams, charts, KPI dashboards, and poster infographics with bundled AWS, GCP, and Azure icons, ELK auto-layout, WCAG-checked themes, re-editable .vizc.json sources, and SVG, PNG, JPG, or vector-PDF export.
VizCharter.zh: 本地优先的 Claude Code MCP 工作室，用于演示级架构图、图表、KPI 仪表盘和海报信息图，附带捆绑的 AWS、GCP 和 Azure 图标、ELK 自动布局、WCAG-checked 主题、可重新编辑的 .vizc.json 源以及 SVG、PNG、JPG 或矢量 PDF 导出。

SketchFlow.source: Canvas-based diagramming workspace with a React client and Express/Prisma server for creating documents, nodes, connectors, notes, persisted canvas images, and prompt-generated C4 or MCP diagrams inside a focused editable whiteboard.
SketchFlow.zh: 基于画布的图表工作区，带有 React 客户端和 Express/Prisma 服务器，用于在集中的可编辑白板内创建文档、节点、连接器、注释、持久画布图像以及提示生成的 C4 或 MCP 图表。

Presentation Forge.source: Portable Claude skill that turns plain-language topics, outlines, and brand references into self-contained HTML slide decks, with theme import from PowerPoint, images, or descriptions plus offline-friendly bundled output for email, local opening, or static hosting.
Presentation Forge.zh: 便携式 Claude Skill 将简单语言的主题、大纲和品牌参考转换为独立的 HTML 幻灯片，可从 PowerPoint 导入主题、图像或描述，以及用于电子邮件、本地打开或静态托管的离线友好捆绑输出。

video2ppt.source: Claude Code skill that converts YouTube URLs or local videos into polished PowerPoint decks through guided or instant modes, selecting among summary, compare, lecture, meeting, technical, trend, proposal, study, executive, and creative analysis workflows before exporting editable slides.
video2ppt.zh: Claude Code Skill，通过引导或即时模式将 YouTube URLs 或本地视频转换为精美的 PowerPoint 平台，在导出可编辑幻灯片之前在摘要、比较、讲座、会议、技术、趋势、提案、研究、执行和创意分析工作流程中进行选择。

ppt-skill by Brusdeylins.source: Deterministic PowerPoint skill and pptc CLI for LLM agents, using template-aware deck creation and editing, schema-validated atomic operations, outline-first planning, capacity checks, speaker notes, footer rules, and bundled fallback templates.
ppt-skill by Brusdeylins.zh: 确定性 PowerPoint Skill 和用于 LLM Agent 的 pptc CLI，使用模板感知的套牌创建和编辑、模式验证的原子操作、大纲优先规划、容量检查、演讲者注释、页脚规则和捆绑后备模板。

web-content-designer.source: Claude skill that transforms pasted text, articles, or URLs into production-grade single-file HTML dashboards, infographics, or one-page executive briefings with Chart.js visualizations, bilingual Korean/English prompts, scroll-spy navigation, and reference layouts.
web-content-designer.zh: Claude Skill 将粘贴的文本、文章或 URLs 转换为生产级单文件 HTML 仪表盘、信息图或一页执行简报，具有 Chart.js 可视化、韩语/英语双语提示、滚动间谍导航和参考布局。

strategy-skill.source: Claude Code strategy skill that scrapes nine live sources for a topic, extracts and clusters signals, synthesizes a Playing-to-Win strategy with inline citations, scores the result on objective and expert-panel layers, and emits a professional HTML report.
strategy-skill.zh: Claude Code 策略 Skill 抓取某个主题的 9 个实时来源，提取和聚类信号，通过内联引用综合“Playing-to-Win”策略，在客观和专家面板层上对结果进行评分，并发出专业的 HTML 报告。

Visual Research.source: Claude Code skill for brand visual research that discovers agency work, captures social presence, extracts visual assets, optionally runs Gemini vision analysis, and packages findings into a branded thirteen-section HTML report.
Visual Research.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于品牌视觉研究，发现代理工作、捕捉社会存在、提取视觉资产、可选择运行 Gemini 视觉分析，并将结果打包到品牌的十三部分 HTML 报告中。

GapHunter Skill.source: Competitor review gap-analysis skill for Claude Code that turns review sources into rigid self-contained HTML reports with tabs, filters, competitor matrices, semantic clustering, chart components, and PDF export.
GapHunter Skill.zh: 针对 Claude Code 的竞争对手评论差距分析 Skill，将评论源转换为严格的独立 HTML 报告，其中包含选项卡、过滤器、竞争对手矩阵、语义聚类、图表组件和 PDF 导出。

creator-analytics.source: Claude Code skill for turning multi-platform creator analytics exports into aligned JSON and then a PPVI-style light HTML review report page with platform-grouped metrics, reusable component references, and a local scriptable render path.
creator-analytics.zh: Claude Code Skill，用于将多平台创建者分析导出转换为对齐的 JSON，然后是 PPVI-style 轻型 HTML 审核报告页面，其中包含平台分组指标、可重用组件引用和本地可编写脚本的渲染路径。

excalidrawer.source: Code-first Excalidraw diagram generator with CLI, MCP server, and agent plugin skills for flowcharts, timelines, architecture diagrams, sequences, and comparisons, rendering deterministic .excalidraw, SVG, and PNG artifacts from structured intent.
excalidrawer.zh: 代码优先的 Excalidraw 图表生成器，带有 CLI、MCP 服务器和 Agent 插件 Skill，用于流程图、时间线、架构图、序列和比较，渲染确定性 .excalidraw、SVG 和PNG 来自结构化意图的产物。

Excalidraw Architect MCP.source: Offline MCP server that turns architecture descriptions into queryable knowledge graphs and auto-laid-out Excalidraw diagrams across architecture, sequence, state, ER, swimlane, timeline, Gantt, quadrant, funnel, and chart-like views.
Excalidraw Architect MCP.zh: 离线 MCP 服务器，可将架构描述转换为可查询的知识图和跨架构、序列、状态、ER、泳道、时间轴、甘特图、象限、漏斗和类似图表视图的自动布局 Excalidraw 图。

Excalimate.source: Excalidraw animation studio and MCP server for AI-driven diagram creation, live preview, timeline and camera animation, action-sequence generation, and export to MP4, WebM, GIF, animated SVG, Lottie, or dotLottie.
Excalimate.zh: Excalidraw 动画工作室和 MCP 服务器，用于 AI-driven 图表创建、实时预览、时间线和相机动画、动作序列生成，以及导出到 MP4、WebM、GIF、动画 SVG、Lottie 或 dotLottie。

drawmode.source: Code Mode MCP server where the LLM writes compact TypeScript against a validated Diagram SDK, Graphviz computes layout, and the tool returns Excalidraw files, URLs, PNGs, SVGs, plus editable .drawmode.ts sidecars.
drawmode.zh: 代码模式 MCP 服务器，其中 LLM 根据经过验证的图 SDK 写入紧凑的 TypeScript，Graphviz 计算布局，并且该工具返回 Excalidraw 文件、URLs、PNGs、 SVGs，加上可编辑的 .drawmode.ts sidecar。

excalidraw-render.source: Local headless Excalidraw renderer MCP for Claude Code and other clients, converting Excalidraw element JSON into PNG or SVG files through a local Chromium rendering path without sending diagram content to Excalidraw servers.
excalidraw-render.zh: 用于Claude Code和其他客户端的本地无头Excalidraw渲染器MCP，通过本地Chromium渲染路径将Excalidraw元素JSON转换为PNG或SVG文件，而不将图表内容发送到Excalidraw 服务器。

excalidraw-mcp by dtour.source: File-based MCP server that treats Excalidraw diagrams as semantic graph data, letting LLMs read, create, modify, and render flowcharts, state machines, ER diagrams, architecture diagrams, and other graph-shaped drawings.
excalidraw-mcp by dtour.zh: 基于文件的 MCP 服务器，将 Excalidraw 图视为语义图数据，让 LLMs 读取、创建、修改和渲染流程图、状态机、ER 图、架构图和其他图形绘图。

Chuk MCP PowerPoint Server.source: LLM-friendly PowerPoint MCP design system with template-first deck creation, universal component API, chart and table components, theme tokens, component registry, semantic slide tools, and optional cloud-ready storage deployment.
Chuk MCP PowerPoint Server.zh: LLM-friendly PowerPoint MCP 设计系统，具有模板优先的演示文稿创建、通用组件 API、图表和表格组件、主题令牌、组件注册表、语义幻灯片工具和可选的云就绪存储部署。

slides-skill by korbinjoe.source: Claude Code presentation skill that turns briefs, talks, and design-review needs into self-contained HTML slide decks with 50 themes, playable theme demos, speaker notes, keyboard navigation, deck-lock contracts, and strict validation.
slides-skill by korbinjoe.zh: Claude Code 演示 Skill 将简报、演讲和设计审查需求转变为独立的 HTML 幻灯片，包含 50 个主题、可播放主题演示、演讲者注释、键盘导航、演示文稿锁定合同和严格验证。

ppt-skill by cookaihq.source: AI-agent skill fork for generating single-file horizontal HTML presentations, PPT illustrations, and social covers with editorial magazine and Swiss-grid visual systems, optional Codex image-generation slots, and low-power fallback mode.
ppt-skill by cookaihq.zh: AI-Agent Skill 叉，用于生成单文件水平 HTML 演示文稿、PPT 插图以及社论杂志和 Swiss-grid 视觉系统的社交封面，可选的 Codex 图像生成插槽和低功耗回退模式。

AgentBuff Presentation Skills.source: Agent-agnostic presentation skill for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Gemini CLI, and other filesystem agents, creating HTML decks from scratch or converting PPTX files, then exporting pixel-identical PDF, PNG/JPG, or PPTX outputs.
AgentBuff Presentation Skills.zh: Agent 不可知的演示 Skill，用于 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、Gemini CLI 和其他文件系统 Agent，从头开始创建 HTML 演示文稿或转换PPTX 文件，然后导出像素相同的 PDF、PNG/JPG 或 PPTX 输出。

skill-evaluator.source: Claude Code skill-evaluation harness that runs blind A/B tests for one or more skills, measures transcript-derived token economics and judged output quality, then writes Markdown reports, summary JSON, and a zero-dependency HTML dashboard.
skill-evaluator.zh: Claude Code Skill 评估工具，对一个或多个 Skill 运行盲 A/B 测试，测量转录衍生的Token经济性并判断输出质量，然后编写 Markdown 报告、摘要 JSON 和零依赖 HTML 仪表盘。

slides by jameshemson.source: Cross-harness slide skill pack for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode that turns rough ideas into narrative outlines, on-brand editable PPTX decks, slop-check reports, and revision loops, with local Node/Python rendering and optional LibreOffice visual checks.
slides by jameshemson.zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 的交叉线束幻灯片 Skill 包，可将粗略的想法转化为叙述大纲、品牌上可编辑的 PPTX 平台、草率检查报告和修订循环，并具有本地 Node/Python 渲染和可选的 LibreOffice 视觉检查。

ClaudePowerPointSkill.source: Windows-focused Claude Code skill for production PowerPoint work through PowerPoint MCP and COM automation, emphasizing backups, open-deck targeting, screenshot QA, AI image/video insertion, Remotion motion graphics, and local desktop privacy boundaries except optional Gemini/Veo calls.
ClaudePowerPointSkill.zh: 以 Windows 为中心的 Claude Code Skill 用于生产 PowerPoint 通过 PowerPoint MCP 和 COM 自动化工作，强调备份、开放式目标、屏幕截图 QA、AI 图像/视频插入、Remotion 动态图形和本地桌面隐私边界（可选的 Gemini/Veo 调用除外）。

DERA Presentation Skill.source: Claude Code skill for professional PPTX generation with Explain, Pitch, Board, Strategy, and Teach modes, ghost-deck approval, PptxGenJS authoring, required visual elements, and LibreOffice/Poppler/Pillow QA loops for local deck validation.
DERA Presentation Skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 用于专业 PPTX 生成，具有解释、推介、董事会、策略和教学模式、幽灵演示文稿批准、PptxGenJS 创作、所需的视觉元素以及用于本地演示文稿验证的 LibreOffice/Poppler/Pillow QA 循环。

UI UX Pro Max Slides Skill.source: Strategic HTML presentation skill inside the UI/UX Pro Max skill set, combining design tokens, Chart.js data slides, responsive layouts, copywriting formulas, and local project assets to create marketing, pitch, and data-driven web decks.
UI UX Pro Max Slides Skill.zh: HTML 战略演示 Skill 位于 UI/UX Pro Max Skill 套装内，结合设计令牌、Chart.js 数据幻灯片、响应式布局、文案公式和本地项目资产，以创建营销、推介和数据驱动的网络平台。

xxc-pptx-gen.source: Claude Code PPTX-generation skill that converts Markdown or text files into editable PptxGenJS decks with auto-selected themes, reusable components, chart/table/flow slide types, and optional reflect mode using LibreOffice, Poppler, and agents for visual QA.
xxc-pptx-gen.zh: 用于生成 PPTX 的 Claude Code Skill，将 Markdown 或文本文件转换成可编辑的 PptxGenJS 演示文稿，支持自动选择主题、复用组件、图表与表格及流程页面，并可通过 LibreOffice、Poppler 和 Agent 运行可选的反思与视觉检查流程。

pptx-gen by alfonsograziano.source: TypeScript deck engine and agent skill system for editable PowerPoint output, supporting clone-and-fill from existing PPTX templates, scratch-built native-shape slides, design-system workspaces, template ingestion, screenshots, and CLI/API usage without external services for deck creation.
pptx-gen by alfonsograziano.zh: TypeScript 套牌引擎和 Agent Skill 系统，用于可编辑的 PowerPoint 输出，支持从现有 PPTX 模板进行克隆和填充、临时构建的本机形状幻灯片、设计系统工作区、模板摄取、屏幕截图和 CLI/API 使用，无需外部服务进行套牌创建。

echart-mcp-view.source: MCP Apps server that turns structured tool arguments into sandboxed ECharts views for AI agents, exposing table, line, bar, pie, scatter, radar, heatmap, funnel, gauge, hierarchy, graph, Sankey, finance, boxplot, and mixed-chart apps over stdio or localhost HTTP.
echart-mcp-view.zh: MCP 应用程序服务器，将结构化工具参数转换为 AI Agent 的沙盒 ECharts 视图，通过 stdio 或本地主机公开表格、折线、条形图、饼图、散点图、雷达、热图、漏斗、仪表、层次结构、图形、Sankey、财务、箱线图和混合图表应用程序HTTP。

Visualize Skill by melodic-software.source: Claude Code visualization-router skill that selects and renders Mermaid diagrams, markdown tables, zero-dependency SVG/CSS charts, ASCII sketches, code-shape views, local self-contained HTML pages, or published artifacts while preserving offline file delivery when requested.
Visualize Skill by melodic-software.zh: Claude Code 可视化路由 Skill，可选择并渲染 Mermaid 图解、Markdown 表格、零依赖 SVG/CSS 图表、ASCII 草图、代码结构视图、本地独立 HTML 页面或已发布的产物，并按要求保留可离线交付的文件。

Plus AI MCP.source: Official hosted Plus AI MCP and agent plugin for creating or revising professionally designed, fully editable PowerPoint decks from prompts or existing files, returning PPTX plus PDF and thumbnail artifacts through OAuth; requires a paid Plus plan and account API key, and runs presentation generation in the Plus AI workspace rather than locally.
Plus AI MCP.zh: 官方托管的 Plus AI MCP 和 Agent 插件，用于根据提示或现有文件创建或修改专业设计的、完全可编辑的 PowerPoint 套牌，通过 OAuth 返回 PPTX 加 PDF 和缩略图产物；需要付费 Plus 计划和帐户 API 密钥，并在 Plus AI 工作区而不是本地运行演示文稿生成。

ARC-DRAW.source: Local SAP-aware draw.io MCP server that turns natural-language architecture descriptions into editable live-canvas SAP BTP solution diagrams using 111 bundled icons, SAP diagram grammar, canonical patterns, and the upstream draw.io MCP rendering stack; it currently installs from source and only needs network access for the initial draw.io asset download.
ARC-DRAW.zh: 本地 SAP-aware draw.io MCP 服务器，将自然语言架构描述转换为可编辑的实时画布 SAP BTP 解决方案图，使用 111 个捆绑图标、SAP 图语法、规范模式和上游 draw.io MCP 渲染堆栈；目前它是从源代码安装的，并且只需要网络访问即可进行初始的draw.io 资源下载。

html-slides by 32Lwk.source: Agent Skill for producing self-contained 1920x1080 HTML decks with data-backed charts, diagrams, maps, tables, illustrations, speaker modes, six themes, PNG export, automated overflow and layout checks, and adversarial review; bundled fonts and assets let finished decks run offline without a model API.
html-slides by 32Lwk.zh: Agent Skill 用于制作独立的 1920x1080 HTML 平台，带有数据支持的图表、图表、地图、表格、插图、扬声器模式、六个主题、PNG 导出、自动溢出和布局检查以及对抗性审查；捆绑的字体和资源让完成的套牌可以离线运行，无需模型 API。

Consulting HTML PPT Skill.source: Agent Skill that condenses text, reports, and articles into single-file 16:9 consulting-style HTML decks, selecting among ECharts data views, SVG structural models, and categorized text layouts from bundled template libraries; SVG and text decks work offline, while data decks can swap the default CDN script for the included ECharts runtime.
Consulting HTML PPT Skill.zh: Agent Skill 将文本、报告和文章压缩为单文件 16:9 咨询式 HTML 平台，在 ECharts 数据视图、SVG 结构模型以及捆绑模板库中的分类文本布局中进行选择； SVG 和文本平台离线工作，而数据平台可以将默认的 CDN 脚本替换为包含的 ECharts 运行时。

Research2Slides.source: Evidence-traceable research presentation agent that parses PDF and LaTeX sources into structured claims, visual and evidence graphs, bilingual plans, editable PptxGenJS decks, speaker notes, PDF and PNG previews, and factual, narrative, visual, and semantic QA reports; offline drafts and a Windows local bundle avoid API calls, while live analysis supports configurable OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoints.
Research2Slides.zh: 证据可追踪的研究演示 Agent，将 PDF 和 LaTeX 来源解析为结构化声明、视觉和证据图、双语计划、可编辑的 PptxGenJS 幻灯片、演讲者笔记、PDF 和 PNG 预览以及事实、叙述、视觉和语义QA 报告；离线草稿和 Windows 本地捆绑包避免 API 调用，而实时分析支持可配置的 OpenAI 兼容响应端点。

mindlm-mcp.source: Local MCP server and CLI that turns text, Markdown, web pages, and local PDFs into editable Markdown outlines and standalone interactive Markmap HTML mind maps; it needs no account or API key in client or heuristic mode, inlines scripts for offline viewing, rejects private URL targets, and supports an optional server-side model key.
mindlm-mcp.zh: 本地 MCP 服务器和 CLI，将文本、Markdown、网页和本地 PDFs 转换为可编辑的 Markdown 轮廓和独立的交互式标记图 HTML 思维导图；它在客户端或启发式模式下不需要帐户或 API 密钥，内联脚本用于离线查看，拒绝私有 URL 目标，并支持可选的服务器端模型密钥。

Report Agent by Ivan2330.source: Agent Skill for evidence-aware topic-interest research across Wikipedia language editions, producing reproducible PDF reports, self-contained HTML dashboards, charts, CSV and JSON evidence, checked narrative answers, and integrity manifests; Wikimedia access is required for fresh studies, while bundled response caches reproduce official examples offline without a model API.
Report Agent by Ivan2330.zh: Agent Skill 用于跨维基百科语言版本的证据感知主题兴趣研究，生成可重复的 PDF 报告、独立的 HTML 仪表盘、图表、CSV 和 JSON 证据、检查的叙述性答案和完整性清单；新的研究需要访问维基媒体，而捆绑的响应缓存可以离线再现官方示例，而无需模型 API。

Manim Slide Decks Skill.source: Claude skill for building 3Blue1Brown-style animated presentations whose slides morph into one another through Manim and manim-slides, then exporting a single browser-playable HTML deck with looping animations, speaker notes, and contact sheets for visual QA; rendering is local and requires Python, Manim, manim-slides, and ffmpeg but no model API or LaTeX.
Manim Slide Decks Skill.zh: Claude Skill 用于构建 3Blue1Brown 风格的动画演示文稿，其幻灯片通过 Manim 和 manim-slides 相互变形，然后导出单个浏览器可播放的 HTML 幻灯片，其中包含循环动画、演讲者注释和视觉 QA 的联系表；渲染是本地的，需要 Python、Manim、manim-slides 和 ffmpeg，但不需要模型 API 或 LaTeX。

Cicero's Hoard.source: Local presentation workspace and MCP server that turns briefs plus TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, or PPTX sources into reviewed editable decks with citations, speaker notes, native charts, revision history, source-number checks, and PPTX, PDF, self-contained HTML, or Markdown exports; documents remain local and only numbered excerpts reach the configured model, with a rule-based fallback when no model is available.
Cicero's Hoard.zh: 本地演示工作区和 MCP 服务器将简报以及 TXT、Markdown、PDF、DOCX 或 PPTX 源文件转换为经过审阅的可编辑平台，其中包含引文、演讲者注释、本机图表、修订历史记录、源代码检查和PPTX、PDF、独立 HTML 或 Markdown 导出；文档保留在本地，只有编号的摘录到达配置的模型，当没有模型可用时，会进行基于规则的回退。

Doc and Deck Skills.source: Ten standalone agent skills spanning topic or Markdown to self-contained HTML, Markdown to editable PPTX, HTML to PPTX, and source-preserving PPTX to HTML, with forty Deep Navy and White Cobalt layouts, speaker scripts, offline single-file delivery, and checked sample decks, PDFs, screenshots, and source records.
Doc and Deck Skills.zh: 十个独立的 Agent Skill 跨越主题或 Markdown 到独立 HTML、Markdown 到可编辑 PPTX、HTML 到 PPTX，并保留源PPTX 到 HTML，包含 40 个深海军蓝和白钴布局、演讲者脚本、离线单文件交付以及检查的样本演示文稿、PDFs、屏幕截图和源记录。

PPT Skills by xu-jin-cs.source: Three Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi-compatible skills for mechanically reverse-engineering PPTX files or screenshots into reusable design schemas and skeleton packs, then generating editable native-vector decks from text with optional LibreOffice and PyMuPDF render QA; the screenshot-only extractor works without scripts or network access.
PPT Skills by xu-jin-cs.zh: 三个 Claude Code、Codex 和 Kimi 兼容的 Skill，用于将 PPTX 文件或屏幕截图机械逆向工程为可重复使用的设计模式和骨架包，然后使用可选的 LibreOffice 和 PyMuPDF 渲染从文本生成可编辑的本机矢量平台QA；仅屏幕截图提取器无需脚本或网络访问即可工作。

SVG Infographic Skill.source: Local Agent Skill for writing compact editable SVG infographics, architecture diagrams, flowcharts, comparison graphics, and README visuals with exact multilingual text, plus Chrome and Python checks for text overflow, invalid colors, blank regions, pixel coverage, and PNG export; it requires no image model, API key, per-image fee, or GPU.
SVG Infographic Skill.zh: 本地 Agent Skill，用于编写紧凑的可编辑 SVG 信息图、架构图、流程图、比较图形和具有精确多语言文本的 README 视觉效果，以及 Chrome 和 Python 检查文本溢出、无效颜色、空白区域、像素覆盖和 PNG 导出；它不需要图像模型、API 密钥、每张图像费用或 GPU。

Awesome AI Motion.source: Bilingual motion field guide and Agent Skill with 637 techniques, 128 rendered reference clips, eleven recipes, seven design routes, canonical JSON metadata, and a comparison website for choosing and adapting motion in videos, infographics, and scroll decks; browsing is dependency-free, while local rendering uses optional Node.js, Chromium, Playwright, and ffmpeg.
Awesome AI Motion.zh: 双语运动领域指南和 Agent Skill，包含 637 种技术、128 个渲染参考剪辑、11 个配方、7 条设计路线、规范的 JSON 元数据以及一个用于在视频、信息图和滚动面板中选择和调整运动的比较网站；浏览是无依赖的，而本地渲染使用可选的 Node.js、Chromium、Playwright 和 ffmpeg。

Voice Film Skill.source: Claude Code skill that turns research, reports, or product stories into one-to-four-minute voice-led explainer films with verified AI narration, music, measured captions, code-rendered charts and screenshots, 16:9 and 9:16 MP4s, contact sheets, and self-contained web pages; OpenRouter is required for voice, music, transcription, and vision review, while rendering runs locally through Remotion and ffmpeg.
Voice Film Skill.zh: Claude Code Skill 将研究、报告或产品故事转化为一到四分钟的语音讲解影片，其中包含经过验证的 AI 旁白、音乐、测量字幕、代码渲染图表和屏幕截图、16:9 和 9:16 MP4s、联系表和独立网页；语音、音乐、转录和视觉审核需要 OpenRouter，而渲染则通过 Remotion 和 ffmpeg 在本地运行。

Explainer Video Skill by rohithgoud30.source: Agent Skill for researching a topic and rendering narrated, captioned explainer videos from a JSON slide script on the user's machine, using offline open-weight Kokoro speech when available, Edge TTS as a network fallback, Chromium for slides, and ffmpeg for assembly; no paid model API key is required and the first run downloads its runtime assets.
Explainer Video Skill by rohithgoud30.zh: Agent Skill 用于研究主题并渲染来自用户计算机上的 JSON 幻灯片脚本的旁白、带字幕的解释视频，使用离线开放权重 Kokoro 语音（如果可用）、Edge TTS 作为网络后备、用于幻灯片的 Chromium 和 ffmpeg用于组装；不需要付费模型 API 密钥，第一次运行会下载其运行时资产。

skillbench by fielding.source: Append-only skill ablation harness and dashboard around Claude plugin eval that compares with-skill and bare-model runs across models, tracks lift, headroom, invocation rate, stale fingerprints, grader evidence, history, coverage, and costs, and emits a self-contained offline HTML dashboard; optional OpenAI-compatible models run through a private ephemeral proxy whose key material can resolve from environment, 1Password, or macOS Keychain and is deleted after each run.
skillbench by fielding.zh: 仅附加 Skill 消融工具和围绕 Claude 插件评估的仪表盘，与 Skill 和裸模型进行比较，跨模型运行，跟踪提升、净空、调用率、陈旧指纹、分级机证据、历史、覆盖范围和成本，并发出独立的离线 HTML 仪表盘；可选的 OpenAI 兼容模型通过私有临时代理运行，其密钥材料可以从环境、1Password 或 macOS 钥匙串中解析，并在每次运行后删除。

Interactive Workflow Skill.source: Agent Skill that converts process descriptions or Mermaid flows into self-contained clickable HTML workflow diagrams with accountable-owner context, search, deep links, four themes, keyboard access, whole-chain tracing, and PNG exports for slides; finished pages work offline, while optional Playwright and Chromium run collision, clipping, routing, and console audits before delivery.
Interactive Workflow Skill.zh: Agent Skill，可将流程描述或 Mermaid 流程转换为独立的可点击 HTML 工作流程图，具有责任所有者上下文、搜索、深层链接、四个主题、键盘访问、全链跟踪和幻灯片的 PNG 导出；完成的页面可以离线工作，而可选的 Playwright 和 Chromium 在交付前运行碰撞、裁剪、路由和控制台审核。

PPT Art Director.source: Research-presentation Agent Skill that searches and inspects current editable templates, plans exact slide copy, evidence, notes, timing, and motion, adapts the selected design into bilingual editable PowerPoint, and validates palettes, package structure, checksums, render quality, and animation plans; it uses the host's authoring tools, and native animation application requires Windows PowerPoint.
PPT Art Director.zh: 研究演示 Agent Skill，搜索和检查当前可编辑模板，计划精确的幻灯片副本、证据、注释、计时和动作，将所选设计调整为双语可编辑 PowerPoint，并验证调色板、包结构、校验和、渲染质量和动画计划；它使用主机的创作工具，本机动画应用程序需要Windows PowerPoint。

Cue Presentation Framework.source: Open-source presentation player and agent-oriented cartridge framework for self-contained HTML decks, with a typed cartridge specification, presenter notes, rehearsal timing, clicker controls, offline installable playback, and optional phone or tablet remotes through a Supabase relay; local presenter mode works without the relay or an internet connection.
Cue Presentation Framework.zh: 开源演示播放器和面向 Agent 的盒式框架，适用于独立的 HTML 唱盘，具有键入的盒式规格、演讲者注释、排练计时、答题器控制、离线安装播放以及通过 Supabase 继电器可选的手机或平板电脑遥控器；本地演示者模式无需中继或互联网连接即可工作。

deckforge by lrivallain.source: Themeable typed-slide framework with a visual editor, embedded GitHub Copilot agent, MCP tools, per-turn undo and audit logs, four themes, thirty-two templates, data charts, technical-deck starters, speaker notes, static HTML and editable PPTX export; inline builds can run and share offline with network checks, note stripping, source tracking, and deck diffs.
deckforge by lrivallain.zh: 主题式幻灯片框架，带有可视化编辑器、嵌入式 GitHub Copilot Agent、MCP 工具、每轮撤消和审核日志、四个主题、三十二个模板、数据图表、技术入门指南、演讲者注释、静态 HTML 和可编辑的 PPTX 导出；内联构建可以通过网络检查、注释剥离、源跟踪和演示文稿差异来离线运行和共享。

Code Flow Report.source: Claude Code skill that statically maps Python applications and AWS CDK infrastructure into a single offline interactive HTML report with call-graph exploration, user journeys, boundaries, model roles, UI triggers, data lifecycles, architecture layers, findings, and staleness checks; extraction and rendering use standard-library Python without running the target code or making network calls.
Code Flow Report.zh: Claude Code Skill，将 Python 应用程序和 AWS CDK 基础设施静态映射到单个离线交互式 HTML 报告中，其中包含调用图探索、用户旅程、边界、模型角色、UI 触发器、数据生命周期、架构层、结果和过时性检查；提取和渲染使用标准Python库，无需运行目标代码或进行网络调用。

Transcript per Slide.source: Agent Skill that pairs lecture slide PDFs with TXT, VTT, SRT, or Whisper transcripts, assigns spoken segments to each slide, cleans them into lecturer-voice notes, flags assessed actions and deadlines, and builds persistent Markdown study packs with slide images, saved tutoring answers, and checked explanatory figures; local scripts validate coverage, order, missing notes, and cut-off recordings.
Transcript per Slide.zh: Agent Skill 将讲座幻灯片 PDFs 与 TXT、VTT、SRT 或 Whisper 笔录配对，为每张幻灯片分配语音片段，将其清理为讲师语音笔记，标记评估的行动和截止日期，并建立持久的Markdown 学习包，包含幻灯片图像、保存的辅导答案和检查的解释图；本地脚本验证覆盖范围、顺序、丢失的注释和截止录音。

Video Kit by WorthingtonCloud.source: Two Claude Code skills on one local engine for narrated explainers and beat-cut promo reels, with code-drawn scenes, word-timed animation, frame and audio QA, optional voice, music, image, and video APIs behind cost gates, reusable assets, and a local Review Studio that captures pinpoint feedback, side-by-side options, mix decisions, approved exports, and learned preferences.
Video Kit by WorthingtonCloud.zh: 一台本地引擎上有两个 Claude Code Skill，用于解说解说和节拍剪辑促销卷轴，具有代码绘制场景、文字定时动画、帧和音频 QA、成本门后面的可选语音、音乐、图像和视频 APIs、可重复使用的资产以及并排捕获精确反馈的本地评论工作室选项、混合决策、批准的出口以及习得的偏好。
