Tutorial Video Skill.source: General Agent Skill for planning, producing, reviewing, and revising editable course videos across subjects, coordinating evidence, learning progression, diagrams, slides, notes, narration, captions, timing, accessibility, and delivery; local dependency-free helpers validate plans, captions, hashes, scene order, and audio-video sync, while optional ffmpeg assembly creates H.264/AAC videos without network calls.
Tutorial Video Skill.zh: 通用 Agent Skill 用于规划、制作、审查和修改跨学科的可编辑课程视频，协调证据、学习进度、图表、幻灯片、笔记、旁白、标题、时间安排、可访问性和交付；本地无依赖帮助程序验证计划、字幕、哈希、场景顺序和音频视频同步，而可选的 ffmpeg 组件无需网络调用即可创建 H.264/AAC 视频。

DynamicDecks Skill.source: Agent Skill for building one-file offline HTML presentations with animated numbers and text, step reveals, SVG charts and diagrams, simulations, interactive sliders, embedded media, clicker controls, speaker notes, presenter view, PDF export, PowerPoint-theme extraction, element references for revisions, and browser checks for overflow, missing still frames, and external network dependencies.
DynamicDecks Skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于构建单文件离线 HTML 演示文稿，其中包含动画数字和文本、步骤显示、SVG 图表和图表、模拟、交互式滑块、嵌入式媒体、点击器控件、演讲者注释、演示者视图、PDF 导出、PowerPoint 主题提取、元素修订参考，浏览器检查溢出、丢失静止帧和外部网络依赖性。

OpenRoom.source: Open-source deck editor and live classroom with layouts, themes, reveal order, notes, version history, polls, quizzes, word clouds, rankings, Q&A, homework, learner feedback, presenter displays, an agent sidebar, CLI, MCP server, and PowerPoint add-in; local files work offline in the desktop app, while live sessions use a hosted or self-hosted Cloudflare relay.
OpenRoom.zh: 开源演示文稿编辑器和现场课堂，包括布局、主题、显示顺序、注释、版本历史、民意调查、测验、文字云、排名、问答、作业、学习者反馈、演示者显示、Agent侧边栏、CLI、MCP服务器和PowerPoint插件；本地文件在桌面应用程序中离线工作，而实时会话则使用托管或自托管的 Cloudflare 中继。

open-slide-py.source: Dependency-free Python library, CLI, and Agent Skill that validates JSON slide scenes and exports byte-reproducible editable PPTX, per-slide SVG, static HTML, or a CSP-pinned offline interactive player with speaker notes, reveals, charts, palettes, contrast and overlap warnings, measured text wrapping, and native PowerPoint objects; PDF is obtained by printing the HTML output.
open-slide-py.zh: 无依赖性 Python 库、CLI 和 Agent Skill，用于验证 JSON 幻灯片场景并导出字节可重现可编辑 PPTX、每张幻灯片 SVG、静态 HTML 或CSP-pinned 离线交互式播放器，具有演讲者注释、显示、图表、调色板、对比度和重叠警告、测量文本换行以及原生 PowerPoint 对象； PDF 是通过打印 HTML 输出获得的。

SVG Animator Skill.source: Agent Skill for generating, repairing, linting, and frame-reviewing self-contained animated SVGs, with twenty-two generator types, fifty-two worked specs, offline static fallbacks, computed paths and timing, structural and geometry checks, and optional Playwright frame rendering for diagrams, charts, loaders, logos, scenes, and README or slide visuals.
SVG Animator Skill.zh: Agent Skill 用于生成、修复、检查和帧审查独立动画 SVGs，具有 22 种生成器类型、52 种工作规格、离线静态回退、计算路径和计时、结构和几何检查以及可选的 Playwright 帧渲染，用于图表、图表、加载程序、徽标、场景和README 或幻灯片视觉效果。

Code Guide.source: Agent Skill and plugin that converts a pull request, branch, or code question into one zoomable HTML map with folder and file topology, merged diffs, code snippets, line-anchored claims, semantic zoom, callouts, and a guided tour; Python and git validate every quoted line locally in a detached worktree, while the generated page loads its layout and syntax libraries from public CDNs and embeds the code it displays.
Code Guide.zh: Agent Skill 和插件，可将拉取请求、分支或代码问题转换为一个可缩放的 HTML 地图，其中包含文件夹和文件拓扑、合并差异、代码片段、行锚定声明、语义缩放、标注和导游； Python 和 git 在分离的工作树中本地验证每个引用的行，而生成的页面从公共 CDNs 加载其布局和语法库并嵌入其显示的代码。

mindmap-skills.source: Cross-agent Markmap skill that structures arbitrary material into concise MECE mind maps with controlled branch count, depth, density, folding, decisions, status, and trade-offs, then emits portable Markdown plus a CSP-hardened standalone HTML artifact; the core has no daemon, telemetry, backend, or idle tool schema, and its optional offline renderer guards CLI and script injection.
mindmap-skills.zh: 跨 Agent 标记图 Skill，将任意材料构造成简洁的 MECE 思维导图，并具有受控的分支计数、深度、密度、折叠、决策、状态和权衡，然后发出便携式 Markdown 加上 CSP-hardened 独立的 HTML 产物；该核心没有守护进程、遥测、后端或空闲工具模式，其可选的离线渲染器保护 CLI 和脚本注入。

Security Scan Skill.source: Read-only application security review Agent Skill that maps attack surfaces, applies fifteen perspectives, audits dependencies, records revision-pinned evidence and confidence, independently rechecks higher-severity findings, and renders one findings JSON into a searchable offline dashboard, print assessment, PDF, and chat summary with explicit coverage, exclusions, uncertainty, retest state, and redaction boundaries.
Security Scan Skill.zh: 只读应用程序安全审查 Agent Skill，映射攻击面、应用 15 个视角、审核依赖性、记录修订固定的证据和置信度、独立重新检查严重性较高的发现，并将一项发现 JSON 呈现到可搜索的离线仪表盘、打印评估、PDF 和聊天摘要，其中包含明确的覆盖范围、排除、不确定性、重新测试状态和编辑边界。

Demo Video Creator Skill.source: English and Korean Agent Skill that turns a live product URL into a forty-to-sixty-second 16:9 launch film using real high-resolution UI captures and output footage, one continuous ElevenLabs narration, generated music, beat-locked code motion, impact effects, captions, transition strips, sync tables, and audio and visual QA; it requires an ElevenLabs API key and keeps credentials in the local environment.
Demo Video Creator Skill.zh: 英语和韩语 Agent Skill 将现场产品 URL 转换为四十到六十秒的 16:9 启动影片，使用真正的高分辨率 UI 捕获和输出素材、一个连续的 ElevenLabs 旁白、生成的音乐、节拍锁定代码运动、冲击效果、字幕、转场片段、同步表以及音频和视频 QA；它需要 ElevenLabs API 密钥并将凭据保存在本地环境中。

Marp Presentation Skill by DavidElsdoerf.source: Local Marp skill and CLI for Markdown decks with interchangeable brand snapshots, localhost live preview, presenter-view HTML and PDF export, portable deck archives, and PowerPoint-master brand extraction and comparison. Requires Node, Python, and Chromium; LibreOffice, Poppler, and ImageMagick are optional import tools. No separate model API or GPU is required; imported logos, fonts, and templates retain their own terms.
Marp Presentation Skill by DavidElsdoerf.zh: 用于 Markdown 演示文稿的本地 Marp Skill 和 CLI 具有可互换的品牌快照、本地主机实时预览、演示者视图 HTML 和 PDF 导出、便携式演示文稿存档以及 PowerPoint 主品牌提取和比较。需要 Node、Python 和 Chromium； LibreOffice、Poppler 和 ImageMagick 是可选的导入工具。不需要单独的型号API或GPU；导入的徽标、字体和模板保留其自己的术语。

Circuit Diagram Skill.source: Local skill and Python CLI translating English DC-circuit descriptions into checked circuit notation, Schemdraw and Matplotlib worksheet diagrams, PNG/SVG/PDF files, and optional worked series/parallel solutions. US and IEC symbols are configurable; first-run dependency installation needs network access. Rendering needs no separate model API or GPU, with the host agent handling descriptions outside the deterministic phrase rules.
Circuit Diagram Skill.zh: 本地 Skill 和 Python CLI 将英文 DC-circuit 描述翻译为检查电路符号、Schemdraw 和 Matplotlib 工作表图表、PNG/SVG/PDF 文件以及可选的串联/并联解决方案。 US和IEC符号是可配置的；首次运行依赖项安装需要网络访问。渲染不需要单独的模型 API 或 GPU，主机 Agent 处理确定性短语规则之外的描述。

GeoGebra Skills by luzwales.source: Two agent skills for cropped PNG geometry/function plots and native editable GeoGebra GGB projects with movable points, sliders, algebraic definitions, and optional PNG previews. Requires Node 18+, Playwright, and Chromium; rendering loads the official GeoGebra web runtime over the network. No separate model API or GPU requirement is documented. The README states MIT, but GitHub does not expose a detected repository license.
GeoGebra Skills by luzwales.zh: 两个 Agent Skill，用于裁剪 PNG 几何/函数图和本机可编辑 GeoGebra GGB 项目，具有可移动点、滑块、代数定义和可选的 PNG 预览。需要节点 18+、Playwright 和 Chromium；渲染通过网络加载官方 GeoGebra Web 运行时。没有记录单独的型号 API 或 GPU 要求。 README 声明 MIT，但 GitHub 不会公开检测到的存储库许可证。

slides by kju4q.source: Claude Code skill that reads a repository, runs its own logic to reproduce numbers, and builds an eight-to-ten-slide self-contained HTML explainer with real code snippets, charts, examples, citations for unreproduced results, and optional live browser simulations. The deck works offline; authoring executes project code and may install its dependencies. Optional headless browser QA checks layout and console errors. No separate API key or GPU requirement is documented.
slides by kju4q.zh: Claude Code Skill 读取存储库，运行自己的逻辑来重现数字，并构建一个八到十张幻灯片的独立 HTML 解释器，其中包含真实的代码片段、图表、示例、未重现结果的引用以及可选的实时浏览器模拟。该套牌可以离线工作；创作执行项目代码并可能安装其依赖项。可选的无头浏览器 QA 检查布局和控制台错误。没有记录单独的 API 密钥或 GPU 要求。

khan-explainer.source: macOS Claude Code skill for narrated board-drawing explainers, screenshot tutorials, and real-audio shorts, using HTML canvas, Playwright, Chromium, ffmpeg, and built-in say speech. Beat durations follow measured narration; blackboard, whiteboard, landscape, vertical, multilingual text, and contact-sheet QA are supported. Local speech needs no account or API key; optional ElevenLabs sends narration to its API, Kokoro provides local neural speech, faster-whisper transcribes clips locally, and macOS Vision handles optional speaker cutouts. No mandatory GPU is documented.
khan-explainer.zh: macOS Claude Code Skill 用于解说板图解说、屏幕截图教程和真实音频短片，使用 HTML 画布、Playwright、Chromium、ffmpeg 和内置语音。节拍持续时间遵循有节奏的叙述；支持黑板、白板、横向、纵向、多语言文本和联系表 QA。本地语音无需账号或API密钥；可选的 ElevenLabs 将旁白发送到其 API，Kokoro 提供本地神经语音，faster-whisper 在本地转录剪辑，macOS Vision 处理可选的扬声器切口。没有记录强制性的 GPU。

Orkas.source: Orkas desktop app includes PptMaker, which turns topics, outlines and documents into editable PPTX decks, coordinated with research and writing agents. Bring your own model keys; runs locally on macOS, Windows and supported Linux systems.
Orkas.zh: Orkas 桌面应用包含 PptMaker，可将主题、大纲和文档转成可编辑的 PPTX 演示文稿，并与研究、写作 Agent 配合使用。需自行提供模型密钥，可在 macOS、Windows 和受支持的 Linux 系统上本地运行。

OrkasVideoStudio.source: Agent-driven CLI, MCP server and skills for HTML motion-graphic explainers, footage editing and optional AI generation through an editable plan.json. Source installation needs Node 22+ and FFmpeg/ffprobe; model-provider keys are optional for generation and narration.
OrkasVideoStudio.zh: 由 Agent 驱动的 CLI、MCP 服务和 Skill，通过可编辑的 plan.json 制作 HTML 动态讲解内容、剪辑素材，并按需调用 AI 生成功能。从源码安装需要 Node 22+ 及 FFmpeg/ffprobe；生成与旁白功能可选配模型服务商密钥。
